AFTER MOVING:

(none).when: Your Fight phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

Your unit shoots as described in Making Attacks (04).
WHILE SHOOTING: You can only select [ASSAULT] weapons to make attacks with.
AFTER SHOOTING: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to start an action.

(none).name: BATTLEFIELD COMMAND
(none).flavor: The commander's authoritative tone cuts through the din of battle, guiding the actions of nearby troops.
(none).when: Start or end of any phase.
(none).target: One Leader unit from your army and one friendly Bodyguard unit within 6" of it that it could normally be attached to.
(none).effect: Select one of your Leader unit’s Leader abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Bodyguard unit is treated as being led by that Leader unit for the purposes of that Leader ability.
(none).restrictions: Once you target a unit with this Stratagem, that unit cannot be targeted with it again until your next Command phase.

(none).name: BURST OF SPEED
(none).flavor: Having unleashed hell upon their target, this unit presses forward, lent fresh speed and impetus by the invigorating thrill of battle.
(none).when: End of your Shooting phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army (excluding units that made a move this phase).
(none).effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", and then cannot move again this phase.

(none).name: CHARGE MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).
BEFORE MOVING: Select one or more enemy units that are within 12" of your unit and within the maximum distance of your unit; until the end of this move, each of those enemy units is a charge target.
WHILE MOVING:
  • Each model must end its move closer to one or more charge targets.
  • Each model that can end its move within 1" of one or more charge targets must do so.
  • Each model that can end its move engaged with one or more charge targets must do so.
AFTER MOVING:
  • Your unit must be engaged with all of the charge targets.
  • Your unit cannot be engaged with one or more enemy units that are not charge targets.
  • Until the end of the turn, each model in your unit has the Fights First ability (24.13).

(none).name: CLOSE-QUARTERS SHOOTING
(none).effect:
Your unit shoots as described in Making Attacks (04).
WHILE SHOOTING: Models in your unit can target enemy units your unit is engaged with.
  • MONSTER/VEHICLE Models: Each time a MONSTER/VEHICLE model in your unit makes an attack:
    • Unless that attack is made with a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon and targets a unit your unit is engaged with, subtract 1 from the hit roll.
    • If that attack is made with a [BLAST] weapon, it still cannot target a unit your unit is engaged with.
  • Non-MONSTER/Non-VEHICLE Models: You can only select [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons to make attacks with and you can only select enemy units that are engaged with your unit as targets.
AFTER SHOOTING: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to start an action.

(none).name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
(none).flavor: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
(none).when: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army.
(none).target: That unit or model from your army.
(none).effect: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

(none).name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
(none).flavor: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
(none).when: Any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.
(none).target: That unit or model from your army.
(none).effect: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.

(none).name: COMMAND RE-ROLL

  • Charge roll
  • Damage roll
  • Hazard roll
  • Hit roll
  • Save roll
  • Wound roll
  • A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.
(none).target: That unit or model.
(none).effect: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

(none).name: CONSOLIDATION MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).
BEFORE MOVING: Select consolidation mode:
  • Ongoing Consolidation:
    If your unit is engaged, you must select this mode and select every enemy unit it is engaged with.
  • Engaging Consolidation:
    Otherwise, if your unit is within 3" of one or more enemy units, you must select this mode and select one or more of those enemy units.
  • Objective Consolidation:
    Otherwise, if your unit is within 3" of one or more objectives, you must select this mode and select one of those objectives.
WHILE MOVING:
  • Ongoing Consolidation:
    Models in base-contact with one or more enemy models cannot be moved. Each model that is moved must end its move closer to the closest selected enemy unit, and engaged with it if possible.
  • Engaging Consolidation:
    Each model that is moved must end its move closer to the closest selected enemy unit, and engaged with it if possible.
  • Objective Consolidation:
    Each model that is moved must end its move within range of the selected objective if possible, or closer to it if not.
AFTER MOVING:
  • Ongoing Consolidation:
    Each model that started this move engaged with an enemy unit must still be engaged with that enemy unit.
  • Engaging Consolidation:
    Your unit must be engaged with all of the selected enemy units. If one or more enemy units engaged with your unit have not been selected to fight this phase, your opponent must select each of those units, one at a time; when each is selected, it becomes eligible to fight and is selected to fight (12.04).
  • Objective Consolidation:
    Your unit must be unengaged and within range of the selected objective.

(none).name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
(none).flavor: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
(none).when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
(none).target: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
(none).effect: Your unit fights next.

(none).name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE

(none).name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
(none).flavor: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
(none).when: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
(none).target: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

(none).name: CRUSHING IMPACT
(none).flavor: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
(none).when: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move.
(none).target: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit.
(none).effect:
Resolve the following sequence:
  1. Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit.
  2. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit.
  3. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

(none).name: DISEMBARK MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
BEFORE MOVING: Select disembark mode:
  • Rapid Disembark:
    If that TRANSPORT made a normal or ingress move this phase, you must select this mode.
  • Tactical Disembark:
    Otherwise, If that TRANSPORT remained stationary or has not yet been selected to move this phase, and if you can set up your unit as described below, you must select this mode.
  • Combat Disembark:
    Otherwise, you must select this mode. Make a hazard roll for each model in your unit.
WHILE MOVING: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
  • Rapid Disembark:
    If that TRANSPORT made an ingress move this turn, each model must follow the same rules that TRANSPORT had to follow while resolving that move.
  • Combat Disembark:
    Each model can be set up engaged with one or more enemy units that TRANSPORT is engaged with.
AFTER MOVING:
  • Rapid Disembark:
    Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
  • Tactical Disembark:
    Select your unit to make a normal or advance move.
  • Combat Disembark:
    Your unit is battle-shocked and, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
RAPID DISEMBARK
When a unit uses the rapid disembark mode after its TRANSPORT makes an ingress move, the models must follow the same rules and restrictions as that TRANSPORT did. For example, if that TRANSPORT had to be set up more than 8" from all enemy units and not within your opponent’s deployment zone, the same applies to the disembarking unit.

(none).name: EMERGENCY DISEMBARK MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
BEFORE MOVING: Make a hazard roll for each model in your unit (06.03).
WHILE MOVING: Set up each model in your unit: (1) Wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT, and as close as possible to that TRANSPORT. OR: (2) If the above is not possible while remaining unengaged, set up that model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT, as close as possible to that TRANSPORT, and engaged. Each model that still cannot be set up is destroyed.
AFTER MOVING: Your unit is battle-shocked and, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

(none).target: One CHARACTER model in your unit.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.

(none).name: EPIC CHALLENGE

(none).target: That CHARACTER unit.

(none).name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE

(none).target: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
(none).effect: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

(none).effect:
Resolve the following sequence:
  1. Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit.
  2. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model.
  3. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

(none).name: FALL-BACK MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).
BEFORE MOVING: Select fall-back mode:
  • Ordered Retreat: If your unit is not battle-shocked, you can select this mode.
  • Desperate Escape: Otherwise, you must select this mode. Make a hazard roll for each model in your unit (06.03).
WHILE MOVING:
  • Desperate Escape: Each model that is moved can be moved through enemy models.
AFTER MOVING:
  • Your unit must be unengaged.
  • Until the end of the turn, unless otherwise stated, your unit is not eligible to shoot, declare a charge or start an action.
  • Desperate Escape: If your unit is not battle-shocked, you must make a battle-shock roll for your unit (01.07).

(none).name: FALL-BACK MOVE

BEFORE MOVING: Select fall-back mode:

  • Desperate Escape: Otherwise, you must select this mode. Make a hazard roll for each model in your unit (06.03).
WHILE MOVING:

AFTER MOVING:

  • Until the end of the turn, unless otherwise stated, your unit is not eligible to shoot, declare a charge or start an action.

(none).name: FIRE OVERWATCH
(none).flavor: A hail of wildfire can drive back advancing foes.
(none).when: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or when an enemy unit starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.
(none).target: One unit from your army that is within 24" of that enemy unit and that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.
(none).effect: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot that enemy unit as if it were your Shooting phase.
(none).restrictions: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

(none).name: FIRE OVERWATCH
(none).flavor: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
(none).when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
(none).target: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units).
(none).effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

(none).name: FORCE A BREACH
(none).flavor: Break through their defences, smash down their walls and barricades and breach their lines. Let no obstacle halt your progress.
(none).when: Your Movement phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through models and terrain features.

(none).when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
(none).target: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.

(none).when: Your Movement phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, add D6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

(none).name: GRENADE
(none).flavor: Priming their hand-held projectiles, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
(none).when: Your Shooting phase.
(none).target: One GRENADES unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
(none).effect: Select one GRENADES model in your unit and one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your GRENADES model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

(none).name: HARBOURED POWER
(none).flavor: Overcharged power packs, experimental ammunition, potent combat stimms or sorcerous might: these assets may be expended in the pursuit of victory.

(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability and your choice of the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

(none).name: HEROIC INTERVENTION

(none).when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
(none).target: One unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
(none).effect: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.
(none).restrictions: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

(none).name: HEROIC INTERVENTION

(none).when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
(none).target: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.
(none).effect:
Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes:
  • Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
+1CP
  • Into the Fray:
    • When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
    • When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

(none).name: INDIRECT SHOOTING
(none).effect:
Your unit shoots as described in Making Attacks (04).
WHILE SHOOTING:
  • [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons in your unit can target units that are not visible to the attacking model.
  • Each time an [INDIRECT FIRE] weapon makes an attack:
    • The target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).
    • You cannot re-roll hit rolls.
    • An unmodified hit roll of 1-5 fails, unless your unit remained stationary this turn and the target is visible to one or more friendly units, in which case an unmodified hit roll of 1-3 fails instead.
AFTER SHOOTING: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to start an action.
INDIRECT FIRE
When you select indirect shooting for a unit, its [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons can launch punishing barrages on targets that are not visible, but don’t forget that its other weapons can still target other visible targets.

  • Each time an [INDIRECT FIRE] weapon makes an attack:

INDIRECT FIRE
When you select indirect shooting for a unit, its [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons can launch punishing barrages on targets that are not visible, but don’t forget that its other weapons can still target other visible targets.

(none).name: INGRESS MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
BEFORE MOVING: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
WHILE MOVING: Set up your unit wholly within the set-up distance of one or more battlefield edges and more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.
  • Before the Third Battle Round: While doing so, no models can be set up within your opponent’s deployment zone.
AFTER MOVING: Unless otherwise stated, until the start of the next Charge phase, your unit is not eligible to make any other type of move.

(none).name: OVERRUN FIGHT
(none).effect:
Your unit can make one additional pile-in move, then fights as described in Making Attacks (04).
OVERRUN FIGHTS
When a unit makes an overrun fight, its models can be moved such that enemy units that were unengaged become engaged. Such enemy units become eligible to fight this phase (and may even be able to fight next if they are Fights First units).

(none).name: PILE-IN MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).
BEFORE MOVING: Select pile-in targets:
  • If your unit is engaged, select every enemy unit it is engaged with.
  • Otherwise, select one or more enemy units within 5" of your unit.
WHILE MOVING:
  • Models in base-contact with one or more enemy models cannot be moved.
  • Each model that is moved must end its move closer to the closest pile-in target, and engaged with it if possible.
AFTER MOVING:
  • Your unit must be engaged.
  • Each model that started this move engaged with an enemy unit must still be engaged with that enemy unit.

(none).name: PIVOTAL MOMENT
(none).flavor: The outcome of the battle hangs in the balance. This is the time to strike hard and without mercy.
(none).when: Your Movement phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army.
(none).effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

(none).name: RAPID INGRESS
(none).flavor: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
(none).when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.
(none).effect: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, and if every model in that unit has the Deep Strike ability, you can set that unit up as described in the Deep Strike ability (even though it is not your Movement phase).
(none).restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem to enable a unit to arrive on the battlefield during a battle round it would not normally be able to do so in.

(none).name: RAPID INGRESS
(none).flavor: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
(none).when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
(none).target: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT).
(none).effect: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04).
(none).restrictions: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

(none).name: REMAIN STATIONARY
(none).effect: No models are moved (either in straight lines or rotated). Units that remain stationary do not trigger any rules that are triggered when a unit starts or ends a move.

(none).name: REMAIN STATIONARY
(none).effect: No models are moved (either in straight lines or rotated). Units that remain stationary do not trigger any rules that are triggered when a unit starts or ends a move.

(none).name: RENEWED FOCUS
(none).flavor: Shutting out the din of battle, these warriors focus only on their foes, unleashing an inescapable fusillade of death and destruction.
(none).when: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

(none).name: SCOUT MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).
AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

(none).name: SMOKESCREEN
(none).flavor: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
(none).when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
(none).target: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.

(none).name: SMOKESCREEN
(none).flavor: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
(none).when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
(none).target: One friendly SMOKE unit.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

(none).name: SNAP SHOOTING
(none).effect:
Your unit shoots as described in Making Attacks (04).
WHILE SHOOTING:
  • You can only target one visible enemy unit within 24" of your unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
  • Each attack only hits on an unmodified hit roll of 6 (irrespective of the attacking weapon’s BS characteristic or any modifiers).
  • You cannot re-roll hit rolls.
AFTER SHOOTING: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to start an action.

(none).name: STRATEGIC RETREAT
(none).flavor: The soundest military minds find no shame in signalling a retreat. Strength preserved may prove pivotal at a later juncture.
(none).when: Start of your Shooting phase.
(none).target: One unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
(none).effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

(none).name: SURGE MOVE
(none).effect:
Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).
BEFORE MOVING: Select the closest enemy unit to be the surge target.
WHILE MOVING:
  • Each model must end its move engaged with the surge target if possible.
  • Each model that cannot end its move engaged with the surge target must end its move as close as possible to the surge target.
AFTER MOVING:
  • Your unit cannot be engaged with one or more enemy units that were not the surge target.
  • Your unit cannot move again this phase.

(none).name: TANK SHOCK
(none).flavor: Ramming the foe with a speeding vehicle may be an unsubtle tactic, but it is a murderously effective one.
(none).when: Your Charge phase, just after a VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
(none).target: That VEHICLE unit.
(none).effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, and select one VEHICLE model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the Toughness characteristic of the selected VEHICLE model. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Auric Champions.name: EARNING OF A NAME
Auric Champions.flavor: To lay low the greatest and most terrible monsters and heretics is to earn new names for a Custodian's mighty tally.
Auric Champions.target: Up to two Adeptus Custodes Character units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
Auric Champions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Auric Champions.name: SHOULDER THE MANTLE
Auric Champions.flavor: The greatest Custodians know when it is both their duty and their right to command their comrades.
Auric Champions.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
Auric Champions.target: One Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army that is not leading a unit.
Auric Champions.effect: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.

Auric Champions.name: SLAYER OF CHAMPIONS
Auric Champions.flavor: Whatfoe can withstand a warrior who has so tested the defences of the Throneworld itself?
Auric Champions.target: One Adeptus Custodes Character unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected at the start of your Command phase as the target of your Assemblage of Might ability.
Auric Champions.effect: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that target that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.

Auric Champions.name: SUPERHUMAN RESERVES
Auric Champions.flavor: With practiced ease, the Talons of the Emperor establish vicious crossfires to cut the foe apart.
Auric Champions.when: Any phase, just after an Adeptus Custodes Warlord model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement that says it can only be used Once per battle.
Auric Champions.effect: Your model can use its Once per battle’ ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase).
Auric Champions.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

Auric Champions.name: THE EMPEROR’S AUSPICE
Auric Champions.flavor: In an age plagued by monsters, when primordial horrors from the darkest void circle Humanity's dying light, still the Adeptus Custodes stand strong.
Auric Champions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Auric Champions.target: One Adeptus Custodes Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Auric Champions.effect: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

Auric Champions.name: VIGIL UNENDING
Auric Champions.flavor: The Custodes do not yield while their duty remains unfulfilled.
Auric Champions.target: One Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Auric Champions.effect: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

Black Ship Guardians.name: BLADES OF THE VIGILATORS
Black Ship Guardians.flavor: Though intended for lopping the heads from witches, the Vigilators' long blades also allow for skilful parrying of incoming attacks.
Black Ship Guardians.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Black Ship Guardians.target: One VIgiLATORS, ALEYA or KNIGHT-CENTURA equipped with an executioner greatblade unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Black Ship Guardians.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Black Ship Guardians.name: CORNERED PREY
Black Ship Guardians.flavor: Once they have their quarry trapped within a section of the voidship, the Silent Sisters relentlessly run them to ground.
Black Ship Guardians.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army Falls Back.
Black Ship Guardians.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Black Ship Guardians.name: FOCUSED FEAR
Black Ship Guardians.flavor: Fighting in the confines of a voidship heightens the fearful aura of the Sisters of Silence, fouling their foes'aim and weakening their sword arms.
Black Ship Guardians.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Black Ship Guardians.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Black Ship Guardians.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Black Ship Guardians.name: PUNISHMENT OF THE PROSECUTORS
Black Ship Guardians.flavor: The Prosecutors cut down without mercy all who dare stand between the Silent Sisters and their prey.
Black Ship Guardians.target: One PROSEcUTORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Black Ship Guardians.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.

Lions of the Emperor.name: DEFIANT TO THE LAST
Lions of the Emperor.flavor: The harder the battle, and the heavier their losses, the more resolute the Lions of the Emperor become.
Lions of the Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Lions of the Emperor
Lions of the Emperor.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lions of the Emperor.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lions of the Emperor.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.

Lions of the Emperor.name: GILDED CHAMPION
Lions of the Emperor.flavor: The shining champions of the Adeptus Custodes are looked upon in awe by all who witness their grim arts. Their judgement is without flaw, and their tactical acumen utterly impeccable.
Lions of the Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Lions of the Emperor
Lions of the Emperor.when: Any phase, just after an Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.
Lions of the Emperor.effect: Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).
Lions of the Emperor.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.

Lions of the Emperor.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
Lions of the Emperor.flavor: The Adeptus Custodes are unrelenting in their advance, laying down punishing fire even as they manoeuvre to new positions.
Lions of the Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Lions of the Emperor
Lions of the Emperor.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
Lions of the Emperor.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Lions of the Emperor.name: PEERLESS WARRIOR
Lions of the Emperor.flavor: With every strike, the Lions of the Emperor prove themselves the masters of single combat, even when engaging the mightiest foes.
Lions of the Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Lions of the Emperor
Lions of the Emperor.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Lions of the Emperor.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

Lions of the Emperor.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
Lions of the Emperor.flavor: Although every Custodian is devastatingly fast on the battlefield, with preternatural reactions to match, the Lions of the Emperor are outstanding even among their peers.
Lions of the Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Lions of the Emperor
Lions of the Emperor.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Lions of the Emperor.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lions of the Emperor.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Lions of the Emperor.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
Lions of the Emperor.flavor: Heroic bands of Terminator-armoured Custodians engage entire armies in unrelenting battle.
Lions of the Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Lions of the Emperor
Lions of the Emperor.target: One Allarus Custodians or Aquilon Custodians unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
Lions of the Emperor.effect: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.

Might of the Moritoi.name: FLAWLESS CONSTRUCTION
Might of the Moritoi.flavor: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnoughts possess expertly wrought armoured forms that contain ancient and esoteric technology, including auto‑repair subroutines and reactive field generators.
Might of the Moritoi.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Might of the Moritoi
Might of the Moritoi.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.
Might of the Moritoi.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Might of the Moritoi.name: PRIORITISED ERADICATION
Might of the Moritoi.flavor: When lauded Telemon pilots turn their pitiless optics upon a proximal threat, the storm of accelerated firepower that ensues leaves naught but smoking ruin.
Might of the Moritoi.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Might of the Moritoi
Might of the Moritoi.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to shoot.
Might of the Moritoi.effect:
Your unit’s:
  • Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons have [RAPID FIRE 6].
  • Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons have [RAPID FIRE 2].

Might of the Moritoi.name: UNSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
Might of the Moritoi.flavor: Even the most formidable obstacles give way to the ancient warriors of the Moritoi, ruptured and trampled underfoot or barged aside with howl of empowered servos.
Might of the Moritoi.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Might of the Moritoi
Might of the Moritoi.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit is selected to move.

Null Maiden Vigil.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
Null Maiden Vigil.flavor: The Vigilators train tirelessly in the art of the swift, beheading strike, with a particular emphasis on the swift elimination of enemy witches.
Null Maiden Vigil.target: One Vigilators unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Null Maiden Vigil.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

Null Maiden Vigil.name: DESPERATION’S PRICE
Null Maiden Vigil.flavor: To overcome the Null Maidens’ aura, enemy psykers overstretch themselves with horrible consequences.
Null Maiden Vigil.when: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.
Null Maiden Vigil.target: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.
Null Maiden Vigil.effect: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.

Null Maiden Vigil.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
Null Maiden Vigil.flavor: Prosecutors can fire psy-chaff bolts whose esoteric emissions weaken those targets not slain outright.
Null Maiden Vigil.target: One Prosecutors unit from your army that has just shot.
Null Maiden Vigil.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an Anathema Psykana model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Null Maiden Vigil.name: PSYCHIC ABOMINATIONS
Null Maiden Vigil.flavor: Enemies must overcome disorienting waves of revulsion in order to even focus upon Null Maidens.
Null Maiden Vigil.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Null Maiden Vigil.target: One Anathema Psykana Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Null Maiden Vigil.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".

Null Maiden Vigil.name: PURGATION SWEEP
Null Maiden Vigil.flavor: Witchseekers know their role in combat is to spread indiscriminate carnage through the foe’s ranks.
Null Maiden Vigil.target: One Witchseekers unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Null Maiden Vigil.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.

Null Maiden Vigil.name: WITCH HUNTERS
Null Maiden Vigil.flavor: Null Maidens train to slay psykers with swift martial efficiency, for they know their prey have many weapons beyond just their powers and must not be allowed time or opportunity to employ them.
Null Maiden Vigil.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Null Maiden Vigil.target: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Null Maiden Vigil.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.

Shield Host.name: ARCANE GENETIC ALCHEMY
Shield Host.flavor: The Adeptus Custodes are individually engineered on a molecular level using secrets of genetic alchemy that render them virtual demigods in battle.
Shield Host.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an Adeptus Custodes model from your army(excluding Anathema Psykana models).
Shield Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

Shield Host.name: ARCHEOTECH MUNITIONS
Shield Host.flavor: The Shield Hosts have access to stockpiles of ancient and incredibly rare weaponry and ammunition.
Shield Host.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Shield Host.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

Shield Host.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
Shield Host.flavor: The loss of a single Talon of the Emperor is commemorated by the tolling of the Bell of Lost Souls on Terra, and by their comrades’ bloody vengeance on the battlefield.
Shield Host.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that is below its Starting Strength.
Shield Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.

Shield Host.name: MULTIPOTENTIALITY
Shield Host.flavor: So widely skilled and studied are the Custodians that, whatever situation they find themselves in, they have the martial wisdom to prevail.
Shield Host.target: One Adeptus Custodes unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
Shield Host.effect: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Shield Host.name: UNWAVERING SENTINELS
Shield Host.flavor: Once the Custodians have laid claim to a location, they defend it with incredible tenacity and skill.
Shield Host.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shield Host.target: One Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Shield Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Shield Host.name: VIGILANCE ETERNAL
Shield Host.flavor: Simply because the Adeptus Custodes do not stand sentinel over a strategic location or asset, does not mean that it - or any who would threaten it - escapes their gaze.
Shield Host.target: One Adeptus Custodes Battleline unit from your army (excluding Anathema Psykana units) within range of an objective marker you control.
Shield Host.effect: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

Silent Hunters.name: DEATHSONG SCYTHES
Silent Hunters.flavor: After stalking their sorcerous prey in silence, the charge of the Vigilators is accompanied by a keening song of death emitted by their scything greatblades as they are swept in eviscerating arcs.
Silent Hunters.when: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATORS unit is selected to fight.
Silent Hunters.effect:
• Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
  • Your unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have +1 A.

Silent Hunters.name: SYNCHRONISED INFERNO
Silent Hunters.flavor: Coordinating through a rapid exchange of Thoughtmark, Witchseekers unleash a flesh-melting inferno of all-consuming promethium from their flamers.
Silent Hunters.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKERS unit is selected to shoot.

Silent Hunters.name: UMBRAL PROSECUTION
Silent Hunters.flavor: When they have cornered their quarry at close range, Prosecutors fire their Umbra-pattern bolters in rapid bursts that sow strings of armour-shredding shots amongst the enemy.
Silent Hunters.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTORS unit is selected to shoot.
Silent Hunters.effect:
Your unit’s Boltgun weapons have:
  • [RAPID FIRE 2].
  • +1 AP.

Solar Spearhead.name: EMPEROR’S VENGEANCE
Solar Spearhead.flavor: Even as death’s cold embrace falls upon them, Custodians vent the last of their wrath upon the foe.
Solar Spearhead.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Solar Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Solar Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Walker keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.

Solar Spearhead.name: FLAWLESS CONSTRUCTION
Solar Spearhead.flavor: The vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are the finest examples of their kind. Their expertly wrought armoured forms contain ancient and esoteric technology, including auto-repair subroutines and reactive field generators.
Solar Spearhead.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Solar Spearhead.target: One Adeptus Custodes Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Solar Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Solar Spearhead.name: PUNISHMENT INESCAPABLE
Solar Spearhead.flavor: The Ten Thousand are relentless in pursuing the Emperor’s foes and thorough in their annihilation. No armour, sorcery or hiding place can shield an enemy from their wrath.
Solar Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Solar Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

Solar Spearhead.name: RELENTLESS PERSECUTION
Solar Spearhead.flavor: Custodians coax wrathful fury from their war engines’ machine spirits to hunt down and eliminate their foes at speed.
Solar Spearhead.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
Solar Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the Walker keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

Solar Spearhead.name: UNSTOPPABLE
Solar Spearhead.flavor: Armoured in adamantine and possessed of furious machine spirits, the vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are almost impossible to stop in their tracks.
Solar Spearhead.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Solar Spearhead.target: One Adeptus Custodes Vehicle or Adeptus Custodes Mounted unit from your army.
Solar Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.

Solar Spearhead.name: WRATHFUL ADVANCE
Solar Spearhead.flavor: The golden-armoured onslaught smashes through the enemy line, trapping the foe and preventing their escape.
Solar Spearhead.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
Solar Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".

Talons Of The Emperor.name: EMPEROR’S EXECUTIONERS
Talons Of The Emperor.flavor: The Talons of the Emperor tear apart their prey.
Talons Of The Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Talons Of The Emperor
Talons Of The Emperor.target: Up to two Adeptus Custodes units from your army.
Talons Of The Emperor.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Talons Of The Emperor.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an Anathema Psykana unit and both are within 6" of each other.

Talons Of The Emperor.name: EMPYRIC SEVERANCE
Talons Of The Emperor.flavor: Null Maidens quash the manifestations of witches.
Talons Of The Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Talons Of The Emperor
Talons Of The Emperor.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Talons Of The Emperor.target: One ADEPTUS CusTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
Talons Of The Emperor.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

Talons Of The Emperor.name: HUNT AS ONE
Talons Of The Emperor.flavor: Custodians and Null Maidens cover one another seamlessly as they manoeuvre to corner their prey.
Talons Of The Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Talons Of The Emperor
Talons Of The Emperor.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
Talons Of The Emperor.effect: Until the end of the turn, your units are eilgible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.
Talons Of The Emperor.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.

Talons Of The Emperor.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
Talons Of The Emperor.flavor: It is second nature for Custodes to place themselves between their comrades and potential peril.
Talons Of The Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Talons Of The Emperor
Talons Of The Emperor.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Talons Of The Emperor.target: One Anathema Psykana Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one other friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.
Talons Of The Emperor.effect: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).

Talons Of The Emperor.name: TALONED PINCER
Talons Of The Emperor.flavor: Every move the enemy makes only sees them fall.
Talons Of The Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Talons Of The Emperor
Talons Of The Emperor.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Talons Of The Emperor.target: Up to two Adeptus Custodes units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit.
Talons Of The Emperor.effect: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Talons Of The Emperor.restrictions: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an Anathema Psykana unit and both are within 6" of each other.

Talons Of The Emperor.name: TALONS INTERLOCKED
Talons Of The Emperor.flavor: With practiced ease, the Talons of the Emperor establish vicious crossfires to cut the foe apart.
Talons Of The Emperor.group: ADEPTUS CUSTODES - Talons Of The Emperor
Talons Of The Emperor.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.
Talons Of The Emperor.effect: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
Talons Of The Emperor.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.

Tharanatoi Hammerblow.name: ELECTROEXORCIST SATURATION
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.flavor: A concussive barrage of specialist grenades enables Allarus Custodians to maximise the destructive potential of their armmounted launchers against their massed enemies.
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.effect: Your unit’s Ballistus Grenade Launcher weapons have D3+3 A.

Tharanatoi Hammerblow.name: HARDENED RESOLVE
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.flavor: Steeling their souls and bracing their indomitable armour, heavily girded Custodians will cleave to their duty and reject attempts to cut them down.
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATORADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

Tharanatoi Hammerblow.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.flavor: Heroic bands of Terminator‑armoured Custodians engage entire armies in unrelenting battle.
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.target: One friendly ALLARUS CUSTODIANS/AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit that is on the battlefield.
Tharanatoi Hammerblow.effect: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.

Voyagers in Darkness.name: ARTIFICER ROUNDS
Voyagers in Darkness.flavor: These hand-crafted bolt shells are made to fragment with particular ferocity, making them ideal for boarding actions.
Voyagers in Darkness.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Voyagers in Darkness.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6".

Voyagers in Darkness.name: AURIC STORM
Voyagers in Darkness.flavor: Even the boldest foes falter before the sudden and unstoppable onslaught of the Allarus Terminators.
Voyagers in Darkness.when: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Voyagers in Darkness.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Voyagers in Darkness.name: BREACHING BEHEMOTHS
Voyagers in Darkness.flavor: When unleashed aboard an enemy voidship, Custodians simply smash a path through any who stand against them by their sheer armoured might.
Voyagers in Darkness.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.
Voyagers in Darkness.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there. In addition, any Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed.

Voyagers in Darkness.name: INESCAPABLE VENGEANCE
Voyagers in Darkness.flavor: The incredible sensory acuity of the Custodians' wargear coupled with their superhuman senses means no foe can hide from them.
Voyagers in Darkness.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.
Voyagers in Darkness.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can ignore Walls and other models for the purposes of determining which enemy units are visible to its own.

(none).name: THREAT‑COGITATION TARGETERS
(none).flavor: Supplementary analytic cogitation routines identify targets of primary importance and assist in their

Cohort Acquisitus.name: CLANDESTINE REPOSITION
Cohort Acquisitus.flavor: Under the cover of a multi‑spectral burst of binharic feedback, vectors of redeployment can be opened up that are unanticipated and unseen by the enemy.
Cohort Acquisitus.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

Cohort Acquisitus.name: DEFECT SCRUTINY
Cohort Acquisitus.flavor: By focusing implanted augurs with split‑second analysis, the foe’s flaws can be exposed and broadcast in a clarion call to the rest of the Omnissiah’s faithful.
Cohort Acquisitus.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to shoot.
Cohort Acquisitus.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly RECON AUGURY unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

Cohort Acquisitus.name: REPOLARISED AUGURS
Cohort Acquisitus.flavor: With a recalibration of divinatory implants, their information absorption can be redirected as a scrambled emission which the enemy’s senses cannot easily penetrate.
Cohort Acquisitus.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Cohort Acquisitus.effect: Your unit has -3" detection range until the end of the turn.

Cohort Cybernetica.name: AUTO-DIVINATORY TARGETING
Cohort Cybernetica.flavor: Encoded with the schemata of the enemy's fortified battle lines and auto-codified vectors of attack, the Cohort's war engines are perfectly aligned to deliver the Machine God's wrath.
Cohort Cybernetica.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army, and one objective marker.
Cohort Cybernetica.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+ and the [IGNORES COVER] ability, but they can only target units within range of the selected objective marker.

Cohort Cybernetica.name: BENEVOLENCE OF THE OMNISSIAH
Cohort Cybernetica.flavor: A protective blessing chanted in pentakairic Novabyte moves machine spirits to defy the most esoteric of assaults.
Cohort Cybernetica.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
Cohort Cybernetica.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain  6+ ability, which is improved to Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Cohort Cybernetica.name: MACHINE SPIRIT RESURGENT
Cohort Cybernetica.flavor: To invigorate the failing machine spirit of a damaged vehicle is a sacred task, greatly aided by certain data-hymns transmitted in the correct sequence.
Cohort Cybernetica.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
Cohort Cybernetica.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

Cohort Cybernetica.name: MACHINE SUPERIORITY
Cohort Cybernetica.flavor: Let the unenlightened be cast down! Let all feel the fire of the Motive Force, and may the sacred engines crunch over their weak bones without impediment!
Cohort Cybernetica.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
Cohort Cybernetica.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

Cohort Cybernetica.name: MOTIVE IMPERATIVE
Cohort Cybernetica.flavor: Intensifying the locomotive protocols of a war engine - while not dishonouring its machine spirit - is a millennia-proven method to hasten the foe’s demise.
Cohort Cybernetica.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
Cohort Cybernetica.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

Cohort Cybernetica.name: TRANSCENDENT COGITATION
Cohort Cybernetica.flavor: Enhanced static chants can briefly raise a war engine's machine spirits to exultant heights of cogitation and multi-tactical capacity.
Cohort Cybernetica.target: One LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit from your army.
Cohort Cybernetica.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for your unit.

Data-Psalm Conclave.name: CHANT OF THE REMORSELESS FIST
Data-Psalm Conclave.flavor: In spitting out a staccato chant to the Motive Force, the faithful warriors of the Cult Mechanicus are filled with merciless surety as well as intent.
Data-Psalm Conclave.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Data-Psalm Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Data-Psalm Conclave.name: INCANTATION OF THE IRON SOUL
Data-Psalm Conclave.flavor: Raising their voices in binharic praise, the Machine God's disciples bolster their spirits - as well as those that inhabit their augmentations - with iron surety.
Data-Psalm Conclave.when: Any phase, just after you allocate a mortal wound to a CULT MECHANICUS model from your army.
Data-Psalm Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

Data-Psalm Conclave.name: LITANY OF THE ELECTROMANCER
Data-Psalm Conclave.flavor: Summoning the spark of the Machine God's divinity that burns within them, the Omnissiah’s faithful manifest blazing auras of energy that lay low the unbeliever.
Data-Psalm Conclave.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army.
Data-Psalm Conclave.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of one or more CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit, adding 1 to the result if that model is an ELECTRO-PRIEST. On a 5+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Data-Psalm Conclave.name: LUMINESCENT BLESSING
Data-Psalm Conclave.flavor: As the cohorts of the Omnissiah recite their dazzling consecration, energy is redirected to infuse masterwork bionics and even the lambent glow of protective fields ignites in a halo of divine defence.
Data-Psalm Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Data-Psalm Conclave.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Data-Psalm Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, CULT MECHANICUS models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Data-Psalm Conclave.name: TRIBUTE OF EMPHATIC VENERATION
Data-Psalm Conclave.flavor: A cacophonous chorale pours from the emitters and augmented throats of the Cult Mechanicus’ faithful, venerating the Omnissiah in deafening and disconcerting frequencies of praise.
Data-Psalm Conclave.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army and one enemy unit within 18" of it.
Data-Psalm Conclave.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Data-Psalm Conclave.name: VERSE OF VENGEANCE
Data-Psalm Conclave.flavor: Rousing code in binharic duometer incites fury for the lost fragments of technological lore. In the grip of vengeance, the devoted extend their remaining functions for one last act of retribution.
Data-Psalm Conclave.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Data-Psalm Conclave.target: One CULT MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Data-Psalm Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CULT MECHANICUS model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Electromartyrs.name: AUTO-VENGEANCE
Electromartyrs.flavor: Inbuilt subroutines fire synapses and muscular fibre bundles, allowing dying warriors to strike out and take their killers with them.
Electromartyrs.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Electromartyrs.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Electromartyrs.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Electromartyrs.name: BALLISTIC SYNCHRONY
Electromartyrs.flavor: Unified datachoristry sees the servants of the Omnissiah meld their firepower to perfection.
Electromartyrs.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Electromartyrs.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Electromartyrs.name: OMNI-TARGETERS
Electromartyrs.flavor: Predictive gunnery subroutines take over, allowing greater reactions and accuracy at close range than any flesh-and-blood soldier could manage.
Electromartyrs.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Electromartyrs.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability. If one or more of those weapons already have this ability, then until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with such a weapon that targets a unit within 6", add 1 to the Hit roll.

Electromartyrs.name: SAVIOUR SYSTEMS
Electromartyrs.flavor: Many warriors of the Adeptus Mechanicus have defensive measures suited to close-quarters battle built into their flesh-and-metal frames.
Electromartyrs.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army (excluding KATAPHRON units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Electromartyrs.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Eradication Cohort.name: ANALYTIC REPRISALS
Eradication Cohort.flavor: Rapid threat analysis triggers the Skitarii to return fire against foes deemed immediate threats, surprising the enemy and thinning their lines
Eradication Cohort.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Eradication Cohort.target: One Skitarii Infantry unit from your army that lost one or more models as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Eradication Cohort.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Eradication Cohort.name: PRECISION ONSLAUGHT
Eradication Cohort.flavor: Leading the charge like a keen bayonet locked to a rifle’s barrel, maniples of Sicarians scythe into the enemy amidst a welter of blood and severed limbs
Eradication Cohort.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Sicarian unit from your army declares a charge.
Eradication Cohort.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Eradication Cohort.name: SERVO‑DRIVEN CHARGE
Eradication Cohort.flavor: Sending reckless surges of motive force through their units, these warriors charge headlong into combat with punishing impact.
Eradication Cohort.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Eradication Cohort.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability.

Eradication Cohort.name: UNRELENTING AGGRESSION
Eradication Cohort.flavor: Even when retreating temporarily in the face of staunch resistance, the warriors of the Omnissiah keep up their storm of fire and violent blows.
Eradication Cohort.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.
Eradication Cohort.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the Skitarii keyword, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

Eradication Cohort.name: UNSHACKLED WRATH
Eradication Cohort.flavor: With Binharic prayers of disengagement, these warriors release the saviour protocols of their weapon spirits to release the guns’ full wrath.
Eradication Cohort.target: One Skitarii unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Eradication Cohort.effect: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase.

Explorator Maniple.name: AUTO-ORACULAR RETRIEVAL
Explorator Maniple.flavor: With a surge of targeting data from the war engine as its hatches slam open, the warriors inside pour out with weapons already trained unerringly on the foe.
Explorator Maniple.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
Explorator Maniple.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Acquisition objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Explorator Maniple.name: CACHED ACQUISITION
Explorator Maniple.flavor: Death is irrelevant compared to the hallowed duty of securing the Omnissiah's knowledge for future retrieval.
Explorator Maniple.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Explorator Maniple.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

Explorator Maniple.name: INCENSE EXHAUSTS
Explorator Maniple.flavor: The machine spirits of sanctified war engines can be entreated to release clouds of incense laced with radioactive particles, veiling the faithful from the foe.
Explorator Maniple.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Explorator Maniple.target:
One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit
from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKE unit within 6" of it.
Explorator Maniple.effect: Until the end of the phase, both of those units have the Stealth ability and the Benefit of Cover.

Explorator Maniple.name: INFOSLAVE SKULL
Explorator Maniple.flavor: Mono-task infoslave skulls range ahead to assess potential sites that must be investigated.
Explorator Maniple.target: One TECH-PRIEST model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of that model (excluding your Acquisition objective marker].
Explorator Maniple.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is also considered to be one of your Acquisition objective markers for all rules purposes.

Explorator Maniple.name: PRIORITY RECLAMATION
Explorator Maniple.flavor: Retrieval of the most sacred and ancient fragments of technology is embedded in loops of alpha-logic.
Explorator Maniple.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Consolidates.
Explorator Maniple.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within range of your Acquisition objective marker.
Explorator Maniple.restrictions: You cannot target a unit with this Stratagem if it is within 3" of one or more enemy units.

Explorator Maniple.name: REACTIVE SAFEGUARD
Explorator Maniple.flavor: Holy data must be hoarded at all costs, and thickly armoured war engines offer swift and secure vaults.
Explorator Maniple.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
Explorator Maniple.target:
One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY
unit from your army within range of your Acquisition objective marker that was selected as a target of that charge, and one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TRANSPORT.
Explorator Maniple.effect: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT.
Explorator Maniple.restrictions: Every model in your unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.

Haloscreed Battle Clade.name: AGGRESSIVE IMPULSE
Haloscreed Battle Clade.flavor: Urgent imperatives flood into the crew thralls of Skitarius transport units, urging them to deploy their cargo of cybernetic soldiers into the heart of the fight.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.target: One Skorpius Dunerider model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

Haloscreed Battle Clade.name: ANALYTICAL DIVINATION
Haloscreed Battle Clade.flavor: Tech-Priest commanders process an overwhelming influx of data screeds, analysing this information to read the flow of battle and coordinate the movements of their thralls.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.target: One Adeptus Mechanicus Infantry unit (excluding Kataphron units) from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit.

Haloscreed Battle Clade.name: ERADICATION PROTOCOLS
Haloscreed Battle Clade.flavor: Fresh imperatives flow down from on high. The orders are simple: eliminate the foe.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

Haloscreed Battle Clade.name: GUIDED RETREAT
Haloscreed Battle Clade.flavor: From their distant strategium pulpit, the Tech-Priest commander’s guiding hand descends, seizing control of allied minds, steering their troops carefully away from harm whilst maintaining a hail of killing fire.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army makes a Fall Back move.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for it.

Haloscreed Battle Clade.name: NEURAL OVERLOAD
Haloscreed Battle Clade.flavor: By projecting their consciousness into the minds of tech thralls, a Tech-Priest may significantly enhance their warriors’ lethality. However, doing so risks overloading their combat units’ more limited neural networks. Such hazards are seen as an opportunity to give one’s life in the name of the Omnissiah.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.effect: If your unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Select one Override ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active for your unit. Designer’s Note: This means that if the targeted unit already has the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it can be affected by multiple Override abilities at the same time, but suffers mortal wounds to do so. Alternatively, if your unit does not have the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it instead has the chosen Override ability until the start of your next Command phase, but does not benefit from any other Override abilities that are active.

Haloscreed Battle Clade.name: TARGETING OVERRIDE
Haloscreed Battle Clade.flavor: Experienced Tech-Priests rapidly analyse the foe’s weaknesses and feed the resultant data to their soldiers, who exploit these flaws to destroy their targets.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Haloscreed Battle Clade.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Lords of the Forge.name: HOLY AVARICE
Lords of the Forge.flavor: When a miracle of technology is identified, a Tech-Priest will go to bloody lengths to retrieve it, simultaneously directing the acquisition of their prize and the dismantling of anyone who threatens it.
Lords of the Forge.group: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS - Lords of the Forge
Lords of the Forge.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit starts an action.
Lords of the Forge.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Lords of the Forge.name: OVERLOADED SAFEGUARDS
Lords of the Forge.flavor: With a cascade of holy screed, implanted aggression protocols and biochemical triggers can be activated by a Tech-Priest to transmute a seeming rout into a predatory counterstrike.
Lords of the Forge.group: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS - Lords of the Forge
Lords of the Forge.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Lords of the Forge.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

Lords of the Forge.name: SCRIPTURAL PROGNOSIS
