Lords of the Forge.flavor: Analysing data from thousands of sources at once, a disciple of the Omnissiah is able to rationalise the enemy’s capabilities and dispense protocols of endurance to their servants.
Lords of the Forge.group: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS - Lords of the Forge
Lords of the Forge.when: In your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit that is within range of an objective.
Lords of the Forge.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Luminen Auto-choir.name: CHANT OF ELECTROTRACTION
Luminen Auto-choir.flavor: With every Binharic chant in praise of the Divine Current, Electro-Priests feel the surge of sacred power. The pulsing nimbus demands a holy circuit which can only be closed by making destructive contact with the foe.
Luminen Auto-choir.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ELECTRO-PRIESTS BATTLECLADE unit is selected to make an advance move.
Luminen Auto-choir.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Luminen Auto-choir.name: ECHOES OF THE CONDUIT WARS
Luminen Auto-choir.flavor: Punishing transgressors has a long and ritualised tradition amongst the unforgiving Electro-Priests, and they will eagerly prove their faith in coruscating violence.
Luminen Auto-choir.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit is selected to attack.
Luminen Auto-choir.effect:
Your unit’s attacks that target a unit within range of an objective can:
  • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Luminen Auto-choir.name: MOMENTUM FEEDBACK
Luminen Auto-choir.flavor: Harnessing the force of the blasphemous enemy’s attacks into energy to fuel a holy retaliatory surge is an act of righteous transmutation.
Luminen Auto-choir.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit has shot.
Luminen Auto-choir.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Machine Cult.name: ELECTROGHEIST VISITATIONS
Machine Cult.flavor: The faithful summon leaping electrogheists whose arcing energies interfere with enemy targeting and swat hostile projectiles from the air.
Machine Cult.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Machine Cult.target: One ELEcTRO-PRIESTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Machine Cult.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the attacking model is within 6” of your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Machine Cult.name: OMNISSIAH’S GUIDANCE
Machine Cult.flavor: By surrendering all control to the Omnissiah, the faithful are able to target their foes with near-omniscient accuracy.
Machine Cult.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Machine Cult.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore other models in their unit for the purposes of determining visibility.

Machine Cult.name: POWER OF THE MOTIVE FORCE
Machine Cult.flavor: Seized by overwhelming holy energies, these auto-fanatics hurl themselves into the fight with tendon-straining, inhuman haste.
Machine Cult.target: One ELEcTRO-PRIESTS unit from your army.
Machine Cult.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Machine Cult.name: TETHER-TENDRILS
Machine Cult.flavor: Weaponised mechadendrites burst from the rapturous faithful, ensnaring and electrocuting foes seeking to flee.
Machine Cult.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Machine Cult.target: One TEcH-PRIEST or ELEcTRO-PRIESTS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Machine Cult.effect: Until the end of the phase, when that enemy unit Falls Back, models in it must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

Rad-Zone Corps.name: AGGRESSOR IMPERATIVE
Rad-Zone Corps.flavor: The Skitarii feel the press of an invisible hand upon their minds as the Machine God drives them forward. Servos are pushed to their structural limits as fibre bundles fill with the boundless energy of the Motive Force and propel the faithful on an unstoppable crusade.
Rad-Zone Corps.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
Rad-Zone Corps.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

Rad-Zone Corps.name: BALEFUL HALO
Rad-Zone Corps.flavor: By briefly unshielding the most corrosive or irradiated components of their being, the warriors of a Rad-Zone Corps can exhale on isotopic fog, sapping the strength of those not inured to its effects.
Rad-Zone Corps.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rad-Zone Corps.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army (excluding Vehicle units) that was selected as the target of one or more of that enemy unit’s attacks. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
Rad-Zone Corps.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is made that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Rad-Zone Corps.name: BULWARK IMPERATIVE
Rad-Zone Corps.flavor: With a pulse of force-loaded wisdom, microactuators lock into bracing positions, reserve power cells are brought online and the Omnissiah's holy crusaders are bestowed with a sensation of sacred invulnerability.
Rad-Zone Corps.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rad-Zone Corps.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
Rad-Zone Corps.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in those units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Rad-Zone Corps.name: EXTINCTION ORDER
Rad-Zone Corps.flavor: As Tech-Priests order the purge of an area of the battlefield, rad-bombardments are redoubled in the hopes of turning it into a wasteland.
Rad-Zone Corps.target: One Tech-Priest model from your army and one objective marker within 24" of that model.
Rad-Zone Corps.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within range of that objective marker. On a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound and it must take a Battle-shock test.

Rad-Zone Corps.name: LETHAL DOSAGE
Rad-Zone Corps.flavor: Tri-fold sanctified power cells, fuel canisters and solid slugs have spent a decade in the most irradiated forge temple to certify their lethality.
Rad-Zone Corps.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Rad-Zone Corps.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Rad-Zone Corps.name: PRE-CALIBRATED PURGE SOLUTION
Rad-Zone Corps.flavor: Employing targeting data collated by a swarm of servo-skulls released over the enemy's battle lines, the Machine God’s faithful purge the foe stumbling amidst rad-scourged positions.
Rad-Zone Corps.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. If that unit is BATTLELINE, you can also target one friendly SKITARII unit (excluding BATTLELINE units) within 6" of it.
Rad-Zone Corps.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of those units makes a ranged attack, if the target of that attack is within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Response Clade.name: ACCESS OVERRIDES
Response Clade.flavor: The machine spirits of the vessel’s hatchways open willingly to permit these defenders to pass.
Response Clade.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Response Clade.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1" of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.
Response Clade.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.

Response Clade.name: INTEGRATIVE WITHDRAWAL
Response Clade.flavor: Employing their servo-symbiotic link to the machine spirits of their vessel, the Skitarii perform a fighting retreat aided by the systems of the ship itself.
Response Clade.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Response Clade.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. In addition, after your unit has shot this phase, if it is within 1" of an open Hatchway and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can close that Hatchway.

Response Clade.name: PRECOGNITATED FIREFIELDS
Response Clade.flavor: The Skitarii have datamapped every distance, angle and optimised fire field of their ship in advance, and can access this targeting intelligence at will.
Response Clade.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Response Clade.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If your unit has the BATTLELINE keyword, those weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.

Response Clade.name: RESPONSIVE SHIELDING
Response Clade.flavor: Key shipboard power nodes detect the proximity of Skitarii defenders and activate temporary energy shields to protect them.
Response Clade.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Response Clade.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Response Clade.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.name: BINHARIC OFFENCE
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.flavor: Employing directed binharic entanglement to coordinate their motions, paired squads of Skitarii attack with eerie and lethal synchronicity.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.target: Two SKITARII units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in both of your units by 1.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.restrictions: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target].

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.name: BIONIC ENDURANCE
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.flavor: Between their multi-layered bionics and their fanatical faith in the indomitability of these machine-blessings, the most augmented of Skitarii are nigh-impossible to lay low.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase orthe Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.target: One SICARIAN, PTERAXII or SYDONIAN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.name: EXPEDITED PURGE PROTOCOL
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.flavor: Binharic imperatives flash through neural architecture, driving augmetic muscle-bundles and auto-actuators into overdrive to propel the Skitarii more swiftly into the fray.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.target: One SKITARII unit from your army.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.name: ISOLATE AND DESTROY
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.flavor: The swiftest hunters seek to engage foes with the equations of war in their favour, isolating their quarry and dispatching it with ruthless efficiency.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.target:
One SICARIAN, PTERAXII, SYDONIAN,
IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other enemy units within 6" of the unit targeted by that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.name: PROGRAMMED WITHDRAWAL
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.flavor: Taking direct control of their cybernetic soldiers’ manoeuvres, the cohort’s commander sees their withdrawal carried out with such precision that they can be pressed back into service from the most efficacious of attack vectors.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.target: Up to two SICARIAN units from your army, or one SKITARII INFANTRY or SKITARII MOUNTED unit from your army.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.restrictions: Each unit targeted with this Stratagem must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.name: SHROUD PROTOCOLS
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.flavor: When Skitarii Hunter Cohorts march to war, they do so beneath a shrouding squall of cyber-static and filament-heavy banks of sacred incense.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.target: One SKITARII INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Skitarii Hunter Cohort.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

(none).name: Either player’s turn
(none).flavor: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have +1 AP.

(none).name: Your turn
(none).flavor: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One Skitarii Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

(none).name: Your turn
(none).flavor: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly T’AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS units) is selected to shoot. TARGET: That T’AU EMPIRE unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" of a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit have [LETHAL HITS].

(none).name: Your turn
(none).flavor: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit is selected to make an advance move. TARGET: That KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit. EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Armoured Warhost.name: LAYERED WARDS
Armoured Warhost.flavor: The wraithbone superstructure of this vehicle has been interlaced with warding runes, enabling its hull to resist incoming fire.
Armoured Warhost.when: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
Armoured Warhost.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Armoured Warhost.name: SOULSIGHT
Armoured Warhost.flavor: Spirit stones containing the souls of gifted seers have been embedded into this vehicle’s targeting matrices. The essences within lend guidance even in death.
Armoured Warhost.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot.
Armoured Warhost.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can re-roll:
  • One hit roll.
  • One wound roll.
  • One damage roll.

Armoured Warhost.name: VECTORED ENGINES
Armoured Warhost.flavor: The result of exquisite and ingenious Aeldari engineering, vectored engines enable grav vehicles to evade their enemies while maintaining accurate fire.
Armoured Warhost.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit makes a fall-back move.
Armoured Warhost.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Army Rules.name: FADE BACK
Army Rules.effect: One eligible unit from your army (excluding Titanic units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

Army Rules.name: FLITTING SHADOWS
Army Rules.effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at that unit.

Army Rules.name: OPPORTUNITY SEIZED
Army Rules.effect: One eligible unit from your army (excluding Titanic units) that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

Army Rules.name: STAR ENGINES
Army Rules.effect: Until the end of the turn, Ranged weapons equipped by this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

Army Rules.name: SUDDEN STRIKE
Army Rules.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Army Rules.name: SWIFT AS THE WIND
Army Rules.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

Aspect Host.name: DOOM INESCAPABLE
Aspect Host.flavor: Cast with the force of a thunderbolt, the Avatar's weapon strikes the foe with meteoric force.
Aspect Host.target: One Avatar of Khaine model from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Aspect Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Wailing Doom ranged weapon has a Range characteristic of 18" and a Damage characteristic of 8.

Aspect Host.name: KHAINE’S VENGEANCE
Aspect Host.flavor: Embodying the rage of Khaine himself, these warriors press home their attack and strike down those cowards who seek to flee their fury.
Aspect Host.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
Aspect Host.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Aspect Host.effect: All models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

Aspect Host.name: PRETERNATURAL PRECISION
Aspect Host.flavor: Analysing their targets' weaknesses with incredible skill, the Aeldari fire for lethal effect.
Aspect Host.target: One Aspect Warriors unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Aspect Host.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, select one of the following abilities, or select two of the following abilities if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem: [IGNORES COVER], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected abilities.

Aspect Host.name: SKYBORNE SANCTUARY
Aspect Host.flavor: The Aeldari excel in striking swiftly then leaping back into the safety of their skimming transports.
Aspect Host.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
Aspect Host.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6” of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Aspect Host.name: TO THEIR FINAL BREATH
Aspect Host.flavor: As champions and defenders of a dying race, these warriors fight furiously to the very end.
Aspect Host.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Aspect Host.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Aspect Host.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Aspect Host.name: WARRIOR FOCUS
Aspect Host.flavor: So absolute is the focus of these warriors in battle that nothing can distract them or stay their blows.
Aspect Host.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Aspect Host.target: One Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Aspect Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill, Weapon skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

Corsair Coterie.name: CLOAK AND SHADOW
Corsair Coterie.flavor: Having secured their prize, the Anhrathe melt into the shadows, leaving their foes shooting at shadows.
Corsair Coterie.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Corsair Coterie.target: One Aeldari Infantry unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker that you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Corsair Coterie.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability and your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Corsair Coterie.name: INTO THE BREACH
Corsair Coterie.flavor: Corsair raiders are swift to exploit gaps in the enemy line and advance upon their objectives.
Corsair Coterie.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Anhrathe unit from your army destroyed one or more enemy units.
Corsair Coterie.effect: After your unit has resolved all of its shooting attacks, it can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".

Corsair Coterie.name: LETHAL RUSE
Corsair Coterie.flavor: With a final flurry of gunshots, blade strikes and explosives, these warriors feign retreat before striking again with renewed aggression.
Corsair Coterie.when: Your Movement phase, just after an AELDARI unit from your army Falls Back.
Corsair Coterie.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If it is an Anhrathe unit, also select one enemy unit your unit was within Engagement Range of at the start of the phase, and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Corsair Coterie.name: OUTCAST AMBUSH
Corsair Coterie.flavor: Anhrathe raiders often find common ground with other Aeldari Outcasts, who use the distraction of the Corsair onslaught to ambush unsuspecting foes.
Corsair Coterie.target: One Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Corsair Coterie.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] and [RAPID FIRE 1] abilities, and until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

Corsair Coterie.name: PIRATES’ DUE
Corsair Coterie.flavor: In their pursuit of riches, Anhrathe warriors will fight with violent fury to seize their due.
Corsair Coterie.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Corsair Coterie.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit has the Anhrathe keyword, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Corsair Coterie.name: VENGEFUL SORROW
Corsair Coterie.flavor: Anhrathe share bonds forged in battle. The loss of an ally inspires sorrow and fury in equal measure.
Corsair Coterie.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Corsair Coterie.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army, if one or more models in that unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, and if that AELDARI unit is neither Battle-shocked nor within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Corsair Coterie.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

Devoted of Ynnead.name: DEATH ANSWERS DEATH
Devoted of Ynnead.flavor: As the foe slays their warriors, a terrible vigour grips the Ynnari and compels them to repay the slaughter in kind.
Devoted of Ynnead.when: End of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
Devoted of Ynnead.target: One Ynnari unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units), if one or more models in that unit were destroyed this phase.
Devoted of Ynnead.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase.

Devoted of Ynnead.name: EMISSARIES OF YNNEAD
Devoted of Ynnead.flavor: Immersed in murder and gripped by holy purpose, these warriors bring Ynnead’s fatal message and his final gift to all who face them.
Devoted of Ynnead.when: Fight phase, just after a Ynnari Infantry unit from your army has selected its targets.
Devoted of Ynnead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Devoted of Ynnead.name: MACABRE RESILIENCE
Devoted of Ynnead.flavor: Such is the conviction and power of the Ynnari that sometimes even mortal wounds cannot slow them.
Devoted of Ynnead.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Devoted of Ynnead.target: One Ynnari Infantry or Ynnari Mounted unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Devoted of Ynnead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Devoted of Ynnead.name: PALL OF DREAD
Devoted of Ynnead.flavor: Even after they fall, the most fervent Ynnari leave a sinister sense of watchfulness in their wake like some invisible death shroud.
Devoted of Ynnead.target: One Ynnari unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Devoted of Ynnead.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Devoted of Ynnead.name: PARTING THE VEIL
Devoted of Ynnead.flavor: In the moment of transcendent glory, before the Ynnari give their essence to their god, they fight harder than ever to take the foe with them to death.
Devoted of Ynnead.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Devoted of Ynnead.target: One Ynnari unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Devoted of Ynnead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Devoted of Ynnead.name: SOULSIGHT
Devoted of Ynnead.flavor: Perceiving the flickering soulstuff of their foes, the Ynnari strike with ruthless precision.
Devoted of Ynnead.target: One Ynnari unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Devoted of Ynnead.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

Eldritch Raiders.name: IMPEDING FIRE
Eldritch Raiders.flavor: As the foes attempt to close in, Yriel’s cunning outcasts stymie their assault with a dazzling burst of distracting fire.
Eldritch Raiders.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Eldritch Raiders.target: One Rangers, Shroud Runners or Starfang unit from your army.
Eldritch Raiders.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) visible to and within 36" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

Eldritch Raiders.name: NO PREY TOO BIG
Eldritch Raiders.flavor: By accurately targeting weak points in anatomies and superstructures, the Anhrathe can bring down even the most resilient of foes.
Eldritch Raiders.target: One Anhrathe, Rangers or Shroud Runners unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Eldritch Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Eldritch Raiders.name: RAIDERS’ SPOILS
Eldritch Raiders.flavor: Even as battle rages around them, the Eldritch Raiders prioritise the seizing of treasures above the destruction of their foes.
Eldritch Raiders.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Eldritch Raiders.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

Eldritch Raiders.name: RUTHLESS KILLERS
Eldritch Raiders.flavor: These are Yriel’s chosen killers, and there is no escape for their prey.
Eldritch Raiders.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Eldritch Raiders.target: One Corsair Voidscarred unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or Fight this phase.
Eldritch Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Eldritch Raiders.name: WITHDRAW AND REINFORCE
Eldritch Raiders.flavor: Prince Yriel commands resources beyond the dreams of most Corsair Princes. Depleted bands may fall back from the battlefield to be reinforced and resupplied at a moment’s notice.
Eldritch Raiders.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Eldritch Raiders.target: One Anhrathe unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Eldritch Raiders.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If that unit is below Starting Strength, return all destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.

Eldritch Raiders.name: YRIEL’S EXAMPLE
Eldritch Raiders.flavor: Inspired by their prince, who has felt Ynnead’s touch, the Eldritch Raiders laugh in the face of death.
Eldritch Raiders.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Eldritch Raiders.target: One Aeldari Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Eldritch Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Fateful Performance.name: DECEPTIVE FEINT
Fateful Performance.flavor: Advancing foes assured of cutting the Harlequins down are often left thwarted with naught but a swirl of holofield shards where their prey once stood.
Fateful Performance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.
Fateful Performance.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Fateful Performance.name: EXIT THE STAGE
Fateful Performance.flavor: Players know when to fade back from the stage of war, ready to strike again when their moment comes.
Fateful Performance.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Fateful Performance.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves

Fateful Performance.name: HEROES’ FALL
Fateful Performance.flavor: Though they may be slain, this step of the saedath calls on the players to act out the demise of tragic heroes who take their enemies with them to death.
Fateful Performance.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HARLEQUINS unit.
Fateful Performance.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Ghosts of the Webway.name: BLOODY DANCE
Ghosts of the Webway.flavor: Enemies goaded into following the steps of the saedath come unwittingly on cue to their executions.
Ghosts of the Webway.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Ghosts of the Webway.target: One Harlequins Infantry or Harlequins Mounted unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Ghosts of the Webway.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
Ghosts of the Webway.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Ghosts of the Webway.name: EXIT THE STAGE
Ghosts of the Webway.flavor: Players know when to fade back from the stage of war, ready to strike again when their moment comes.
Ghosts of the Webway.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Ghosts of the Webway.target: One Harlequins unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Ghosts of the Webway.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Ghosts of the Webway.name: HEROES’ FALL
Ghosts of the Webway.flavor: Though they may be slain, this step of the saedath calls on the players to act out the demise of tragic heroes who take their enemies with them to death.
Ghosts of the Webway.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ghosts of the Webway.target: One Harlequins unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ghosts of the Webway.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Ghosts of the Webway.name: MOCKING FLIGHT
Ghosts of the Webway.flavor: The Harlequins tumble away in mock terror and panic before spinning back into the fight with cruel laughter and redoubled fury.
Ghosts of the Webway.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Harlequins unit from your army Falls Back.
Ghosts of the Webway.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Ghosts of the Webway.name: STAGED DEATH
Ghosts of the Webway.flavor: A feigned death and sudden, shocking return are as impactful as dismaying to the foe.
Ghosts of the Webway.target: One Harlequins Character model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Ghosts of the Webway.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
Ghosts of the Webway.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.

Ghosts of the Webway.name: TRICKSTERS’ RETORT
Ghosts of the Webway.flavor: To the Harlequins, the foe are simply unwitting dance partners, their every move matched with graceful aplomb.
Ghosts of the Webway.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Ghosts of the Webway.target: One Troupe unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Ghosts of the Webway.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Guardian Battlehost.name: BLADES OF ASURYAN
Guardian Battlehost.flavor: Asuryani martial teachings enable those wielding ranged weapons to employ them as close-quarter implements of death as well.
Guardian Battlehost.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Guardian Battlehost.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

Guardian Battlehost.name: COST OF VICTORY
Guardian Battlehost.flavor: In so desperate and vital a fight, the Aeldari must accept casualties they would normally avoid and even send fresh warriors in to bolster the flagging ranks if it means victory.
Guardian Battlehost.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Guardian Battlehost.target: One Guardians unit from your army.
Guardian Battlehost.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. When doing so, return every destroyed GUARDIANS model to your unit.

Guardian Battlehost.name: SHIELD NODES
Guardian Battlehost.flavor: Exploiting a spar of old Aeldari technology, these warriors engage the flickering ghosts of ancient defensive force fields.
Guardian Battlehost.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Guardian Battlehost.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Guardian Battlehost.effect: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Guardian Battlehost.name: TIME TO STRIKE
Guardian Battlehost.flavor: Storm Guardians train to recognise where and when their selfless aggression can best benefit their craftworld and never to miss such opportunities.
Guardian Battlehost.target: One Storm Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Guardian Battlehost.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Guardian Battlehost.name: VAUL’S VENGEANCE
Guardian Battlehost.flavor: Swift and terrible vengeance comes for those who dare strike down the warriors of the Aeldari in the form of searing heavy weapons fire.
Guardian Battlehost.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army.
Guardian Battlehost.target: One War Walkers unit from your army.
Guardian Battlehost.effect: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
Guardian Battlehost.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Guardian Battlehost.name: WARDING SALVOES
Guardian Battlehost.flavor: Woe betide the foe that seeks to claim the holdings of armed and determined Asuryani.
Guardian Battlehost.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Guardian Battlehost.target: One Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Guardian Battlehost.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Khaine’s Arrow.name: BLADEFOCUS
Khaine’s Arrow.flavor: Those Aspect Warriors best versed in close-quarters combat fight all the harder, knowing they must act as the piercing tip of their host's strike.
Khaine’s Arrow.target: One HOwLING BANSHEES or STRIKING ScORPIONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Khaine’s Arrow.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if it made a Charge move this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Khaine’s Arrow.name: CRITICAL CAPTURE
Khaine’s Arrow.flavor: These warriors know precisely which strategic sites must be secured, and in what order.
Khaine’s Arrow.target: One AELDARI unit from your army (excluding CHARAcTER units).
Khaine’s Arrow.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, at the end of your turn, select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

Khaine’s Arrow.name: FOCUSED FUSILLADE
Khaine’s Arrow.flavor: The fiery passage of Khaine's Arrow scours the enemy away, leaving them nowhere to hide.
Khaine’s Arrow.target: One DIRE AvENGERS, FIRE DRAGONS, SwOOPING HAwKS or WARP SPIDERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Khaine’s Arrow.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Khaine’s Arrow.name: VOID GHOSTS
Khaine’s Arrow.flavor: Exploiting the fluctuating gravity of voidship fighting and flowing with the nigh-imperceptible movements of the vessel around them, the Aeldari acrobatically evade the blasts and blades of their foes.
Khaine’s Arrow.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Khaine’s Arrow.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Khaine’s Arrow.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Path of the Outcast.name: CASTING BACK THE VEIL
Path of the Outcast.flavor: Once these snipers have found their range to a shrouded foe with marksmen’s instincts and esoteric targeting technology, they swiftly pass this knowledge onto their allies.
Path of the Outcast.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
Path of the Outcast.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

Path of the Outcast.name: ELDRITCH SUPPRESSION
Path of the Outcast.flavor: Struck by a sudden volley of precision shots when no foe can be pinpointed can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.
Path of the Outcast.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
Path of the Outcast.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll if a model in that enemy unit was destroyed by those attacks.

Path of the Outcast.name: NOMADS OF THE HIDDEN WAY
Path of the Outcast.flavor: The unconstrained nomadism of a craftworld’s outcasts extends to the battlefield, such that few foes can respond before they melt back into hiding to hunt elsewhere.
Path of the Outcast.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
Path of the Outcast.effect:
• Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

Protector Host.name: RAPID AMBUSH
Protector Host.flavor: Reacting with a speed most mortal beings could not dream of, the Aeldari engulf emerging foes in a sudden hail of gunfire.
Protector Host.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit opens a Hatchway.
Protector Host.target: One DIRE AvENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase and is wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from that enemy unit.
Protector Host.effect: If that enemy unit is within 9" of and visible to your unit, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. If that enemy unit suffers one or more mortal wounds in this way, your unit can then make a Normal move of up to D6”.
Protector Host.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot fire Overwatch.

Protector Host.name: SHIELD OF BLADES
Protector Host.flavor: A discipline refined for shipboard battle, this feat of marksmanship sees the Aeldari overlap annihilating hails of defensive fire.
Protector Host.when: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase.
Protector Host.target: One DIRE AvENGERS or GUARDIAN DEfENDERS unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
Protector Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

Protector Host.name: SHURIKEN STORM
Protector Host.flavor: Shuriken weaponry fill corridors and chambers with inescapable hails of monomolecular discs and reduce enemy boarding parties to bloodied ruin.
Protector Host.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Protector Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of Avenger shuriken catapults, shuriken catapults, shuriken pistols and shuriken cannons equipped by models in your unit.

Protector Host.name: VOID GHOSTS
Protector Host.flavor: Exploiting the fluctuating gravity of voidship fighting and flowing with the nigh-imperceptible movements of the vessel around them, the Aeldari acrobatically evade the blasts and blades of their foes.
Protector Host.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Protector Host.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Protector Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Seer Council.name: FATE INESCAPABLE
Seer Council.flavor: The Aeldari have already seen how best to lay low this enemy and strike in the sure knowledge the foe cannot evade their terrible fate.
Seer Council.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is within 9" of one or more friendly Asuryani Psyker models.
Seer Council.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Seer Council.name: FOREWARNED
Seer Council.flavor: Having foreseen already how this fight will play out, the seer projects their insights and warnings into the minds of the Aeldari who must fight it.
Seer Council.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Seer Council.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly Asuryani Psyker models.
Seer Council.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Seer Council.name: ISHA’S FURY
Seer Council.flavor: Leaping from the seer’s outstretched hand, this blast of empyric energy is a raw expression of the sorrow and bitterness suffered by the Aeldari people.
Seer Council.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Seer Council.target: One Asuryani Psyker model from your army within 9" of that enemy unit.
Seer Council.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Seer Council.name: PRESENTIMENT OF DREAD
Seer Council.flavor: The seer plucks fate to find the foe suffering a horrible death, then projects it into their minds.
Seer Council.target: One Asuryani Psyker model from your army.
Seer Council.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to your model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

Seer Council.name: PSYCHIC SHIELD
Seer Council.flavor: A twist of the seer's psychic powers raises a whirling shield of empyric energy and psychokinetic debris to screen the Aeldari from enemy fire.
Seer Council.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Seer Council.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly Asuryani Psyker models.
Seer Council.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Seer Council.name: UNSHROUDED TRUTH
Seer Council.flavor: Dispelling the psychosomatic mirage that has so far beguiled and assailed the foe, the seer reveals the true location of the warriors it was masquerading as.
Seer Council.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that has not been selected to move this phase, was not set up on the battlefield this phase, and is within 9" of one or more friendly Asuryani Psyker models.
Seer Council.effect:
• Place your unit in strategic reserves.
  • Your unit has Deep Strike.
  • Your unit must make an ingress move this phase.
Seer Council.restrictions: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to be selected to move.

Serpent’s Brood.name: FANGS OF THE BROOD
Serpent’s Brood.flavor: Many are the heads of the brood, and many their fangs. As they spring and tumble over their foes, the Harlequins’ weapons echo the multiplicity of strikes unleashed by that mythic nest of snakes.
Serpent’s Brood.target: One Troupe unit from your army.
Serpent’s Brood.effect: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit’s Dance of Death ability, you can select three of the abilities for your unit to gain, instead of one.

Serpent’s Brood.name: SKYWARD LUNGE
Serpent’s Brood.flavor: Like a serpent rearing back to strike at its prey anew, the Harlequins sweep high and appear to quit the field, ready to descend in fury a moment later.
Serpent’s Brood.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Serpent’s Brood.target: One Harlequins Vehicle or Harlequins Mounted unit from your army.
Serpent’s Brood.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Serpent’s Brood.name: STRIKING STRIDE
Serpent’s Brood.flavor: Springing between pillars and rubble, bounding forwards as though running on thin air, the Harlequins acrobatically hurl themselves into battle.
Serpent’s Brood.target: One Harlequins unit from your army.
Serpent’s Brood.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Serpent’s Brood.name: VENOMOUS WRATH
Serpent’s Brood.flavor: Embodying the serpent that strikes with blinding swiftness, this grav-skimmer lunges suddenly into range and unleashes its full fury on the foe.
Serpent’s Brood.target: One Harlequins Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Serpent’s Brood.effect: After your unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Serpent’s Brood.name: WEAVERS’ COILS
Serpent’s Brood.flavor: Inescapable yet impossible to catch, this unit personifies the ever-winding and incorporeal coils of the Skyweavers of myth.
Serpent’s Brood.target: One Harlequins Mounted unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
Serpent’s Brood.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".

Serpent’s Brood.name: WEAVING STRIDE
Serpent’s Brood.flavor: Maintaining their blistering pace, these warriors respond to their foes’ steps in the saedath with their own gravity-defying motions.
Serpent’s Brood.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Serpent’s Brood.target: One Harlequins Infantry unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Serpent’s Brood.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Spirit Conclave.name: BLADES FROM BEYOND
Spirit Conclave.flavor: Sometimes, the twinned perceptions of ghost warriors allow them to perceive - and strike at - the souls of their foes.
Spirit Conclave.target: One Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Spirit Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Spirit Conclave.name: CRUSHING STRIDES
Spirit Conclave.flavor: Elegant they may be, but the weight and implacable strength of wraith constructs on the charge can smash enemies to the ground bloody and broken.
Spirit Conclave.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Wraithblades, Wraithlord or Wraithknight unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Spirit Conclave.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each WRAITHBLADES model in your unit, or roll four D6 if your unit has the WRAITHLORD keyword, or roll six D6 if your unit has the WRAITHKNIGHT keyword: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Spirit Conclave.name: SEER’S EYE
Spirit Conclave.flavor: Seeing their prey as much through the eyes of their guiding seer as with any sense of their own, the wraith constructs strike swift and true.
Spirit Conclave.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Spirit Conclave.target: One Aeldari Psyker model from your army and one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of it that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Spirit Conclave.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your PSYKER model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Armour Penetration and/or Damage characteristics of that attack.

Spirit Conclave.name: SOUL BRIDGE
Spirit Conclave.flavor: It is risky for a Spiritseer to cast their awareness so far, but aiding the dead is sometimes necessary.
Spirit Conclave.target: One Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit from your army and one Asuryani Psyker model from your army.
Spirit Conclave.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit is considered to be within 12" of your PSYKER model for the purposes of the Psychic Guidance and Spirit Guides abilities.

Spirit Conclave.name: SPIRIT TOKEN
Spirit Conclave.flavor: By leaving psycho-resonant wraithbone markers upon the battlefield, these warriors wreathe vital strategic locations in an aura of dread not easily overcome.
Spirit Conclave.target: One Wraithblades or Wraithguard unit from your army.
Spirit Conclave.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Spirit Conclave.name: WRAITHBONE ARMOUR
Spirit Conclave.flavor: The apparent fragility of wraith constructs’ lithe bodies be/ies their incredible resilience.
Spirit Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Spirit Conclave.target: One Wraith Construct unit from your army (excluding TiTANic units] that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Spirit Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Star-dancer Masque.name: ACROBATIC LEAPS
Star-dancer Masque.flavor: Reacting with a speed most mortal beings could not dream of, the Aeldari engulf emerging foes in a sudden hail of gunfire.
Star-dancer Masque.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Star-dancer Masque.effect: Until the end of the phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed, and each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there.

Star-dancer Masque.name: DARTING STRIKES
Star-dancer Masque.flavor: Shuriken weaponry fill corridors and chambers with inescapable hails of monomolecular discs and reduce enemy boarding parties to bloodied ruin.
Star-dancer Masque.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Star-dancer Masque.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Star-dancer Masque.name: SERPENT STRIKE
Star-dancer Masque.flavor: A discipline refined for shipboard battle, this feat of marksmanship sees the Aeldari overlap annihilating hails of defensive fire.
Star-dancer Masque.when: Fight phase, just after an AELDARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Star-dancer Masque.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3" and, if it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units that are visible to it (and in Unit Coherency), it can still make that Consolidation move, and when doing so can move in any direction.

Star-dancer Masque.name: VOID GHOSTS
Star-dancer Masque.flavor: Exploiting the fluctuating gravity of voidship fighting and flowing with the nigh-imperceptible movements of the vessel around them, the Aeldari acrobatically evade the blasts and blades of their foes.
Star-dancer Masque.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Star-dancer Masque.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Star-dancer Masque.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Twilight Flickers.name: CAPTIVATING PERFORMANCE
Twilight Flickers.flavor: With the placement of sentinel nodes and a performance that echoes their guardianship of things lost to other Aeldari, the Harlequins guard well that which is sacred to them.
Twilight Flickers.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

Twilight Flickers.name: PHANTASMAL MIRAGE
Twilight Flickers.flavor: The mirage launchers carried by a masque’s graceful craft can be triggered to produce haunting simulacra long enough to deceive the foe and allow a crew to manoeuvre away again to their next stage.
Twilight Flickers.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit has shot.
Twilight Flickers.effect:
• Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Twilight Flickers.name: PRESAGED REHEARSAL
Twilight Flickers.flavor: Amongst the performances of a saedath is the climactic sundering of monstrous foes or the enemy’s hateful barques, acts the Harlequins have long mastered.
Twilight Flickers.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TROUPE unit is selected to fight.

Warhost.name: BLITZING FIREPOWER
Warhost.flavor: When unleashed in a close-ranged storm, Aeldari weapons fire can completely eradicate all life within the target zone.
Warhost.target: One Asuryani unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Warhost.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 12". If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Warhost.name: FEIGNED RETREAT
Warhost.flavor: What appears to be a full retreat one moment is revealed as the deceptive prelude to a devastating attack the next.
Warhost.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Asuryani unit from your army Falls Back.
Warhost.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Warhost.name: FIRE AND FADE
Warhost.flavor: The Aeldari are masters of hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before swiftly ducking back out of harm's way.
Warhost.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Asuryani Infantry unit from your army (excluding Aircraft, Asurmen and Wraith Construct units) has shot.
Warhost.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".
Warhost.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a Transport.

Warhost.name: LIGHTNING-FAST REACTIONS
Warhost.flavor: Processing events at incredible speed, these warriors easily evade attacks that would have slain any less celeritous combatants.
Warhost.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Warhost.target: One Asuryani unit from your army (excluding Wraith Construct units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Warhost.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Warhost.name: SKYBORNE SANCTUARY
Warhost.flavor: The Aeldari excel in striking swiftly, then leaping back into the safety of their skimming transports.
Warhost.target: One unengaged ASURYANI unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
Warhost.effect: If your ASURYANI unit is wholly within 6” of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Warhost.name: WEBWAY TUNNEL
Warhost.flavor: By slipping away into the ethereal confines of the Webway, Aeldari warriors can circumnavigate the foe and strike from new and unexpected quarters.
Warhost.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Warhost.target: One Asuryani Infantry unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
Warhost.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Windrider Host.name: DARING RIDERS
Windrider Host.flavor: Some of the Windrider Hosts are especially aggressive, unable to restrain the fierce joy of racing perilously close to the foe while strafing them with fire.
Windrider Host.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Windrider Host.target: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army in Reserves.
Windrider Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield from Reserves, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units. When doing so, if your unit is set up within 8" horizontally of one or more enemy units, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

Windrider Host.name: DEATH FROM ON HIGH
Windrider Host.flavor: Streaking suddenly down from on high, the Aeldari strike like the fall of an executioner's blade.
Windrider Host.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Windrider Host.target: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that was set upon the battlefield from Reserves this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Windrider Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Windrider Host.name: FOCUSED FIREPOWER
Windrider Host.flavor: Able to analyse and assess target data at incredible speeds, these Aeldari isolate the foe's weak spot and pour all their fire into it as they hurtle past.
Windrider Host.target: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Windrider Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Windrider Host.name: OVERFLIGHT
Windrider Host.flavor: These airborne warriors arc up and away from the ruin of their foes, already seeking fresh prey.
Windrider Host.when: End of your Shooting phase or the end of the Fight phase.
Windrider Host.target: One Asuryani Mounted unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
Windrider Host.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 7".

Windrider Host.name: SPIRALLING EVASION
Windrider Host.flavor: None but the Aeldari could risk such breakneck and seemingly suicidal evasive manoeuvres to jink around incoming enemy fire.
Windrider Host.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Windrider Host.target: One Asuryani Mounted or VYPER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Windrider Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Windrider Host.name: WIND OF BLADES
Windrider Host.flavor: Warriors such as these cannot be pinned down or held back. They hit and run at will, hammering the foe with constant fire and slashing blows.
Windrider Host.target: One Asuryani Mounted or Vyper unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Windrider Host.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Wraiths of the Void.name: D-STRIKE
Wraiths of the Void.flavor: Recognising the importance of liminal boundaries in void warfare, the ghost warriors unleash their fury upon such a space to the shock of their foes.
Wraiths of the Void.target: One WRAITH CONSTRUcT unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Wraiths of the Void.effect: Select one closed Hatchway that is visible to and within range of one or more of the ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, until the start of your next Shooting phase, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Wraiths of the Void.restrictions: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to shoot.

Wraiths of the Void.name: GUARDIAN CONSTRUCTS
Wraiths of the Void.flavor: Like graven sentinels the wraith constructs stand immovable, barring the enemy's path.
Wraiths of the Void.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Wraiths of the Void.target: One WRAITH CONSTRUcT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Wraiths of the Void.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the attacking model is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Wraiths of the Void.name: UNFLINCHING FIRE
Wraiths of the Void.flavor: None can match the calm, patient precision of those who have already known death and do not fear it.
Wraiths of the Void.when: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase.
Wraiths of the Void.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
Wraiths of the Void.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

Wraiths of the Void.name: WRAITHSIGHT
Wraiths of the Void.flavor: There are advantages to perceiving the foe as glimmering souls without the obstruction of intervening walls and bulkheads.
Wraiths of the Void.target: One AELDARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Wraiths of the Void.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or to the Hit roll.

Abhuman Auxiliaries.name: LOW PROFILE
Abhuman Auxiliaries.flavor: Ratling snipers carefully scout out the most advantageous vantage points from which to unleash their kill shots, positions in which their eerie stillness and diminutive silhouette are hard to spot.
Abhuman Auxiliaries.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RATLINGS unit has shot.
Abhuman Auxiliaries.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

Abhuman Auxiliaries.name: STIRRED TO ACTION
Abhuman Auxiliaries.flavor: An enemy who manages to pierce the Ogryns’ dense forms often succeeds only in attracting their attention and becoming the objects of a sudden and trampling rush.
Abhuman Auxiliaries.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit has shot.
Abhuman Auxiliaries.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Abhuman Auxiliaries.name: THICK-SKULLED OBDURANCE
Abhuman Auxiliaries.flavor: With an order to hold the line, Ogryn auxilia will devotedly – and stubbornly – endure the most extreme firepower to see their duty done.
Abhuman Auxiliaries.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit that is within range of an objective.
Abhuman Auxiliaries.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Armoured Infantry.name: BURST OF SPEED
Armoured Infantry.flavor: Pushing bodies or engines to the limit, these warriors continue their swift advance.
Armoured Infantry.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.
Armoured Infantry.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Armoured Infantry.name: COMBINED FIRE
Armoured Infantry.flavor: Hammering the enemy, this transport’s crew share targeting solutions with nearby allies, allowing for concentrated combined fire to obliterate the foe’s infantry and even erode armour plating.
Armoured Infantry.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army has shot.
Armoured Infantry.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.

Armoured Infantry.name: MOBILE FIREBASE
Armoured Infantry.flavor: Armoured fighting vehicles and transports keep pace with the infantry, supporting the advance as mobile gun platforms
Armoured Infantry.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
Armoured Infantry.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Armoured Infantry.name: OPENING SALVO
Armoured Infantry.flavor: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.
Armoured Infantry.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Armoured Infantry.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Armoured Infantry.name: ORDER THE ADVANCE
Armoured Infantry.flavor: At a barked order, armour and infantry surge forward as one, utilising speed and aggression to close with objectives and the enemy.
Armoured Infantry.target: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
Armoured Infantry.effect: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.

Armoured Infantry.name: SUPPORTING ORDNANCE
Armoured Infantry.flavor: This vehicle’s heavy weapons support lightly equipped infantry, suppressing enemy armour and bringing down lumbering monsters.
Armoured Infantry.target: One Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Armoured Infantry.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Bridgehead Strike.name: FIRING HOT
Bridgehead Strike.flavor: At the risk of permanently burning out power packs, hot-shot weaponry can be temporarily overcharged to provide additional punch at the crucial moment.
Bridgehead Strike.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit is selected to shoot.
Bridgehead Strike.effect: Your unit’s Hot-shot Lascarbines, Hot-shot Lasguns, Hot-shot Laspistols, Hot-shot Marksman Rifles, Hot-shot Volley Guns and Sentry Hot-shot Volley Guns weapons that targeted an enemy unit within 12" have +1 S and AP.

Bridgehead Strike.name: ON MY POSITION
Bridgehead Strike.flavor: Circling Aeronautica Imperialis strike fighters wait above to launch strafing runs should the attack falter. In extremis, these assets can be called down upon Imperial positions in danger of being overrun, affording soldiers the desperate dignity of taking their enemies with them into death.
Bridgehead Strike.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Bridgehead Strike.effect:
Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit:
  • On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.

Bridgehead Strike.name: SERVO‑DESIGNATORS
Bridgehead Strike.flavor: Released in a swarm from a modified Valkyrie gunship, high-altitude servo-skulls analyse targeting data from the ongoing fight and then provide updated firing solutions to the troops on the ground.
Bridgehead Strike.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit has shot.
Bridgehead Strike.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

Combined Arms.name: COORDINATED ACTION
Combined Arms.flavor: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.
Combined Arms.target: One Regiment unit from your army and one Squadron unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
Combined Arms.effect: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.

Combined Arms.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
Combined Arms.flavor: Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.
Combined Arms.target: One Regiment unit and one Squadron unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
Combined Arms.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Combined Arms.name: FLEXIBLE COMMAND
Combined Arms.flavor: Some Astra Militarum officers have served with infantry and armour, and are equally adept at commanding either.
Combined Arms.target: Any number of Astra Militarum Officer units from your army.
Combined Arms.effect: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to Regiment units and Squadron units.

Combined Arms.name: INSPIRED COMMAND
Combined Arms.flavor: The greatest officers make their voices heard at the critical moment, their orders swift and decisive.
Combined Arms.target: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.
Combined Arms.effect: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.

Combined Arms.name: REINFORCEMENTS!
Combined Arms.flavor: So numerous are the infantry of the Astra Militarum that fresh reserves can be called up at a moment’s notice.
Combined Arms.target: One Infantry Regiment unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Combined Arms.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
Combined Arms.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

Combined Arms.name: STALWART PROTECTOR
Combined Arms.flavor: The indefatigable tanks of the Astra Militarum serve as mobile cover for the troops marching in their shadow.
Combined Arms.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Combined Arms.target: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army.
Combined Arms.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Designation Force.name: CLOSE-RANGE DETECTION
Designation Force.flavor: With a daring reconnaissance dangerously close to the hiding enemy, soldiers can provide more accurate reports of their location.
Designation Force.target: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
Designation Force.effect: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.

Designation Force.name: SUMP-SMOG SCREEN
Designation Force.flavor: Named for the density and reek of their concealing smoke, varied packs of foul chemicals are carried by elite scouts that can be ignited to foul the enemy’s aim.
Designation Force.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase
Designation Force.target: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.
Designation Force.effect: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

Designation Force.name: TRIGGERED ALERTS
Designation Force.flavor: Alerted by proximity snares set up by recon teams, readied soldiers can evade their prowling foes to prepare new firing lines.
Designation Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
Designation Force.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3"

Embarked Regiment.name: AGAINST THE ODDS
