Renegade Raiders.name: REAVERS’ HASTE
Renegade Raiders.flavor: The prospect of riches spurs these renegade warriors forwards. Woe betide any in their path.
Renegade Raiders.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.
Renegade Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it  Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.

Renegade Raiders.name: RUINOUS RAID
Renegade Raiders.flavor: Utilising their swift transports, these ravagers plunge through the enemy lines to assault key positions.
Renegade Raiders.when: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase
Renegade Raiders.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Renegade Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a  model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Renegade Raiders.name: SCOUR AND SEIZE
Renegade Raiders.flavor: If the bounty is to be claimed, the foe must first be purged.
Renegade Raiders.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Renegade Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

Renegade Raiders.name: UNFAILINGLY OBDURATE
Renegade Raiders.flavor: Such is their determination to claim their due that these warriors will gladly weather a storm of fire.
Renegade Raiders.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Renegade Raiders.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Renegade Raiders.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Renegade Raiders.name: WARPCHARGED ENGINES
Renegade Raiders.flavor: The engines of this vehicle or construct crackle with the raw energies of the immaterium, propelling it forward or incredible speed.
Renegade Raiders.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Renegade Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit  Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Renegade Warband.name: CORRUPTED MUNITIONS
Renegade Warband.flavor: Without traditional methods of resupply and rearmament, Renegades must plunder or barter for their ammunition. Whether seized from the holds of captive vessels or acquired from daemonic arms dealers or xenos black marketeers, these munitions are horrifically effective.
Renegade Warband.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
Renegade Warband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.

Renegade Warband.name: NEVER OUTGUNNED
Renegade Warband.flavor: Centuries of combined combat experience enable these Renegade killers to eliminate any target, bringing down resilient foes by targeting weak points or reducing hordes of enemy infantry to bloody mist with rapid volleys.
Renegade Warband.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Renegade Warband.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.
Renegade Warband.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

Renegade Warband.name: REAVERS’ REACTION
Renegade Warband.flavor: Reacting to incoming fire, traitorous infantry adjust their battle plan without breaking stride, moving to take cover or closing in upon their assailants with vengeance in mind.
Renegade Warband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Renegade Warband.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
Renegade Warband.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Renegade Warband.name: RENEGADE CLAIM
Renegade Warband.flavor: Renegades do not relinquish their prizes easily.
Renegade Warband.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
Renegade Warband.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Renegade Warband.name: UNDYING HATRED
Renegade Warband.flavor: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.
Renegade Warband.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Renegade Warband.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Renegade Warband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Renegade Warband.name: VENGEFUL DESTRUCTION
Renegade Warband.flavor: Hatred is a powerful motivator. Those who cross Renegade Space Marines rarely live long enough to regret their actions.
Renegade Warband.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Renegade Warband.target: One Heretic Astartes Infantry (excluding Damned units) or Heretic Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Renegade Warband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Soulforged Warpack.name: DAEMONIC POSSESSION
Soulforged Warpack.flavor: Those steeped in techno-sorcery may trammel daemonic entities within mechanical constructs.
Soulforged Warpack.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding Daemon units).
Soulforged Warpack.effect: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.

Soulforged Warpack.name: DESPERATE PLEDGE
Soulforged Warpack.flavor: A daemon construct may beseech the Arkifane for further aid, adding to its soul debt in return for greater might.
Soulforged Warpack.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Soulforged Warpack.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Soulforged Warpack.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Soulforged Warpack.name: FEEDING FRENZY
Soulforged Warpack.flavor: The daemonic entities at the heart of possessed vehicles hunger for the life force of their enemies.
Soulforged Warpack.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
Soulforged Warpack.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Soulforged Warpack.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of your units Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, of that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, substract 1 from each of those tests.

Soulforged Warpack.name: GLUT OF SOULS
Soulforged Warpack.flavor: Wrh each soul harvested the bound daemon comes closer to settling its contract and earning freedom.
Soulforged Warpack.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding Titanic units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Soulforged Warpack.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wound).

Soulforged Warpack.name: PREDATORY PURSUIT
Soulforged Warpack.flavor: Corrupted Heretic Astartes Vehicles Pursue their prey with an animalistic determination.
Soulforged Warpack.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall back move.
Soulforged Warpack.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Soulforged Warpack.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.

Soulforged Warpack.name: UNSTOPPABLE RAMPAGE
Soulforged Warpack.flavor: The tortured machine spirits of Heretic Astartes vehicles are driven forward by their anguish.
Soulforged Warpack.when: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.
Soulforged Warpack.target: One Heretic Astartes Vehicle or Vashtorr the Arkifane unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Soulforged Warpack.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes Normal, Advance or charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

Underdeck Uprising.name: CRUDE SABOTAGE
Underdeck Uprising.flavor: Using charged rigged from scavenged junk and pollutant runoff, the fanatical masses blast open the hatchways that bar their paths to ascension.
Underdeck Uprising.target: One CULTIST MOB or DAMNED CHARAcTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Underdeck Uprising.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1“ of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.
Underdeck Uprising.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.

Underdeck Uprising.name: FLEETING MIGHT
Underdeck Uprising.flavor: For one tantalising instant, the dark prayers of these fanatics are answered by some infernal warp patron, placing the power to slay champions in their hands.
Underdeck Uprising.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DAMNED unit from your army makes a Dark Pact.
Underdeck Uprising.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Underdeck Uprising.name: INFERNAL ALTARS
Underdeck Uprising.flavor: Whether heretical fanes unveiled amidst the rebellion or heaped corpses and votive offerings, these ritual foci lend the faithful supernatural protection.
Underdeck Uprising.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Underdeck Uprising.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Underdeck Uprising.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if your unit is within range of an objective marker, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against that attack. If your unit has the CULTIST MOB keyword, models in it have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack instead.

Underdeck Uprising.name: STORM THE BRIDGE!
Underdeck Uprising.flavor: Seizing their opportunity to strike a fatal blow against those who have oppressed them for so long - and please the Dark Gods in the process - these heretics surge forwards with zealous ferocity.
Underdeck Uprising.target: One DAMNED or CHAOS SPAwN unit from your army.
Underdeck Uprising.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Veterans of the Long War.name: BLACK CRUSADE
Veterans of the Long War.flavor: The Warmaster s Black Crusade grinds ever onwards without restraint or remorse.
Veterans of the Long War.group: CHAOS SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Long War
Veterans of the Long War.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army  (excluding DAMNED units).
Veterans of the Long War.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is  eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced  or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have  the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.

Veterans of the Long War.name: BRINGERS OF DESPAIR
Veterans of the Long War.flavor: Fearful of countenance, these ancient warriors are redolent with warp power and radiate a horrifying aura of might.
Veterans of the Long War.group: CHAOS SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Long War
Veterans of the Long War.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
Veterans of the Long War.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

Veterans of the Long War.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
Veterans of the Long War.flavor: Such embittered warriors as these shrug off hails of enemy fire with arrogant disdain.
Veterans of the Long War.group: CHAOS SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Long War
Veterans of the Long War.when: Your opponents Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Veterans of the Long War.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Veterans of the Long War.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Veterans of the Long War.name: ENDLESS IRE
Veterans of the Long War.flavor: No amount of bloodshed can truly satisfy this bitter champion's desire for vengeance.
Veterans of the Long War.group: CHAOS SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Long War
Veterans of the Long War.when: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.
Veterans of the Long War.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from  your army (excluding DAMNED units)
Veterans of the Long War.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.

Veterans of the Long War.name: LET THE GALAXY BURN
Veterans of the Long War.flavor: No barricade or fortification is proof against the vengeful fury of these hate-fuelled murderers.
Veterans of the Long War.group: CHAOS SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Long War
Veterans of the Long War.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase
Veterans of the Long War.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.

Veterans of the Long War.name: MILLENNIA OF EXPERIENCE
Veterans of the Long War.flavor: Thousands of years of ceaseless conflict have forged these warriors into skilled and merciless killers.
Veterans of the Long War.group: CHAOS SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Long War
Veterans of the Long War.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Veterans of the Long War.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding  DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Veterans of the Long War.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Warpstrike Champions.name: ARMOUR OF CORRUPTION
Warpstrike Champions.flavor: Drawn to the largest and toughest warriors by their inherent sense of might and superiority, overspilling warp energies make their conceit a resilient reality.
Warpstrike Champions.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Warpstrike Champions.target: One Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Warpstrike Champions.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Warpstrike Champions.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.

Warpstrike Champions.name: EMPYRIC DISLOCATION
Warpstrike Champions.flavor: These warriors have not quite escaped the grip of the Warp, remaining slightly incorporeal in a way that causes enemy fire to pass harmlessly through them.
Warpstrike Champions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Warpstrike Champions.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding Damned units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Warpstrike Champions.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Warpstrike Champions.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.

Warpstrike Champions.name: PORTAL OF SPITE
Warpstrike Champions.flavor: The warp rift through which these warriors reach the battlefield has been directed toward chosen prey by a vengeful daemonic entity.
Warpstrike Champions.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
Warpstrike Champions.effect: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

Warpstrike Champions.name: SIEGEBREAKER STRIKE
Warpstrike Champions.flavor: These warriors have drilled relentlessly in the art of laying down murderous fire against dug-in foes the moment they teleport into battle.
Warpstrike Champions.target: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.
Warpstrike Champions.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Warpstrike Champions.name: WARP FLICKER
Warpstrike Champions.flavor: Momentary flares of empyric energy wreathe this unit, causing them to stutter through time and space more swiftly.
Warpstrike Champions.target: One Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army.
Warpstrike Champions.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Warpstrike Champions.name: WARP-TAINTED
Warpstrike Champions.flavor: Immaterial energies still cling to these warriors like tattered shrouds, leaving sites of significance tainted by their touch and haunted by insubstantial spectres.
Warpstrike Champions.target: One Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators or Mutilators unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.
Warpstrike Champions.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Arch-Contaminators.name: ALLIES OF ENTROPY
Arch-Contaminators.flavor: The foul vitality that flows through these warriors is slow to depart, even in extremis.
Arch-Contaminators.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Arch-Contaminators.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Arch-Contaminators.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Arch-Contaminators.name: CLOUD OF FLIES
Arch-Contaminators.flavor: Plague flies engulf these warriors in a storm of buzzing wings and pustulent bodies, soaking up incoming enemy fire and obscuring the Death Guard elite from the foe.
Arch-Contaminators.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Arch-Contaminators.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Arch-Contaminators.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Arch-Contaminators.name: CORROSIVE CURSE
Arch-Contaminators.flavor: Mere proximity to these repulsive plague champions is enough to see vital systems rust and crumble as the taint of Chaos consumes them.
Arch-Contaminators.target: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Arch-Contaminators.effect: Select one objective marker within Contagion Range of and visible to your unit. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
Arch-Contaminators.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once and, until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

Arch-Contaminators.name: SEED OF CORRUPTION
Arch-Contaminators.flavor: Like infectious spores contaminating their victim, the warriors of the Death Guard teleport into battle then dig in as their foulness slowly spreads around them.
Arch-Contaminators.target: One DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Arch-Contaminators.effect: If your unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, it can perform a Tactical Manoeuvre this phase as if it was not set up on the battlefield this turn.

Champions of Contagion.name: BLESSINGS OF FILTH
Champions of Contagion.flavor: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.
Champions of Contagion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Champions of Contagion.target: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Champions of Contagion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Champions of Contagion.name: DEATH’S HEADS
Champions of Contagion.flavor: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.
Champions of Contagion.target: One Biologus Putrifier unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Champions of Contagion.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).

Champions of Contagion.name: GROTESQUE FORTITUDE
Champions of Contagion.flavor: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.
Champions of Contagion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Champions of Contagion.target: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Champions of Contagion.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

Champions of Contagion.name: MALIGNANCE MAGNIFIED
Champions of Contagion.flavor: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.
Champions of Contagion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Champions of Contagion.target: One Death Guard Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Champions of Contagion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Champions of Contagion.name: MOBILE VECTOR
Champions of Contagion.flavor: Nurgle's champions move through the Death Guard ranks like squirming parasites.
Champions of Contagion.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
Champions of Contagion.target: One Death Guard Character unit from your army that is not leading a unit.
Champions of Contagion.effect: Select one other friendly Death Guard unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.

Champions of Contagion.name: RABID INFUSION
Champions of Contagion.flavor: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.
Champions of Contagion.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that includes two Character models.
Champions of Contagion.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

Contagion Engines.name: BLOODRUST DELUGE
Contagion Engines.flavor: Warp‑tainted saturation oozes through this aggressive vehicle, leeching into its weapons, which spit the infection into foes at a distance.
Contagion Engines.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot.
Contagion Engines.effect: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.

Contagion Engines.name: FRESH VECTORS
Contagion Engines.flavor: As if drawn to flesh and matter yet to be blessed by corruption, infected weapons unerringly find their mark.
Contagion Engines.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack.
Contagion Engines.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Contagion Engines.name: SOULROT FLUX
Contagion Engines.flavor: As courage crumbles in the face of mechanised abhorrence, then does the bloom of soulrot find purchase to spread its cyclic infection.
Contagion Engines.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.
Contagion Engines.effect:
When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, roll one D6:
  • On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
  • On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
  • On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

Death Lord’s Chosen.name: BLOOMING PESTILENCE
Death Lord’s Chosen.flavor: Death Guard warriors know to chant the sevenfold prayers to unleash Nurgle's bounty on the foe.
Death Lord’s Chosen.target: One Terminator unit from your army.
Death Lord’s Chosen.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models in your unit.

Death Lord’s Chosen.name: GRIM REAPERS
Death Lord’s Chosen.flavor: Swollen with bitter arrogance, these warriors carve a path through their perceived lessers and leave them as worm food.
Death Lord’s Chosen.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Death Lord’s Chosen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Death Lord’s Chosen.name: MORTARION'S TEACHINGS
Death Lord’s Chosen.flavor: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.
Death Lord’s Chosen.target: One Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Death Lord’s Chosen.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.

Death Lord’s Chosen.name: SICKENING IMPACT
Death Lord’s Chosen.flavor: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.
Death Lord’s Chosen.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Death Lord’s Chosen.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Death Lord’s Chosen.name: SIGNAL POX
Death Lord’s Chosen.flavor: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.
Death Lord’s Chosen.target: One Lord of Virulence model from your army.
Death Lord’s Chosen.effect: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.

Death Lord’s Chosen.name: UNDYING SPITE
Death Lord’s Chosen.flavor: Driven by bitterness and the putrid vitality of Nurgle's gifts, these warriors fight on for several moments, even after death.
Death Lord’s Chosen.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Death Lord’s Chosen.target: One Terminator unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Death Lord’s Chosen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Flyblown Host.name: DRONING HORROR
Flyblown Host.flavor: Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.
Flyblown Host.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.
Flyblown Host.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • That target a unit within half range, can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Flyblown Host.name: EYE OF THE SWARM
Flyblown Host.flavor: The vermin swarms intensify as the Death Guard close in upon the enemy. As their foes clutch and tear their crawling skin, pitiless Plague Marines unleash volleys of point‑blank fire into their tormented foes.
Flyblown Host.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.

Flyblown Host.name: NAUSEATING PAROXYSMS
Flyblown Host.flavor: The contagion borne by the Death Guard and their attendant swarms of winged vermin triggers bouts of sickness and convulsion in those they encounter.
Flyblown Host.target: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.
Flyblown Host.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Mortarion’s Hammer.name: BLIGHTED LAND
Mortarion’s Hammer.flavor: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.
Mortarion’s Hammer.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
Mortarion’s Hammer.effect: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.

Mortarion’s Hammer.name: DRAWN TO DESPAIR
Mortarion’s Hammer.flavor: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.
Mortarion’s Hammer.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Mortarion’s Hammer.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Mortarion’s Hammer.name: EYESTINGER STORM
Mortarion’s Hammer.flavor: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.
Mortarion’s Hammer.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
Mortarion’s Hammer.effect: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Mortarion’s Hammer.name: FONT OF FILTH
Mortarion’s Hammer.flavor: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.
Mortarion’s Hammer.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Mortarion’s Hammer.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

Mortarion’s Hammer.name: RELENTLESS GRIND
Mortarion’s Hammer.flavor: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.
Mortarion’s Hammer.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Mortarion’s Hammer.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Mortarion’s Hammer.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Mortarion’s Hammer.name: STINKING MIRE
Mortarion’s Hammer.flavor: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.
Mortarion’s Hammer.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Mortarion’s Hammer.target: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.
Mortarion’s Hammer.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as the target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

Paragons of Putrescence.name: AGGRAVUS SPASMS
Paragons of Putrescence.flavor: There is no hiding from contagion, and particular pathogens can incite neurological paroxysms that force their victims to give away their positions in painful throes.
Paragons of Putrescence.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
Paragons of Putrescence.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

Paragons of Putrescence.name: SIMULTANEOUS CONTAMINATION
Paragons of Putrescence.flavor: The worst infections spread both visibly and subtly. Thus do the Death Guard’s champions attack, ordering vile operations, the two vectors more deadly than either alone.
Paragons of Putrescence.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starts an action.
Paragons of Putrescence.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Paragons of Putrescence.name: TERRITORIAL INFECTION
Paragons of Putrescence.flavor: The intensive contagions that flow in abundance from this champion taint everything around them, making taking ground from them a repulsive prospect for the enemy.
Paragons of Putrescence.target: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.
Paragons of Putrescence.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

Shamblerot Vectorium.name: GNAWING HUNGER
Shamblerot Vectorium.flavor: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.
Shamblerot Vectorium.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army.
Shamblerot Vectorium.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Shamblerot Vectorium.name: GRIP OF THE WALKING POX
Shamblerot Vectorium.flavor: Those infected by walking pox may fall as though fatally wounded, but they soon rise again.
Shamblerot Vectorium.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shamblerot Vectorium.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Shamblerot Vectorium.effect: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.

Shamblerot Vectorium.name: HIDDEN AMONGST THE DEAD
Shamblerot Vectorium.flavor: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.
Shamblerot Vectorium.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Shamblerot Vectorium.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.
Shamblerot Vectorium.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

Shamblerot Vectorium.name: SHAMBLING WALL
Shamblerot Vectorium.flavor: Lacking even basic self-preservation instincts, Poxwalkers make excellent walking shields.
Shamblerot Vectorium.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shamblerot Vectorium.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly Poxwalkers unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
Shamblerot Vectorium.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.

Shamblerot Vectorium.name: SHOCK AND HORROR
Shamblerot Vectorium.flavor: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.
Shamblerot Vectorium.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Death Guard unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Shamblerot Vectorium.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

Shamblerot Vectorium.name: SMEARED WITH FILTH
Shamblerot Vectorium.flavor: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.
Shamblerot Vectorium.target: One Poxwalkers unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Shamblerot Vectorium.effect: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

Tallyband Summoners.name: ALL IS ROT
Tallyband Summoners.flavor: Death Guard warriors open fire into foes already embattled by Nurgle’s daemons, knowing that no matter who they hit, all will wither and rot.
Tallyband Summoners.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Tallyband Summoners.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

Tallyband Summoners.name: AVATARS OF DECAY
Tallyband Summoners.flavor: Countless diseases blossom in the unreal flesh of Nurgle's daemon childer, manifestations of his blessings to be spread to all.
Tallyband Summoners.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army.
Tallyband Summoners.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

Tallyband Summoners.name: CLUTCHING CORRUPTION
Tallyband Summoners.flavor: The daemons of Nurgle grasp their victims tightly with rotting talons and coiling tentacles, their clutch as inescapable as entropy itself.
Tallyband Summoners.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Tallyband Summoners.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more Plague Legions units from your army, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Tallyband Summoners.name: FLESHY AVALANCHE
Tallyband Summoners.flavor: The ephemeral structures of realspace have no power to halt the onset of Nurgle's Great Unclean Ones; they crumble, rot and burst apart before their unholy bulk.
Tallyband Summoners.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Tallyband Summoners.target: One Plague Legions Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Tallyband Summoners.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Tallyband Summoners.name: MIRESLICK
Tallyband Summoners.flavor: Beneath the tread of Nurgle’s daemons, even ferrocrete or plasteel soon turns to a quagmire of rotting matter, in which their unlucky enemies begin to sink and become trapped.
Tallyband Summoners.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
Tallyband Summoners.target: One Plague Legions unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Tallyband Summoners.effect: Until the end of the phase, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, each time that unit is selected to Fall Back, it must take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

Tallyband Summoners.name: PERSISTENT PESTS
Tallyband Summoners.flavor: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.
Tallyband Summoners.target: One Nurglings unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Tallyband Summoners.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.
Tallyband Summoners.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

Unclean Uprising.name: PATH OF PESTILENCE
Unclean Uprising.flavor: Long have lurking cultists planned the uprising and prepared the route for their plague-blessed masters to process to victory.
Unclean Uprising.target: One DEATH GUARD CULTISTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Unclean Uprising.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1” of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.
Unclean Uprising.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.

Unclean Uprising.name: POX FLARE
Unclean Uprising.flavor: Like fever heat bursting into unclean flame, the diseases infesting these Poxwalkers flare with sudden infectious vitality.
Unclean Uprising.target: One POXwALKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Unclean Uprising.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Unclean Uprising.name: SHAMBLING ONSLAUGHT
Unclean Uprising.flavor: Relentless, untiring, the plague-rotted hordes press forward in a tide of grasping hands, stinking bodies and gnashing, splintered teeth.
Unclean Uprising.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Unclean Uprising.target: One POXwALKERS unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Unclean Uprising.effect: After that enemy unit ends that Fall Back move, if your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, your unit can make a Normal move.

Unclean Uprising.name: THE DEAD RISE
Unclean Uprising.flavor: What appeared moments before to be a mere carrion heap suddenly lurches into foul and grinning unlife.
Unclean Uprising.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
Unclean Uprising.target: One POXwALKERS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
Unclean Uprising.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Deep Strike ability.
Unclean Uprising.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Vectors of Decay.name: CHINKS IN THE ARMOUR
Vectors of Decay.flavor: Even the slightest weakness is enough for the foulness of the Death Guard to find a way in.
Vectors of Decay.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Vectors of Decay.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Vectors of Decay.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within Contagion Range of one or more units from your army, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

Vectors of Decay.name: GROTESQUE DEMISE
Vectors of Decay.flavor: Many of the plague weapons and revolting diseases unleashed by the Death Guard inflict endings so hideous that the mere sight of them is enough to send unharmed enemies fleeing in horror.
Vectors of Decay.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXwALKERS units) has shot or fought.
Vectors of Decay.effect: Select one enemy unit that had one or more models destroyed as a result of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Vectors of Decay.name: INFESTATION
Vectors of Decay.flavor: The taint left by the servants of Nurgle is not easily scoured from the stuff of realspace.
Vectors of Decay.when: Start or end of any turn, when an enemy unit attempts to Seize an objective marker you have Secured.
Vectors of Decay.target: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXwALKERS units) within Contagion Range of that objective marker.
Vectors of Decay.effect: Roll one D6: on a 5+, until the end of your next turn, that objective marker remains Secured by your army and you are considered to control it, regardless of how many enemy models are within range of it.
Vectors of Decay.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Vectors of Decay.name: SEEPING CORROSION
Vectors of Decay.flavor: Crawling tendrils of foulness spread through the voidship at the touch of the Death Guard, poisoning and rotting luckless foes.
Vectors of Decay.when: Your Movement phase, when a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding CULTISTS and POXwALKERS units) attempts to open a Hatchway.
Vectors of Decay.effect: Select one enemy unit within 1" of your unit and on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit, and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds. Until the end of the phase, if an enemy unit attempts to prevent that Hatchway from being opened, when rolling off, you can re-roll your result.

Virulent Vectorium.name: CREEPING BLIGHT
Virulent Vectorium.flavor: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.
Virulent Vectorium.target: One Death Guard Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Virulent Vectorium.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Virulent Vectorium.name: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
Virulent Vectorium.flavor: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.
Virulent Vectorium.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Virulent Vectorium.target: One Death Guard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Virulent Vectorium.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Virulent Vectorium.name: LEECHSPORE ERUPTION
Virulent Vectorium.flavor: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.
Virulent Vectorium.target: One Death Guard model your army that has lost one or more wounds.
Virulent Vectorium.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).

Virulent Vectorium.name: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
Virulent Vectorium.flavor: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.
Virulent Vectorium.target: One Death Guard Character unit from your army.
Virulent Vectorium.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

Virulent Vectorium.name: PLAGUESURGE
Virulent Vectorium.flavor: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.
Virulent Vectorium.target: Your Death Guard WARLORD that is on the battlefield.
Virulent Vectorium.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.

Virulent Vectorium.name: PUTRID DETONATION
Virulent Vectorium.flavor: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.
Virulent Vectorium.target: One Death Guard Vehicle or Death Guard Monster model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Virulent Vectorium.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

Covenite Coterie.name: CONNOISSEURS OF PAIN
Covenite Coterie.flavor: These epicureans of extreme sensation revel in their agonies as much as those of the foe.
Covenite Coterie.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Covenite Coterie.target: One Drukhari unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Covenite Coterie.effect: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a Haemonculus Covens unit, you gain 1 Pain token.

Covenite Coterie.name: DISTILLERS OF FEAR
Covenite Coterie.flavor: By arcane syringe and unholy invocation, the enemy's terror is syphoned out of their bodies, leaving them as little more than contorted husks.
Covenite Coterie.target: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Covenite Coterie.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Battle-shocked, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Covenite Coterie.name: ENFOLDING NIGHTMARE
Covenite Coterie.flavor: Even as the prey seek to drive the covenites back with hails of firepower, the horrors lurch closer.
Covenite Coterie.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Covenite Coterie.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Covenite Coterie.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Covenite Coterie.name: POISONER’S ART
Covenite Coterie.flavor: The venoms wielded by these warriors are potent enough to impress Shaimesh himself.
Covenite Coterie.when: Fight phase, just after a Haemonculus Covens unit from your army has fought.
Covenite Coterie.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Covenite Coterie.name: POSTMORTALITY
Covenite Coterie.flavor: To the greatest Haemonculi, death is but an intriguing and temporary state to be experienced.
Covenite Coterie.target: One HAEMONCULUS model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Covenite Coterie.effect: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent. RESTRICTION: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.

Covenite Coterie.name: SYMPHONY OF SUFFERING
Covenite Coterie.flavor: So extreme are the foe's agonies that they spread a shock wave of terror through their comrades.
Covenite Coterie.when: Fight phase, just after a Drukhari unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Covenite Coterie.effect: Each enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a Haemonculus Covens unit.

Exhibition of Slaughter.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
Exhibition of Slaughter.flavor: Moving so quickly they seem to blur, the Wyches evade incoming fire with contemptuous elegance.
Exhibition of Slaughter.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WYCH CULT unit.

Exhibition of Slaughter.name: PLANNED STRIKES
Exhibition of Slaughter.flavor: Murderous rehearsals ensure that those who survive can bring down the most resilient of prey in puissant displays.
Exhibition of Slaughter.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to fight.
Exhibition of Slaughter.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Exhibition of Slaughter.name: SCULPTING THE STAGE
Exhibition of Slaughter.flavor: Gauche are the gladiators who kill too relentlessly. Preparing the stage with a variety of torments in order to build the tension for a delightful crescendo is the mark of a true artist.
Exhibition of Slaughter.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
Exhibition of Slaughter.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

Kabalite Agonysts.name: KILLERS FROM THE DARK SPIRES
Kabalite Agonysts.flavor: Defensive barriers or camouflage are little protection against those who have honed their talents hunting amongst the twisted and dark spires of their kabal’s territory.
Kabalite Agonysts.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KABALITE WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.
Kabalite Agonysts.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Kabalite Agonysts.name: PRIORITISED VICTIM
Kabalite Agonysts.flavor: Contracts to annihilate, maim or capture singular victims of rarefied value are eagerly competed for by a kabal’s killers.
Kabalite Agonysts.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit targets a CHARACTER unit.
Kabalite Agonysts.effect:
Your unit’s attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can:
  • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Kabalite Agonysts.name: SHADOWS’ REACH
Kabalite Agonysts.flavor: The capability of militant kabals to project their killing power is rightfully feared, as is the fact that the perpetrators can usually never be found.
Kabalite Agonysts.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit has shot.
Kabalite Agonysts.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

Kabalite Cartel.name: DEADLY DECEIVERS
Kabalite Cartel.flavor: A life lived amidst the shadowed spires of Commorragh teaches many ways to creep up on your enemies, unseen and unsuspected.
Kabalite Cartel.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Kabalite Cartel.target: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Kabalite Cartel.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Kabalite Cartel.name: DOUBLE-CROSS
Kabalite Cartel.flavor: What better way to eliminate rivals than tricking them into taking the blade meant for your ribs?
Kabalite Cartel.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Kabalite Cartel.target: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly Drukhari unit (excluding Vehicles).
Kabalite Cartel.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit, if your DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacking model, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead, your DRUKHARI unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Kabalite Cartel.name: ENEMIES WITHOUT NUMBER
Kabalite Cartel.flavor: This Archon’s personal kill list of rivals, nemeses and victims is virtually never-ending.
Kabalite Cartel.when: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.
Kabalite Cartel.effect: Select one new Contract (this can be one you have already completed), then select one unit from your opponent’s army that is on the battlefield and matches the ‘Contract’ description in that Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and the Murderous Agenda Detachment rule applies as normal.

Kabalite Cartel.name: MAKING A POINT
Kabalite Cartel.flavor: Whether seeking to impress a watching Archon, show up rivals or revel in their supremacy, these marksmen fire for spiteful effect.
Kabalite Cartel.target: One Kabalite Warriors or Hand of the Archon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Kabalite Cartel.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Kabalite Cartel.name: TAILORED TOXINS
Kabalite Cartel.flavor: Specially prepared for their chosen prey, these malignant poisons are the anathema of their targets.
Kabalite Cartel.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Kabalite Cartel.target: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Kabalite Cartel.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Kabalite Cartel.name: TAKEN ALIVE
Kabalite Cartel.flavor: Borne away screaming into the shadows, everyone knows these unfortunates face a dreadful fate.
Kabalite Cartel.target: One Drukhari unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Kabalite Cartel.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result of those attacks, every unit in your opponent’s army must take a Battle-shock test. You cannot gain more than 3 Pain tokens as a result of failed Battle-shock tests caused by this Stratagem.

Kabalite Corsairs.name: DECKPLATE SWEEPERS
Kabalite Corsairs.flavor: Indiscriminate hails of splinter fire fill chambers and corridors, leaving nowhere to hide in the enclosed space.
Kabalite Corsairs.target: One KABAL unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Kabalite Corsairs.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of splinter cannons, splinter rifles and splinter pistols equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Kabalite Corsairs.name: ELUSIVE DUELLISTS
Kabalite Corsairs.flavor: These warriors delight in the close-quarters blade-duels of boarding actions, weaving around their enemies' blows and cutting them down in droves.
Kabalite Corsairs.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Kabalite Corsairs.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Kabalite Corsairs.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if your unit has the INcUBI keyword, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Kabalite Corsairs.name: OPPORTUNISTIC THIEVES
Kabalite Corsairs.flavor: Any undefended source of riches or power is fair game to these fast-moving raiders.
Kabalite Corsairs.target: One KABAL unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Kabalite Corsairs.effect: Select one objective marker you do not control that is visible to your unit. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", but if it does, every model in that unit must end that move as close as possible to that objective marker.

Kabalite Corsairs.name: TAKE THEM ALIVE
Kabalite Corsairs.flavor: Aiming to maim rather than slag, and employing psychotropic or paralysing venoms, the Kabalites seek to incapacitate their victims so that they too may be taken as plunder.
Kabalite Corsairs.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABAL unit from your army has shot.
Kabalite Corsairs.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase (excluding those made with Pistols). That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result if your unit is within 6” of it.

Painbringers.name: HORRIFYING FORM
Painbringers.flavor: The hulking monsters of the Haemonculus Covens are terrifying indeed, cowing enemy warriors with their grotesque and intimidating forms.
Painbringers.when: End of any phase, when an objective marker Secured by your army would be Seized by an enemy unit.
Painbringers.target: One HAEMONcULUS COvENS unit from your army within range of that objective marker.
Painbringers.effect: Until the end of your next turn, while you have one or more DRUKHARI units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units), that objective marker remains Secured by your army and cannot be Seized by enemy units.
Painbringers.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Painbringers.name: MOULDED MUSCULATURE
Painbringers.flavor: The muscular fleshcraft monstrosities fielded by the Haemonculi can punch through hatchways and bulkheads to reach their cowering victims.
Painbringers.target: One HAEMONcULUS COvENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Painbringers.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models by 1, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.

Painbringers.name: TERRIFYING AURA
Painbringers.flavor: The disturbing nature of these creatures causes weapons to quiver, even in the hands of veteran soldiers.
Painbringers.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Painbringers.target: One HAEMONcULUS COvENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 6" of the attacking unit.
Painbringers.effect: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 if it is within 3" of your unit: if failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.

Painbringers.name: UNFEELING ABOMINATIONS
Painbringers.flavor: The creations of the Haemonculi are capable of enduring terrible wounds and continuing to fight.
Painbringers.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Painbringers.target: One HAEMONcULUS COvENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Painbringers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit has the GROTESqUES keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Painbringers.restrictions: If your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword, until the end of the phase, it loses the Mindless Killing Machines ability.

Realspace Raiders.name: DARK HARVEST
Realspace Raiders.flavor: Wicked sickles and serrated blades hack through writhing flesh as the Drukhari harvest agony and suffering.
Realspace Raiders.target: Up to two Wracks units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
Realspace Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Realspace Raiders.name: EAGER FOR THE KILL
Realspace Raiders.flavor: The exhilarating promise of bloodshed goads these warriors into battle with preternatural haste.
Realspace Raiders.target: Up to two Wyches units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army, that have not been selected to move this phase.
Realspace Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit (this is not cumulative with the Reavers’ Matchless Swiftness ability).

Realspace Raiders.name: FIGHTING SHADOWS
Realspace Raiders.flavor: Even attempting to strike the Drukhari is like trying to lay a blade to smoke, so sly and swift are they.
Realspace Raiders.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Realspace Raiders.target: One Drukhari unit from your army (excluding Haemonculus Covens units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Realspace Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Realspace Raiders.name: INSENSIBLE TO PAIN
Realspace Raiders.flavor: The twisted creations of the haemonculus covens are uncaring of all but the most mortal injuries.
Realspace Raiders.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Realspace Raiders.target: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Realspace Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Realspace Raiders.name: INSTINCTIVE SPITE
Realspace Raiders.flavor: It is hardwired into the Drukhari psyche to prey upon weakened and suffering victims.
Realspace Raiders.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Realspace Raiders.target: Up to two Drukhari Battleline units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
Realspace Raiders.effect: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Realspace Raiders.name: RAID AND FADE
Realspace Raiders.flavor: The Drukhari are masters at using hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before quickly manoeuvring into cover or out of sight.
Realspace Raiders.target: Up to two Kabalite Warriors units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army (excluding ScouRGES and Aircraft).
Realspace Raiders.effect: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Realspace Raiders.restrictions: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.

Reaper’s Wager.name: DANCE MACABRE
Reaper’s Wager.flavor: The saedath’s victims become unwitting partners in a frantic dance of ghastly slaughter.
Reaper’s Wager.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Reaper’s Wager.target: One Drukhari Infantry or Harlequins Infantry unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Reaper’s Wager.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is currently losing the wager, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.

Reaper’s Wager.name: FATEFUL ROLE
Reaper’s Wager.flavor: These warriors are so absorbed by their desire to win the wager that they risk death to land their killing blows.
Reaper’s Wager.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Reaper’s Wager.target: One Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Reaper’s Wager.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is losing the wager: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Reaper’s Wager.name: MALICIOUS FRENZY
Reaper’s Wager.flavor: Jealous competition descends into frenzied carnage as the kill count climbs higher and the intoxicating screams of the dying fill the air.
Reaper’s Wager.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Reaper’s Wager.target: One Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Reaper’s Wager.effect: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

Reaper’s Wager.name: MURDERER’S CIRCUS
Reaper’s Wager.flavor: In bounding leaps and graceful pirouettes, the cavalcade of capricious killers bounds through hails of fire, cackling gleefully as they come.
Reaper’s Wager.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Reaper’s Wager.target: One Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Reaper’s Wager.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Reaper’s Wager.name: SCINTILLATING TEMPO
Reaper’s Wager.flavor: Commorrite or Harlequin, these lithe combatants move with stunning speed, darting in and out of firing lines before their foes can raise their weapons.
Reaper’s Wager.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, just after a Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
Reaper’s Wager.effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at your unit.

Reaper’s Wager.name: SHORTEN THE ODDS
Reaper’s Wager.flavor: Having selected their victims, these killers strive to complete the kill with speed and brutality whilst moving ever closer to winning their macabre wager.
Reaper’s Wager.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army has Advanced.
Reaper’s Wager.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Ship-killer Cult.name: HYPERAGILITY
Ship-killer Cult.flavor: Driven by combat drugs and the elation of their victims'fear and pain, the Wyches weave around their enemies' blades with easy scorn.
Ship-killer Cult.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ship-killer Cult.target: One WYcH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ship-killer Cult.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Ship-killer Cult.name: NO OBSTACLE
Ship-killer Cult.flavor: Scenting their prey's fear sweat, tracking their fluttering heartbeats, the Wyches beardown unerringly on their victims through corridors and chambers.
Ship-killer Cult.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that opened a Hatchway this turn.
Ship-killer Cult.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can declare a charge that includes one or more targets that are not visible to it, provided each of those units that are not visible to it are wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit.

Ship-killer Cult.name: PHANTASM GRENADES
Ship-killer Cult.flavor: These hallucinogenic atomisers spew clouds of nightmare-inducing gasses that leave the foe glassy-eyed and reeling.
Ship-killer Cult.when: Your Movement phase, just after a WYcH CULT unit from your army ends a Normal move, before any enemy units fire Overwatch.
Ship-killer Cult.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.

Ship-killer Cult.name: TOYING WITH THE PREY
Ship-killer Cult.flavor: More than simply besting their victims in combat, the Wyches slowly take them apart, one perfectly placed cut and slice at a time, making a terrifying example to shatter enemy morale.
Ship-killer Cult.when: Fight phase, just after a WYcH CULT unit from your army has fought.
Ship-killer Cult.effect: If your unit destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, select one of those enemy models. Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy model's unit (to a minimum of l).

Skysplinter Assault.name: NIGHT SHIELD
Skysplinter Assault.flavor: These powerful Drukhari devices occlude their raiding vehicles from physical sight, targeting sensors, and even psychic senses.
Skysplinter Assault.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Skysplinter Assault.target: One Drukhari Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Skysplinter Assault.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Skysplinter Assault.name: POUNCE ON THE PREY
Skysplinter Assault.flavor: Incredible alien agility and a delight in taking wild risks help these warriors to leap acrobatically from their skimming transports directly into battle.
Skysplinter Assault.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari Infantry unit from your army disembarks from a Transport that made a Normal move this phase.
Skysplinter Assault.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge.

Skysplinter Assault.name: SKYBORNE ANNIHILATION
Skysplinter Assault.flavor: These warriors are well versed in raining suppressing fire on the foe even as they close with them from on high, shredding defences and leaving the survivors easy prey for the raid.
Skysplinter Assault.target: One Drukhari unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and that disembarked from a Transport this turn.
Skysplinter Assault.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, or the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability if your unit is a Kabalite Warriors or Hand of the Archon unit.

Skysplinter Assault.name: SWOOPING MOCKERY
Skysplinter Assault.flavor: The crew of this skimmer delight in evading and taunting their enemies with mocking ease.
Skysplinter Assault.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Skysplinter Assault.target: One Drukhari Transport from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Skysplinter Assault.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Skysplinter Assault.name: VICIOUS BLADES
Skysplinter Assault.flavor: Wielding a horrifying array of hooked boarding blades, barbed lariats and other specialised tools of agony, these warriors hack and slash at their foes even as their transport skims low overhead.
Skysplinter Assault.when: Fight phase, just after a Drukhari Transport from your army has selected its targets.
Skysplinter Assault.effect: After your TRANSPORT has fought, select one enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks and roll one D6 for each model embarked within your TRANSPORT, adding 1 to the result if that embarked model is a Wracks model: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Skysplinter Assault.name: WRAITHLIKE RETREAT
