Skysplinter Assault.flavor: Employing smoke grenades, paralysing mists or simple cunning and agility, these warriors slip away like spectres.
Skysplinter Assault.target: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army that fought this phase.
Skysplinter Assault.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, but unless it is a WYCHES unit, it must end that move wholly within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of a friendly DRUKHARI TRANSPORT and must embark within that TRANSPORT at the end of that move (otherwise, it cannot make that move). Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from that TRANSPORT.

Space Lane Raiders.name: CREW-THIEVES
Space Lane Raiders.flavor: The fast-acting incapacitation toxins on the blades of these Wracks allow them to lay low the defenders, before dragging them away, alive but powerless, to a far more horrible fate than death.
Space Lane Raiders.target: One WRAcKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Space Lane Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+] ability.

Space Lane Raiders.name: SHIPBOARD SHADES
Space Lane Raiders.flavor: Amidst the strobing lumens and gouting steam of voidship combat, the Drukhari flicker and flit like malevolent, half-seen shadows.
Space Lane Raiders.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Space Lane Raiders.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Space Lane Raiders.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Space Lane Raiders.name: VETERAN PIRATES
Space Lane Raiders.flavor: No strangers to shipboard warfare, these warriors are skilled in loosing volleys then vanishing swiftly back behind corners and bulkheads to avoid reprisals.
Space Lane Raiders.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABALITE WARRIORS unit from your army has shot.
Space Lane Raiders.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

Space Lane Raiders.name: VOIDSHIP GLADIATORS
Space Lane Raiders.flavor: Treating the vessel they have boarded as just another arena to perform in, these Wyches turn every iota of their skill and agility to the task.
Space Lane Raiders.target: One WYcHES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Space Lane Raiders.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2+, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at your unit.

Spectacle of Spite.name: A CHALLENGE MET
Spectacle of Spite.flavor: The foe's advance is not something to be wary of but rather an opportunity to be seized.
Spectacle of Spite.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
Spectacle of Spite.target: One friendly unengaged WYCH CULT unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
Spectacle of Spite.effect: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

Spectacle of Spite.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
Spectacle of Spite.flavor: Moving so quickly they seem to blur, the Wyches evade incoming fire with contemptuous elegance.
Spectacle of Spite.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Spectacle of Spite.target: One Wych Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Spectacle of Spite.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Spectacle of Spite.name: BERSERK FUGUE
Spectacle of Spite.flavor: The cult's gladiators enter a killing trance when combat is joined, allowing them to fight on through the most grievous hurts with undimmed ferocity.
Spectacle of Spite.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Spectacle of Spite.target: One Wych Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Spectacle of Spite.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Spectacle of Spite.name: DEADLY DEBUT
Spectacle of Spite.flavor: Imitating Lelith Hesperax, these warriors begin their gladiatorial bout with an opening so spectacularly violent that none can fail to be impressed.
Spectacle of Spite.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Spectacle of Spite.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Wyches unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.

Spectacle of Spite.name: FEIGNED WEAKNESS
Spectacle of Spite.flavor: Employing a common ruse from the arenas, the Drukhari appear to cower, wounded and exhausted, before surging back at their overconfident opponents with blades and fangs bared.
Spectacle of Spite.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari unit from your army Falls Back.
Spectacle of Spite.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in turn in which it Fell Back.

Spectacle of Spite.name: PRETERNATURAL AGILITY
Spectacle of Spite.flavor: Bounding and weaving, the Wyches cross the battlefield with unmatched acrobatic agility.
Spectacle of Spite.when: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.
Spectacle of Spite.target: One Wych Cult unit from your army.
Spectacle of Spite.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it and, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes such a move, it can move horizontally through models (when doing so, such a model can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end a Normal or Advance move within Engagement Range of them).

Tools of Torment.name: DIVIDENDS OF AGONY
Tools of Torment.flavor: Sharing is typically anathema to the self‑centred Drukhari, except where horror can be fruitfully reinvested in those marked for later harvest.
Tools of Torment.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit destroys an enemy unit.
Tools of Torment.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Tools of Torment.name: SALTING THE WOUND
Tools of Torment.flavor: Confusion, terror, and panic are triggers for a Haemonculus’ Engines of Pain, which stimulate them to drive their evil augmentations even deeper into the foe.
Tools of Torment.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CRONOS/TALOS unit is selected to fight.
Tools of Torment.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

Tools of Torment.name: URGENT METAMORPHOSIS
Tools of Torment.flavor: The unhurried menace exuded by Covenites as they extricate themselves from gore‑slick foes can metamorphose in an instant back to pain‑hungry savagery.
Tools of Torment.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Tools of Torment.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Carnival of Excess.name: DARK APPARITIONS
Carnival of Excess.flavor: The daemons of Slaanesh are not bound by the laws of reality, fading in and out of existence at will.
Carnival of Excess.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Carnival of Excess.target: One Daemonettes unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Carnival of Excess.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly Emperor’s Children units.

Carnival of Excess.name: ECSTATIC SLAUGHTER
Carnival of Excess.flavor: As the violence intensifies, so does the ecstasy of battle empower daemon and mortal alike.
Carnival of Excess.when: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Carnival of Excess.target: That Legions OF Excess unit and one friendly Emperor’s Children unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Carnival of Excess.effect: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.

Carnival of Excess.name: SUSTAINED BY AGONY
Carnival of Excess.flavor: Slaaneshi daemons feed upon the emotions of others, with agony a particular delicacy.
Carnival of Excess.when: Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Carnival of Excess.effect: Select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a Daemonettes unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.

Carnival of Excess.name: SYCOPHANTIC SURGE
Carnival of Excess.flavor: The daemons of Slaanesh care naught for mortals but strive to earn the approval of their Dark Prince.
Carnival of Excess.target: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.
Carnival of Excess.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more Emperor’s Children units from your army.

Carnival of Excess.name: UNCANNY REACTIONS
Carnival of Excess.flavor: Those who have earned the favour of their Dark Prince may be granted a sliver of his grace.
Carnival of Excess.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Carnival of Excess.target: One Slaanesh unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Carnival of Excess.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Carnival of Excess.name: VIOLENT CRESCENDO
Carnival of Excess.flavor: In the final act of the battle, the followers of Slaanesh descend to slaughter the remaining foes.
Carnival of Excess.target: One Slaanesh Beasts, Slaanesh Infantry or SLAANESH Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Carnival of Excess.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

Coterie of the Conceited.name: ARMOUR OF ABHORRENCE
Coterie of the Conceited.flavor: The abhorrent contempt that the Emperor’s Children possess, combined with their combat-stimmed physiologies, makes them unyielding foes to face.
Coterie of the Conceited.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Coterie of the Conceited
Coterie of the Conceited.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Coterie of the Conceited.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Coterie of the Conceited.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Coterie of the Conceited.name: EMBRACE THE PAIN
Coterie of the Conceited.flavor: The Emperor’s Children revel in every sensation - even ones that would slay lesser mortals outright.
Coterie of the Conceited.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Coterie of the Conceited
Coterie of the Conceited.target: One Emperor’s Children Infantry unit from your army.
Coterie of the Conceited.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

Coterie of the Conceited.name: MARTIAL PERFECTION
Coterie of the Conceited.flavor: The Emperor’s Children find stimulation in excess, be it brutally shocking acts of violence or gratuitous displays of martial prowess.
Coterie of the Conceited.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Coterie of the Conceited
Coterie of the Conceited.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Coterie of the Conceited.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Coterie of the Conceited.name: PROTECTION OF THE DARK PRINCE
Coterie of the Conceited.flavor: On occasion, the Dark Prince may grant a boon of protection to his favoured followers in the heat of battle. Such a boon incurs a debt, one that will be paid in the fullness of time.
Coterie of the Conceited.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Coterie of the Conceited
Coterie of the Conceited.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an Emperor’s Children unit from your army.
Coterie of the Conceited.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

Coterie of the Conceited.name: UNBOUND ARROGANCE
Coterie of the Conceited.flavor: The hubris of the Emperor’s Children is both their greatest strength and their biggest weakness.
Coterie of the Conceited.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Coterie of the Conceited
Coterie of the Conceited.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Coterie of the Conceited.effect: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.
Coterie of the Conceited.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Coterie of the Conceited.name: UNSHAKEABLE OPPONENTS
Coterie of the Conceited.flavor: Inured to ordinary sensations by several lifetimes of indulgence, there is little that can deter or faze the warriors of the Emperor's Children.
Coterie of the Conceited.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Coterie of the Conceited
Coterie of the Conceited.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army.
Coterie of the Conceited.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.

Court of the Phoenician.name: CATALYTIC STIMULUS
Court of the Phoenician.flavor: Invigorated by pain, the Emperor’s Children will embrace an enemy’s attack as a catalyst for masterful vengeance.
Court of the Phoenician.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Court of the Phoenician
Court of the Phoenician.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Court of the Phoenician.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
Court of the Phoenician.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Court of the Phoenician.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS EXCRUCIATION
Court of the Phoenician.flavor: At short range, the Emperor’s Children eagerly target weak points in their enemies, exulting over every cry of pain they elicit.
Court of the Phoenician.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Court of the Phoenician
Court of the Phoenician.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Court of the Phoenician.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

Court of the Phoenician.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
Court of the Phoenician.flavor: With cocktails of resilience-enhancing stimms or armour inlaid with forbidden runes of warding, the Emperor’s Children sneeringly disregard even powerful blows.
Court of the Phoenician.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Court of the Phoenician
Court of the Phoenician.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Court of the Phoenician.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army.
Court of the Phoenician.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Court of the Phoenician.name: EUPHORIC INSPIRATION
Court of the Phoenician.flavor: Those with the Dark Prince’s blessings inspire euphoric floods of battle-lust in the Emperor’s Children, who power towards the foe with screams of murderous ecstasy.
Court of the Phoenician.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Court of the Phoenician
Court of the Phoenician.target: One Emperor’s Children Daemon unit from your army.
Court of the Phoenician.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly Emperor’s Children units within 6" of your unit.

Court of the Phoenician.name: PRIDEFUL SUPERIORITY
Court of the Phoenician.flavor: The chance to ostentatiously humble the foe’s champions and prove them worthless rivals is a lure few Emperor’s Children can resist.
Court of the Phoenician.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Court of the Phoenician
Court of the Phoenician.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Court of the Phoenician.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Court of the Phoenician.name: SINUOUS BREACH
Court of the Phoenician.flavor: The power of Slaanesh is an undulating and writhing thing, and his daemonic servants can mould their forms to slither over and through any obstacle.
Court of the Phoenician.group: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN - Court of the Phoenician
Court of the Phoenician.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Court of the Phoenician.target: One Emperor’s Children Daemon unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Court of the Phoenician.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Elegant Brutes.name: DELIGHT IN AGONY
Elegant Brutes.flavor: So well shielded by their armour are Emperor’s Children Terminators that, when the foe’s attacks actually punch through to wound them, the rarity of the sensation is an invigorating tonic.
Elegant Brutes.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
Elegant Brutes.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Elegant Brutes.name: PSYCHEDELIC SOULFLAME
Elegant Brutes.flavor: The Terminators’ fervid need to annihilate ever more enemies manifests as a lurid empyric firestorm which wreathes their blows and the projectiles spat from their guns.
Elegant Brutes.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is selected to attack.

Elegant Brutes.name: WARP PLUNGE
Elegant Brutes.flavor: Addicted to the supreme danger of teleportation, these Terminators employ twisted warp sorcery to plunge into the immaterium time and again.
Elegant Brutes.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Elegant Brutes.target: One friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
Elegant Brutes.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Frenzied Host.name: ABSOLUTE SENSORY OVERLOAD
Frenzied Host.flavor: Far from hiding from the foe, these warriors unleash such an unbearable barrage of blinding light and deafening sound that those who try to take aim at them are temporarily deafened and blinded.
Frenzied Host.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to shoot.
Frenzied Host.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

Frenzied Host.name: AGONISED CACOPHONY
Frenzied Host.flavor: Hurling vile semiorganic screamer grenades into the midst of the foe, these warriors mark their presence not only by the wails of their ordnance, but also by the agonised screams of their victims.
Frenzied Host.target: One friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.
Frenzied Host.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

Frenzied Host.name: POSSESSIVE MANIA
Frenzied Host.flavor: Having seized some vital location or enthralling prize, these Slaaneshi warriors experience a frenzied need to claim it that renders them inured to the most grievous hurts.
Frenzied Host.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective.
Frenzied Host.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Mercurial Host.name: CAPRICIOUS REACTIONS
Mercurial Host.flavor: Their superhuman reflexes enhanced by endless streams of addictive combat stimms, the Emperor's Children react to incoming fire with haste, weaving between shots and taking cover in the blink of an eye.
Mercurial Host.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Mercurial Host.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Mercurial Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Mercurial Host.name: COMBAT STIMMS
Mercurial Host.flavor: Hideously euphoric concoctions empower the minds and constitutions of the Legion’s sybaritic warriors.
Mercurial Host.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Mercurial Host.target: One Emperor’s Children iNFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Mercurial Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Mercurial Host.name: CRUEL RAIDERS
Mercurial Host.flavor: The Emperor's Children delight in the shattering of false hope, often disengaging from their foes only to strike again at an exposed flank.
Mercurial Host.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Mercurial Host.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.
Mercurial Host.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Mercurial Host.name: DARK VIGOUR
Mercurial Host.flavor: The Emperor’s Children possess inhuman vigour- their warriors move with monstrous speed to counter any advance and meet any challenge.
Mercurial Host.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Mercurial Host.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army (excluding Beasts and Vehicles) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
Mercurial Host.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Mercurial Host.name: HONOUR THE PRINCE
Mercurial Host.flavor: Warriors who venerate Slaanesh through the most graceful fighting forms are rewarded for their efforts.
Mercurial Host.target: One Emperor’s Children Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Mercurial Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Mercurial Host.name: VIOLENT EXCESS
Mercurial Host.flavor: The visceral thrill of killing causes the warriors of the Emperor’s Children to enter an ecstatic frenzy of butchery and dismemberment.
Mercurial Host.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Mercurial Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Peerless Bladesmen.name: CRUEL BLADESMAN
Peerless Bladesmen.flavor: Fulgrim’s scions are renowned for their bladecraft, toying with their inferiors while preparing an exquisite, penetrating thrust.
Peerless Bladesmen.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Peerless Bladesmen.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Peerless Bladesmen.name: CUT DOWN THE WEAK
Peerless Bladesmen.flavor: Contempt for lesser warriors drives the Emperor's Children in their punishing reprisals.
Peerless Bladesmen.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
Peerless Bladesmen.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army (you can only select a Vehicle if it is a Walker) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
Peerless Bladesmen.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.

Peerless Bladesmen.name: DEATH ECSTASY
Peerless Bladesmen.flavor: Death is but another thrilling experience and the Emperor's Children are loath to deny the enemy such ecstatic sensation.
Peerless Bladesmen.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Peerless Bladesmen.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Peerless Bladesmen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Peerless Bladesmen.name: DEFT PARRY
Peerless Bladesmen.flavor: Bedazzled by these warriors’ weaving swordsmanship and hypnotic aura, foes cannot land a telling blow upon them.
Peerless Bladesmen.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Peerless Bladesmen.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Peerless Bladesmen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Peerless Bladesmen.name: INCESSANT VIOLENCE
Peerless Bladesmen.flavor: Caught up in the joyful exhilaration of violent excess, the momentum of the Emperor's Children is almost impossible to halt.
Peerless Bladesmen.when: Fight phase, just before an Emperor’s Children unit from your army Consolidates.
Peerless Bladesmen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Peerless Bladesmen.name: TERRIFYING SPECTACLE
Peerless Bladesmen.flavor: Flensing strikes, dismemberments and eviscerations strike fear into the hearts of the foe.
Peerless Bladesmen.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
Peerless Bladesmen.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Rapid Evisceration.name: ADVANCE AND CLAIM
Rapid Evisceration.flavor: The Emperor's Children send forth their front-line troops in swift vehicles to seize ground rapidly.
Rapid Evisceration.target: One Emperor’s Children Transport from your army that has one or more Tormentors units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
Rapid Evisceration.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Rapid Evisceration.name: CEASELESS ONSLAUGHT
Rapid Evisceration.flavor: Cocktails of combat stimms and a blazing murderlust drive the warriors of the Emperor’s Children forward at breakneck speed.
Rapid Evisceration.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport that made a Normal move this turn.
Rapid Evisceration.effect: Until the end of the phase, your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is eligible to declare a charge.

Rapid Evisceration.name: DYNAMIC BREAKTHROUGH
Rapid Evisceration.flavor: Relying upon shock, awe and daemonically enhanced vehicles, the Emperor's Children drive through the enemy lines to outflank the enemy.
Rapid Evisceration.target: One Emperor’s Children Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Rapid Evisceration.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Rapid Evisceration.name: ONTO THE NEXT
Rapid Evisceration.flavor: The fleeting obsessions of the Emperor's Children cause them always to seek fresh targets.
Rapid Evisceration.target: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
Rapid Evisceration.effect: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Rapid Evisceration.name: OUTFLANKING STRIKE
Rapid Evisceration.flavor: The Emperor’s Children utilise their infantry to pin the enemy down whilst further transports seek to outflank the foe and deploy troops behind.
Rapid Evisceration.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Rapid Evisceration.target: One Emperor’s Children Transport from your army, or up to two Emperor’s Children Dedicated Transports from your army.
Rapid Evisceration.effect: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Rapid Evisceration.name: REACTIVE DISEMBARKATION
Rapid Evisceration.flavor: As their transports come underfire, the Emperor’s Children disembark and take the fight to the foe with boltgun and sword.
Rapid Evisceration.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rapid Evisceration.target: One Emperor’s Children Transport from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rapid Evisceration.effect: One Emperor’s Children unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Slaanesh’s Chosen.name: BEAUTIFUL DEATH
Slaanesh’s Chosen.flavor: The more extravagant and luridly violent the kill, the greater the Dark Prince's appreciation.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.target: One Emperor’s Children Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Slaanesh’s Chosen.name: DEVOTED DUELLISTS
Slaanesh’s Chosen.flavor: By slaying theirfoes in close combat, the champions of Slaanesh seek to elevate themselves in his favour.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.target: One or more Emperor’s Children Character units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

Slaanesh’s Chosen.name: DIABOLIC MAJESTY
Slaanesh’s Chosen.flavor: Those who gaze upon one of Slaanesh’s chosen are stricken by their diabolic majesty.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children Character unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Slaanesh’s Chosen.name: HEIGHTENED JEALOUSY
Slaanesh’s Chosen.flavor: Rivalries are commonplace amongst the champions of the Emperor's Children as all vie for Slaanesh’s boons.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children Character unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

Slaanesh’s Chosen.name: REFUSAL TO BE OUTDONE
Slaanesh’s Chosen.flavor: Rivals for the Dark Prince's favour will stop at nothing to outdo their foes and claim a greater tally of souls.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.effect: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

Slaanesh’s Chosen.name: VENGEFUL SURGE
Slaanesh’s Chosen.flavor: Consumed by their obsessive desire for revenge, the Emperor's Children surge into oncoming fusillades.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Slaanesh’s Chosen.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.

Spectacle of Slaughter.name: HONOUR IS FOR FOOLS
Spectacle of Slaughter.flavor: Far from facing enemy champions in fair duels one‑on‑one, the Flawless Blades fall upon them like a pack of jackals competing viciously to claim the glory of the kill.
Spectacle of Slaughter.when: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.

Spectacle of Slaughter.name: INTOXICATED BY TRIUMPH
Spectacle of Slaughter.flavor: Seeing their foes fleeing in terror before them only fires the chem‑laced blood of the Flawless Blades, urging them on toward their next challenge all the quicker.
Spectacle of Slaughter.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.
Spectacle of Slaughter.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Spectacle of Slaughter.name: SINGLE-MINDED STRIKE
Spectacle of Slaughter.flavor: Scornfully dismissing the chaff that blocks their path, the Flawless Blades swat them aside and sweep regally on toward their true quarry.
Spectacle of Slaughter.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.
Spectacle of Slaughter.effect: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).

Sublime Strike.name: ALLURING GROTESQUERIE
Sublime Strike.flavor: Physically and spiritually distorted by the blessings of Slaanesh, these warriors can project an aura that fascinates and revolts their enemies on a level so instinctual that it drives some to madness.
Sublime Strike.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Sublime Strike.name: CLOYING CORRUPTION
Sublime Strike.flavor: The mere presence of these Slaaneshi chosen is enough to taint the fabric of reality, saturating it with lingering spiritual corruption.
Sublime Strike.target: One FLAWLESS BLADES unit from your army.
Sublime Strike.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

Sublime Strike.name: EAGER FOR MORE
Sublime Strike.flavor: Never sated, no matter the ferocity of the fight, the Emperor's Children maintain a manic momentum as they drive toward their primary target at a breakneck pace.
Sublime Strike.when: Your Movement phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Sublime Strike.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

Sublime Strike.name: VYING FOR VICTORY
Sublime Strike.flavor: Sweeping their enemies aside almost as an afterthought, these warriors press on with all haste, obsessed with staying ahead of their rivals within the boarding party.
Sublime Strike.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Sublime Strike.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
Sublime Strike.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

Biosanctic Broodsurge.name: BIO-HORROR REVELATION
Biosanctic Broodsurge.flavor: Face to face with hideous genetic monstrosities, their full horror can shake even the most stoic soul.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit within 9" of your unit is selected to shoot, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result. If that test is failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Biosanctic Broodsurge.name: EVASIVE VANGUARD
Biosanctic Broodsurge.flavor: Adaptive and intelligent, the purest of a cult's broods can evade their foes to find new avenues of ingress.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

Biosanctic Broodsurge.name: GENE-TWISTED MUSCLE
Biosanctic Broodsurge.flavor: The raw strength of those infused with the Patriarch’s distilled power is undeniable when directed against the foe’s hulking tools of tyranny.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Biosanctic Broodsurge.name: HYPER-METABOLIC VIGOUR
Biosanctic Broodsurge.flavor: Evidence of the bio-horror taint in their veins, the most blessed of a cult exhibit an inhuman swiftness.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.target: One Aberrants, Biophagus or Purestrain Genestealers unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

Biosanctic Broodsurge.name: SAINTLY PAROXYSM
Biosanctic Broodsurge.flavor: There are few more holy virtues in the cult’s eyes than to use one’s final act to lay low the oppressor.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Genestealer Cults Character model from your army.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.target: That destroyed CHARACTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If that Character model is an Abominant or Patriarch, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead.

Biosanctic Broodsurge.name: STIMULATED BIO-SURGE
Biosanctic Broodsurge.flavor: Triggered by xenos bio-stimms flooding their bodies, when the cult’s predators spring their trap, the jaws close inescapably.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.target: One ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
Biosanctic Broodsurge.effect: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

Brood Brother Auxilia.name: A DARK NETWORK
Brood Brother Auxilia.flavor: Forewarned of the enemy's sudden onset by spies in their ranks or by the Brood Brothers' own strategos, the cult’s faithful evade potential catastrophe.
Brood Brother Auxilia.when: Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves.
Brood Brother Auxilia.target: One Astra Militarum or GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12" of that enemy unit.
Brood Brother Auxilia.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Brood Brother Auxilia.name: ACCEPTABLE LOSSES
Brood Brother Auxilia.flavor: With martial pragmatism and the cult's victory at stake, Brood Brothers will willingly open fire on the foe even if it endangers infiltrating cells of allies.
Brood Brother Auxilia.target: One Astra Militarum unit from your army.
Brood Brother Auxilia.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those GENESTEALER CULTS units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

Brood Brother Auxilia.name: IN THE SHADOW OF IRON
Brood Brother Auxilia.flavor: Hulking armoured war engines provide ideal cover to launch a well-timed ambush.
Brood Brother Auxilia.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
Brood Brother Auxilia.target: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army.
Brood Brother Auxilia.effect: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers. You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.

Brood Brother Auxilia.name: REGIMENTAL REINFORCEMENTS
Brood Brother Auxilia.flavor: Xeno-tainted soldiers have long learned to lurk in the shadows, ready to attack when the cult calls.
Brood Brother Auxilia.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Astra Militarum Infantry Regiment unit from your army (excluding Artillery and Character units) is destroyed.
Brood Brother Auxilia.target: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Brood Brother Auxilia.effect: Roll one D6: on a 3+, place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed) and add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
Brood Brother Auxilia.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

Brood Brother Auxilia.name: SUPPRESS AND OVERWHELM
Brood Brother Auxilia.flavor: Disciplined salvoes of fire can drive the foe into cover, leaving them vulnerable to the rest of the cult.
Brood Brother Auxilia.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum unit from your army has shot.
Brood Brother Auxilia.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem and each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army selects that enemy unit as a target of a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

Brood Brother Auxilia.name: SYMBIOTIC DESTRUCTION
Brood Brother Auxilia.flavor: As the Broodmind coordinates their timing, martial and insurrectionist comrades target their chosen victims in volleys of mutually supportive firepower.
Brood Brother Auxilia.target: One Astra Militarum and one GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
Brood Brother Auxilia.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to both of those selected units and within range of at least one ranged weapon from each of those units. Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, each time such a model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Cult Unveiled.name: FOR THE BROOD
Cult Unveiled.flavor: Fanatical, and with wills suborned by the insidious Broodmind, these cultists will gladly die amidst hails of their comrades’fire if it means victory.
Cult Unveiled.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Cult Unveiled.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly GENESTEALER CULTS units. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after your unit has finished making those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those friendly units: on a 2-4, that friendly unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that friendly unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

Cult Unveiled.name: LURKING MENACE
Cult Unveiled.flavor: Foes find their aim confounded as the Genestealer Cultists prowl through gloom and drifting steam, rarely presenting themselves as targets.
Cult Unveiled.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Cult Unveiled.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Cult Unveiled.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the attacking model is not within 3", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Cult Unveiled.name: OUT OF HIDING
Cult Unveiled.flavor: Wary of detection, the cult has concealed cells of the faithful through the structure of the ship. Now they emerge into the fight like insects from their cocoon.
Cult Unveiled.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
Cult Unveiled.target: One NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
Cult Unveiled.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.
Cult Unveiled.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Cult Unveiled.name: PLANNED EXTRACTION
Cult Unveiled.flavor: Driven by the Broodmind and their own guerrilla training, these cultists refuse open battle, instead firing hails of cover fire as they retreat into the shadows.
Cult Unveiled.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Final Day.name: AVENGE THE STAR CHILDREN
Final Day.flavor: Some amongst the cult still retain enough sentience and zeal to feel rage and a need for vengeance if they see the Star Children slain.
Final Day.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Final Day.target: One Tyranids Character unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Final Day.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a Genestealer Cults model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Final Day.name: DARTING ATTACKS
Final Day.flavor: Like predatory sea beasts lunging from wheeling shoals of fish, the vanguard organisms strike and fade from amidst the cultist hordes repeatedly, picking apart their overwhelmed prey.
Final Day.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
Final Day.target: One Tyranids unit from your army.
Final Day.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Final Day.name: DIVINE IMPERATIVE
Final Day.flavor: Cultists dash madly into the fighting without a care for their survival, drawn onward to aid the vanguard organisms by a will they cannot resist.
Final Day.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Genestealer Cults unit within 12" of a friendly engaged Tyranids unit declares a charge.
Final Day.effect:
• Your unit has +1 to charge rolls.
  • You can use this part of this stratagem. If you do:
    • Your unit can re-roll charge rolls.
    • Your unit must end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that friendly TYRANIDS unit.

Final Day.name: HYPERFEROCITY
Final Day.flavor: Goaded by the newly ascendant Hive Mind, the cultists fight with greater fury even as their muscles tear and organs rupture under the strain.
Final Day.target: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Final Day.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly Tyranids units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Final Day.name: PSI SURGE
Final Day.flavor: As the Tyranid invasion gathers pace, the influence of the Hive Mind surges like waves rolling ever higher onto a desolate shore.
Final Day.target: One Tyranids unit from your army.
Final Day.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit’s Catalyst ability by 3".
Final Day.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.

Final Day.name: RESISTANCE TUNNELS
Final Day.flavor: Never again will the tunnel networks of the cult provide secret roads for hopeful and idealistic freedom fighters. Yet they can still serve one last time as a means by which the Tyranids and their surviving worshippers can vanish from the battlefield only to strike again elsewhere.
Final Day.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Final Day.target: One Genestealer Cults or Tyranids unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Final Day.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Genespawn Onslaught.name: GROWING DREAD
Genespawn Onslaught.flavor: The more enemies see of the gene-wrought terrors they are fighting against, the more their tactical cohesion is drowned by horror and panic.
Genespawn Onslaught.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre.
Genespawn Onslaught.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is within 9" of and visible to that enemy unit.
Genespawn Onslaught.effect: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, that enemy unit does not perform that Tactical Manoeuvre and it cannot perform anotherTactical Manoeuvre this turn (but can otherwise act normally).

Genespawn Onslaught.name: MONSTROUS MOMENTUM
Genespawn Onslaught.flavor: Not content with slaying their immediate prey, these warriors press on in search of more before the bodies have even stopped twitching.
Genespawn Onslaught.when: Fight phase, just after a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Genespawn Onslaught.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in your unit can end that move as close as possible to the nearest Hatchway instead of the nearest visible enemy unit. Your unit can then attempt to operate that Hatchway.

Genespawn Onslaught.name: SOLDIERS OF THE STAR CHILDREN
Genespawn Onslaught.flavor: For all their grotesque appearance, Hybrid Metamorphs are amongst the most skilled and ruthlessly efficient of the cult’s warriors.
Genespawn Onslaught.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a HYBRID METAMORPHS unit from your army is selected to perform the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre.
Genespawn Onslaught.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

Genespawn Onslaught.name: UNSTOPPABLE BRUTES
Genespawn Onslaught.flavor: Bulked out with enormous slabs of twisted muscle, Aberrants and Abominants simply smash aside hatches and bulkheads that block their paths.
Genespawn Onslaught.target: One ABOMINANT or ABERRANTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
Genespawn Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the phase, when makinga Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
Genespawn Onslaught.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

Heroes of the Uprising.name: LIVING UP TO LEGEND
Heroes of the Uprising.flavor: Few sights are more inspiring to the downtrodden yet fanatical masses of the Genestealer Cult than seeing their folk heroes striking down their oppressors.
Heroes of the Uprising.group: GENESTEALER CULTS - Heroes of the Uprising
Heroes of the Uprising.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit has attacked, if those attacks destroyed an enemy unit or an enemy CHARACTER model.
Heroes of the Uprising.effect: Each visible friendly battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

Heroes of the Uprising.name: LOYAL TO THE END
Heroes of the Uprising.flavor: Even caught firmly within the jaws of death, still this champion of the cult lives up to their reputation for deadly skill and utter devotion to the cause.
Heroes of the Uprising.group: GENESTEALER CULTS - Heroes of the Uprising
Heroes of the Uprising.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly KILLER unit.
Heroes of the Uprising.effect:
When a KILLER model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
  • On a 2+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Heroes of the Uprising.name: SURGING BROODWORSHIP
Heroes of the Uprising.flavor: Feeding back through the unnatural connection of the broodmind, the sheer worshipful belief of the masses in the superhuman abilities of their champions actually manifests to empower those very figureheads.
Heroes of the Uprising.group: GENESTEALER CULTS - Heroes of the Uprising
Heroes of the Uprising.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit is selected to attack.
Heroes of the Uprising.effect: Attacks made by KILLER models in your unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

Host of Ascension.name: A DEADLY SNARE
Host of Ascension.flavor: An enemy's fervour to strike down the faithful of the cult can be turned against them, luring the foe into a region laced with hidden traps and primed explosives.
Host of Ascension.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
Host of Ascension.target: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
Host of Ascension.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

Host of Ascension.name: COORDINATED TRAP
Host of Ascension.flavor: A tenet of guerrilla warfare is the concentration of even inferior firepower to inflict maximum harm.
Host of Ascension.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Host of Ascension.target: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Host of Ascension.effect: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Host of Ascension.name: LYING IN WAIT
Host of Ascension.flavor: The brood lurks invisibly as the enemy approaches. Not until the last second do they burst from cover to strike.
Host of Ascension.target: One Genestealer Cults Battleline unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
Host of Ascension.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Host of Ascension.name: PRIMED AND READIED
Host of Ascension.flavor: The broodkin have been trained and equipped for this moment, with weapons readied for Ascension.
Host of Ascension.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Host of Ascension.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Host of Ascension.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

Host of Ascension.name: RETURN TO THE SHADOWS
Host of Ascension.flavor: With their task of drawing the oppressors' fire complete, the surviving cultists melt away, ready to strike again.
Host of Ascension.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Host of Ascension.target: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Host of Ascension.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Host of Ascension.name: TUNNEL CRAWLERS
Host of Ascension.flavor: The cult can expertly assail seemingly impregnable enemy positions.
Host of Ascension.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
Host of Ascension.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
Host of Ascension.restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

Infestation Swarm.name: HUNTING GROUNDS
Infestation Swarm.flavor: Genestealers on the hunt are relentless, squirming through hatches before they have even half opened.
Infestation Swarm.when: Your Movement phase, just after a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Infestation Swarm.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3", provided at least one of its models ends that move on the opposite side of that Hatchway from when your unit opened it.

Infestation Swarm.name: HYPERADRENAL REFLEXES
Infestation Swarm.flavor: Goaded by the biostimulants surging through their bodies, these warrior organisms evade their enemies'attacks with unbelievable swiftness.
Infestation Swarm.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Infestation Swarm.target: One GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Infestation Swarm.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Infestation Swarm.name: OUTFLANK
Infestation Swarm.flavor: Swarms of Genestealers crawl through vents and ducts as they seek to outflank their prey.
Infestation Swarm.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Infestation Swarm.target: One GENESTEALERs or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit from your army that is wholly within an Entry Zone.
Infestation Swarm.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase. When doing so, if it was within one of your Entry Zones when it was removed, it must be set up wholly within another one of your Entry Zones. If it was within one of your opponent’s Entry Zones when it was removed, it must be set up wholly within another one of your opponent’s Entry Zones instead. If this is not possible, your unit is destroyed.

Infestation Swarm.name: PERVASIVE DREAD
Infestation Swarm.flavor: With the death of their leader, the surviving prey feel an ominous sense of doom press down upon them, heightened by subtle psionic assault.
Infestation Swarm.when: Fight phase, just after the enemy WARLORD is destroyed (and is not returned to the battlefield) by a GREAT DEVOURER unit from your army.
Infestation Swarm.effect: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. This Stratagem cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Outlander Claw.name: ALONG SHADOWED TRAILS
Outlander Claw.flavor: With raw speed and subtle misdirection, Atalan Jackals outflank those who believe them trapped.
Outlander Claw.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
Outlander Claw.target: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
Outlander Claw.effect: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

Outlander Claw.name: CLOSE-RANGE SHOOT-OUT
Outlander Claw.flavor: A cult’s experienced outriders are experts in hit-and-run attacks and close-range firefights. These skills are deadly when combined.
Outlander Claw.target: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Outlander Claw.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".

Outlander Claw.name: DEFT MANOEUVRING
Outlander Claw.flavor: Serpent-fast, jinking and swerving with incredible skill, the cult’s light vehicles appear to slide through the oppressors' gunfire.
Outlander Claw.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Outlander Claw.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Outlander Claw.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Outlander Claw.name: DEVOTED CREW
Outlander Claw.flavor: With evasive manoeuvres and split-second repairs, Outlander Claws marshal their rugged vehicles through the worst the foe can throw at them.
Outlander Claw.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Outlander Claw.target: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Outlander Claw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Outlander Claw.name: ENCIRCLING THE PREY
Outlander Claw.flavor: Skirting the edge of battle, an Outlander Claw's raiders watch keenly forvulnerabilities, ready to throw themselves back into the fight to exploit any weaknesses in the enemy.
Outlander Claw.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
Outlander Claw.target: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
Outlander Claw.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Outlander Claw.name: RAPID FEINT
Outlander Claw.flavor: An Outlander Claw’s skilled riders and crews can use their enhanced hybrid reactions to rapidly alter speed and course, roaring after fleeing prey or luring enemy out of position and leaving them flat-footed.
Outlander Claw.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Outlander Claw.target: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Outlander Claw.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Purestrain Broodswarm.name: CRAWLING HORROR
Purestrain Broodswarm.flavor: Genestealers can constrict themselves into grotesquely narrow spaces, can crawl across vertical surfaces and hang from ceilings in utter silence, and are rarely seen by their prey before it is altogether too late.
Purestrain Broodswarm.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Purestrain Broodswarm.effect: Your unit has -6" detection range until the end of the turn.

Purestrain Broodswarm.name: INHUMAN REACTIONS
Purestrain Broodswarm.flavor: Purestrain Genestealers think and move with horrifying swiftness, darting through the smoke and shadow of the battlefield, remaining always a few steps ahead of their prey.
Purestrain Broodswarm.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
Purestrain Broodswarm.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Purestrain Broodswarm.name: LURK AND STRIKE
Purestrain Broodswarm.flavor: Any sign these vicious aliens are trying to flee is but misdirection as they slip away from their attackers only to pounce once again upon unsuspecting prey.
Purestrain Broodswarm.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Purestrain Broodswarm.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Xenocreed Congregation.name: FRENZIED DEVOTION
Xenocreed Congregation.flavor: The faithful will gladly hurl themselves into harm's way.frenziedly dragging the foe down.
Xenocreed Congregation.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Xenocreed Congregation.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding Characters) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

Xenocreed Congregation.name: THE DOWNTRODDEN RISE
Xenocreed Congregation.flavor: Such is the creed's inspirational call to arms that as the foe foil one incursion, another rises for the cause.
Xenocreed Congregation.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Xenocreed Congregation.target: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
Xenocreed Congregation.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

Xenocreed Congregation.name: THE PATH OF ANGUISH
Xenocreed Congregation.flavor: Bloody persecution by the oppressors is grist for the mill of the cult's violent and zealous creed.
Xenocreed Congregation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Xenocreed Congregation.target: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
Xenocreed Congregation.effect: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

Xenocreed Congregation.name: TIRELESS FERVOUR
Xenocreed Congregation.flavor: When the cult's leaders demand devotion, danger and exhaustion are forgotten in the rush to serve.
Xenocreed Congregation.target: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
Xenocreed Congregation.effect:
• If your unit made an advance/fall-back move this turn, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
  • When your unit declares a charge, you can use this part of this stratagem. If you do:
    • Your unit can re-roll charge rolls.
    • Your unit must end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit engaged with a friendly CHARACTER unit.

Xenocreed Congregation.name: TRANSCENDENT CELERITY
Xenocreed Congregation.flavor: Owing to their hypersensory reactions, the cult’s rate of fire increases.
Xenocreed Congregation.target: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Xenocreed Congregation.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

Xenocreed Congregation.name: VENGEANCE FOR THE MARTYR!
Xenocreed Congregation.flavor: Should one of the Patriarch's inner coven fall, those that remain are swift to call for lethal retribution.
Xenocreed Congregation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Genestealer Cults Character model from your army.
Xenocreed Congregation.target: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
Xenocreed Congregation.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Xenocult Masses.name: EYES OF THE CULT
Xenocult Masses.flavor: Equipped with a wealth of local knowledge, it is no great task for these Neophytes to make out the positions of the unbelievers and report their presence to the cult.
Xenocult Masses.target: One friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a terrain area.
Xenocult Masses.effect: Enemy units within that terrain area have +6" detection range

Xenocult Masses.name: FANATICAL HAIL
Xenocult Masses.flavor: Driven wild with hate and fervour, the hybrids unleash a veritable storm of criss-crossing fire into their loathed foe.
Xenocult Masses.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is selected to shoot.
Xenocult Masses.effect: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can re-roll hit rolls.

Xenocult Masses.name: SLUNK FROM THE UNDERBELLY
Xenocult Masses.flavor: Used to being downtrodden, to creeping secretively through the shadows and hiding from authority, these Neophyte Hybrids are almost preternaturally skilled at making use of battlefield cover.
Xenocult Masses.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit with every model within a terrain area.
Xenocult Masses.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that unit has attacked

Argent Assault.name: A THREAT ENDED
Argent Assault.flavor: Paladins, more than even their brother Grey Knights, must strive to lay low those heretical champions from whom the taint of damnation spreads to threaten the Imperium.
Argent Assault.when: Fight phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

Argent Assault.name: AURA OF VENGEANCE
Argent Assault.flavor: Chanting incantations of vengeful wrath, the Paladins cursethose who strike at them to be laid low by their own strength and hatred.
Argent Assault.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit.
Argent Assault.effect: That enemy unit’s melee attacks have [HAZARDOUS].

Argent Assault.name: TRUESILVER AEGIS
Argent Assault.flavor: Layered into the Paladins’ armour by shriven seers and blessed saints, these potent wards of abjuration turn aside attacks both supernatural and mundane.
Argent Assault.when: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.
Argent Assault.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

Augurium Task Force.name: AGGRESSIVE ANTICIPATION
Augurium Task Force.flavor: Already knowing, blow-for-blow, how the battle they fight is predicted to play out, the Grey Knights take full advantage of their supernatural insight.
Augurium Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Augurium Task Force.target: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Augurium Task Force.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

Augurium Task Force.name: APPOINTED HOUR
Augurium Task Force.flavor: This moment was foreseen in an age before the Imperium itself. Now, that ancient fragment of foretelling is put to deadly use.
Augurium Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Augurium Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Augurium Task Force.name: FOREWARNED EVASION
Augurium Task Force.flavor: These warriors have received warning of the possible junctures of fate at which they are struck down. Such intelligence allows them to avoid their destiny.
Augurium Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Walker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Augurium Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Augurium Task Force.name: MIRAGE OF ECHOES
Augurium Task Force.flavor: Fragments of futures never to be are projected into the minds of the foe to make it seem that the Grey Knights are where they are not.
Augurium Task Force.when: The Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Augurium Task Force.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Augurium Task Force.name: NECESSARY END
Augurium Task Force.flavor: Sometimes, the ultimate sacrifice is required in the Emperor's name, yet with sufficient foresight, even death can be made to serve the Grey Knights' cause.
Augurium Task Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Augurium Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Augurium Task Force.name: REDIRECTED STRIKE
Augurium Task Force.flavor: Precognitive intelligence, strategic cunning and potent psychic power allow these Grey Knights to be virtually in two places simultaneously.
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Augurium Task Force.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves. Designer’s Note: This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.

Baneslayer Strike.name: ARMOURED AEGIS
Baneslayer Strike.flavor: This warrior stands indomitable, a shining tower of strength amidst a maelstrom of foes.
Baneslayer Strike.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

Baneslayer Strike.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
Baneslayer Strike.flavor: By entreating the machine spirit of his weapon with psychic incantations, a battle-brother can infuse it's already deadly payload with explosive mental energy.
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of storm bolters equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Baneslayer Strike.name: RELENTLESS BOARDERS
Baneslayer Strike.flavor: Once aboard the enemy vessel, the elite of the Grey Knights press forward relentlessly, even their momentary withdrawals only presaging another aggressive push into the next chamber.
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to charge this phase.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Baneslayer Strike.name: SANCTIC CIRCLE
Baneslayer Strike.flavor: Through focused psychic might, this warrior cleanses and wards a vital location against the foe.
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER or PALADIN SqUAD unit from your army.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit.
