If that objective marker does not have any enemy models within range of it (excluding Battle-shocked models), your unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result if that objective marker is Secured by your opponent’s army. If that test is passed, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army and is Secured by your army.

Banishers.name: CELERITY
Banishers.flavor: Tried and tested tactical battlefield magick, this working accelerates its casters' swiftness of thought and movement to preternatural levels.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker Infantry unit from your army.
Banishers.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Banishers.name: CHAOS BANE
Banishers.flavor: The Grey Knights reserve their greatest loathing and most potent rites of banishment for those who serve the Ruinous Powers.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Banishers.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.

Banishers.name: CIRCLE OF SANCTUARY
Banishers.flavor: Autolaunchers on this warrior's armour dispense airbursting canisters of blessed waters to create an instant zone of warding against hostile manifestations.
Banishers.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Character model from your army.
Banishers.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.

Banishers.name: HEXWROUGHT REPRISAL
Banishers.flavor: Hexagrammic wards worked into this warrior’s wargear blaze to life, bringing down a potent empyric curse upon those who dared seek to harm him.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
Banishers.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

Banishers.name: SHADOW OF ANARCH
Banishers.flavor: This muttered incantation conjures a sympathetic shadow of the true darkness beneath Mount Anarch, through which the Grey Knights stride fearlessly to emerge elsewhere than where they began.
Banishers.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Banishers.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Banishers.name: WARDING CHANT
Banishers.flavor: The Grey Knights maintain a tireless chant of warding magicks that turn aside the blasts and blades of even the most skilled foes.
Banishers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Banishers.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.

Brotherhood Strike.name: COMBAT MANIFESTATION
Brotherhood Strike.flavor: Extensive training helps these battle-brothers to burst from the Warp recklessly close to their foes without the risk of catastrophic recorporeation.
Brotherhood Strike.target: One Grey Knights unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
Brotherhood Strike.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

Brotherhood Strike.name: DUTY UNENDING
Brotherhood Strike.flavor: There are always more threats than the templars of Titan can attend to at once. They must strike swiftly before redeploying to the following critical combat.
Brotherhood Strike.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more Grey Knights units from your army Falls Back.
Brotherhood Strike.target: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Brotherhood Strike.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Brotherhood Strike.name: EXPEDITIOUS EXIT
Brotherhood Strike.flavor: Pragmatists well aware of their irreplaceable value, the warriors of Titan will not spend themselves needlessly in losing battles.
Brotherhood Strike.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Brotherhood Strike.target: One Grey Knights Psyker Infantry unit from your army.
Brotherhood Strike.effect: If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Designer’s Note: This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Brotherhood Strike.name: PURGATION PATTERN
Brotherhood Strike.flavor: Employing an overlapping fire pattern coupled with destructive cantrips, the Grey Knights fill the target zone with an inescapable hail of death.
Brotherhood Strike.target: One Grey Knights unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Brotherhood Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Brotherhood Strike.name: SHINING VEIL
Brotherhood Strike.flavor: Chanting words of sorcerous concealment, the Grey Knights gather a blinding psychic shroud around themselves through which no foe can see.
Brotherhood Strike.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Brotherhood Strike.target: One Grey Knights unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Brotherhood Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.

Brotherhood Strike.name: TRUESILVER CHANNELLING
Brotherhood Strike.flavor: Chanting words of abjuration, the Grey Knights pour their psychic might into their weapons until they burn with a sorcerous flame.
Brotherhood Strike.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Brotherhood Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Fires of Purgation.name: FOCUSED IMMOLATION
Fires of Purgation.flavor: Concentrating their fire on a single luckless target and pouring all their psychic might into every shot, the Purgators sear their victims from existence as though cauterising an infested wound in the flesh of realspace.
Fires of Purgation.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
Fires of Purgation.effect:
Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have:
  • [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Fires of Purgation.name: SOUL-LOCKED
Fires of Purgation.flavor: Once these warriors have acquired a spiritual target lock upon the animus of their enemies, they can hammer them with deadly fire, no matter the circumstances.
Fires of Purgation.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Fires of Purgation.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Fires of Purgation.name: SPIRITSEAR
Fires of Purgation.flavor: With their spiritual armour shattered along with that of their physical forms, the very souls of the enemy fall prey to the devastating fire of the Purgators.
Fires of Purgation.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot.
Fires of Purgation.effect: Select one battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

Hallowed Conclave.name: GIANTS OF THE BATTLEFIELD
Hallowed Conclave.flavor: Seeming to loom impossibly large in the minds of their foes, the Grey Knights employ the sheer force of their presence to overwhelm the enemy.
Hallowed Conclave.target: One Grey Knights Terminator unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Hallowed Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Hallowed Conclave.name: GRIND THEM UNDERFOOT
Hallowed Conclave.flavor: A psychic shock wave drives foes to their knees at the moment before the Terminators' armoured mass smashes into them with killing force.
Hallowed Conclave.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Grey Knights Terminator unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Hallowed Conclave.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Hallowed Conclave.name: POINT-BLANK PURGATION
Hallowed Conclave.flavor: Confident in the unbeatable protection of their armour and wards, the Terminators rake their foes with mass reactives at perilously close range.
Hallowed Conclave.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Hallowed Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.

Hallowed Conclave.name: PRECOGNITIVE STRATEGIES
Hallowed Conclave.flavor: The psychic abilities of these battle-brothers are turned toward predicting the foe's actions even before their enemies know what they will do.
Hallowed Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Hallowed Conclave.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Hallowed Conclave.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Hallowed Conclave.name: SHINING RESOLVE
Hallowed Conclave.flavor: Undimmed by pain, hardship or horror, the Grey Knights will to see their duty done burns as bright as a purifying flame.
Hallowed Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hallowed Conclave.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hallowed Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Hallowed Conclave.name: UNENDING FIDELITY
Hallowed Conclave.flavor: Unto their last breath and sometimes even beyond, the templars of Titan strive to fight on in the Emperor’s name.
Hallowed Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hallowed Conclave.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hallowed Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Immaterial Interdiction.name: BLADES FROM THE BEYOND
Immaterial Interdiction.flavor: With exceptional skill, these Interceptors teleport perilously close to their foes, bursting from the Immaterium into their very midst with lethal force.
Immaterial Interdiction.when: Fight phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

Immaterial Interdiction.name: BY THOUGHT ALONE
Immaterial Interdiction.flavor: Employing telekinetic sorceries even in the midst of a furious battle, Interceptors are able to complete vital mission objectives while interdicting the foe’s forces.
Immaterial Interdiction.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit starts an action.
Immaterial Interdiction.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Immaterial Interdiction.name: RESPONSIVE DISPLACEMENT
Immaterial Interdiction.flavor: Masters of reading the ebb and flow of battle, Interceptors stay ever on the move and exploit any gap in the enemy lines with lightning swiftness.
Immaterial Interdiction.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a fall-back move, if that INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit is unengaged.
Immaterial Interdiction.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Sanctic Spearhead.name: ABOMINUS-CLASS TARGETS
Sanctic Spearhead.flavor: Eliminating massive priority targets such as diabolical war engines or Warp-tainted monsters is often crucial to victory.
Sanctic Spearhead.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Sanctic Spearhead.target: One Grey Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Sanctic Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Sanctic Spearhead.name: ARGENT WRATH
Sanctic Spearhead.flavor: Blazing with spectral silver flame and surrounded by a keening note of sorcerous dissonance that fills foes with unreasoning terror, this vehicle ploughs into enemy lines like some merciless avatar of destruction.
Sanctic Spearhead.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Sanctic Spearhead.effect: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

Sanctic Spearhead.name: ARMOURED AEGIS
Sanctic Spearhead.flavor: Where purely physical defences may waver or break, sorcerous warding and empyric shields can take the strain their place.
Sanctic Spearhead.target: One Grey Knights Psyker Vehicle unit from your army.
Sanctic Spearhead.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

Sanctic Spearhead.name: FORCE WAVE
Sanctic Spearhead.flavor: A bow wave of psychic force slams out ahead of this vehicle, ploughing obstacles from its path and forming invisible bridges over yawning chasms.
Sanctic Spearhead.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Sanctic Spearhead.target: One Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Sanctic Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Sanctic Spearhead.name: REDOUBLED ASSAULT
Sanctic Spearhead.flavor: Charged with smashing a path through the enemy lines to vital objectives, this war machine lands blow after relentless blow.
Sanctic Spearhead.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army Falls Back.
Sanctic Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Sanctic Spearhead.name: TRUESILVER WILL
Sanctic Spearhead.flavor: The combination of a Grey Knight's psychic fortitude with the warding circuitry of their armoured vehicles is potent indeed.
Sanctic Spearhead.when: Any phase, just after a Grey Knights Psyker Vehicle unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
Sanctic Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

Void Purge Force.name: BREACH-SHOCK
Void Purge Force.flavor: So swift and overwhelming is a boarding assault by the Grey Knights that foes are overrun in short order before they even realise their peril.
Void Purge Force.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Void Purge Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Void Purge Force.name: HEXBANE WARDS
Void Purge Force.flavor: These unsettling hexagrammatic wards, inscribed on the Grey Knights' wargear before boarding, cause enemy weapons to falter and misfire as machine spirits are banished or tormented to madness.
Void Purge Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Void Purge Force.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Void Purge Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

Void Purge Force.name: SANCTIFIED SLAUGHTER
Void Purge Force.flavor: With their foes cornered, the Grey Knights’ blades rise and fall, the purge thorough and unmerciful.
Void Purge Force.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that charged this turn.
Void Purge Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Void Purge Force.name: TRANSLOCATION
Void Purge Force.flavor: Employing single-use microteleportation matrices or focused psychic powers, these Grey Knights step through the warp and back to realspace in an eyeblink.
Void Purge Force.target: One INTERcEPTOR SqUAD or GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Void Purge Force.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
Void Purge Force.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Warpbane Task Force.name: AEGIS ETERNAL
Warpbane Task Force.flavor: Channelling their shared psychic potential, these warriors form a coruscating aurora that courses through the warding sigils of their armour, causing them to flare with protective power.
Warpbane Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Warpbane Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Warpbane Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Warpbane Task Force.name: FIRES OF COVENANT
Warpbane Task Force.flavor: As the enemy moves close, these warriors draw upon their pledges of duty and the bonds of their brotherhood to unleash a fiery conflagration of arcane death.
Warpbane Task Force.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Warpbane Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army.
Warpbane Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Warpbane Task Force.name: FLAMES OF SANCTITY
Warpbane Task Force.flavor: As the Purifiers battle, their pooled psychic might manifests in a corona of flame that is anathema to the unclean.
Warpbane Task Force.target: One Purifier Squad unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
Warpbane Task Force.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes Castellan Crowe: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Warpbane Task Force.name: HALLOWED BEACON
Warpbane Task Force.flavor: Newly sanctified ground serves as a luminescent beacon to guide warded battle-brothers stepping through glowing empyric gateways.
Warpbane Task Force.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Warpbane Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit (excluding Terminator units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
Warpbane Task Force.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

Warpbane Task Force.name: REPELLING SPHERE
Warpbane Task Force.flavor: Chanting a chorus of warding spells, the Grey Knights project a shimmering field of empyric forces that repels their foes.
Warpbane Task Force.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Warpbane Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army.
Warpbane Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

Warpbane Task Force.name: SANCTIFIED KILL ZONE
Warpbane Task Force.flavor: As new ground is seized and consecrated, so are the Grey Knights lent greater ferocity and resolve.
Warpbane Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Warpbane Task Force.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
Warpbane Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a Purifier Squad.

Armoured Trailblazers.name: BUILT TO LAST
Armoured Trailblazers.flavor: Intended to shrug off the worst punishment by hostile alien environments, not to mention the hostile aliens themselves, Sagitaurs can withstand remarkable quantities of enemy fire.
Armoured Trailblazers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SAGITAUR unit.
Armoured Trailblazers.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Armoured Trailblazers.name: COORDINATED CROSSFIRE
Armoured Trailblazers.flavor: With their quarry caught outflanked and in the open, the Sagitaurs’ gunners coordinate fire to pick them apart with swift efficiency.
Armoured Trailblazers.target: Up to two friendly SAGITAUR units.
Armoured Trailblazers.effect:
Select one enemy unit. Your units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can:
  • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Armoured Trailblazers.name: OUTFLANKING ARMOUR
Armoured Trailblazers.flavor: With the foes’ weaknesses identified, outflanking Sagitaurs streak in to exploit the gaps and punch deep into their lines.
Armoured Trailblazers.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
Armoured Trailblazers.target: Up to two friendly SAGITAUR units in strategic reserves.
Armoured Trailblazers.effect: Your units each make an ingress move.

Brandfast Oathband.name: BASTION RUNNING
Brandfast Oathband.flavor: A Hekaton Land Fortress can be temporarily rigged by its crew for bastion running. They fortify its systems to provide a brief power surge, allowing the tank to smash its way through hostile environments.
Brandfast Oathband.target: One Hekaton Land Fortress unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Brandfast Oathband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Brandfast Oathband.name: ILLUMINATED PRIORITY
Brandfast Oathband.flavor: Using specialised beam emission signatures, multispectral ammunition, or broadcasting targeting data, the gunnery crews of Kin war engines can signify priority targets for their comrades.
Brandfast Oathband.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Leagues of Votann Vehicle unit from your army has shot.
Brandfast Oathband.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a Leagues of Votann Infantry model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

Brandfast Oathband.name: INEXORABLE EFFICIENCY
Brandfast Oathband.flavor: With the wealth of sensor-wrought information they can access, the Kin can efficiently adapt fighting withdrawals into deadly counterattacks.
Brandfast Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann unit from your army.
Brandfast Oathband.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Brandfast Oathband.name: OPPORTUNISTIC ESCALATION
Brandfast Oathband.flavor: Even amid heavy incoming fire, the crew of a kinhost's lighter vehicles can make rapid manoeuvres to exploit sudden openings.
Brandfast Oathband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if units from your army have Hostile Acquisition.
Brandfast Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann Vehicle unit from your army (excluding Hekaton Land Fortress units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
Brandfast Oathband.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Brandfast Oathband.name: SECURE POSITIONS
Brandfast Oathband.flavor: While there are resources to secure, the Kin will seize any opportunity to effect a rapid and ordered deployment to establish defensive positions.
Brandfast Oathband.when: End of any of your phases.
Brandfast Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann Transport unit from your army.
Brandfast Oathband.effect: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your TRANSPORT. That unit cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally in the remainder of the turn.

Brandfast Oathband.name: VENGEANCE FLARE
Brandfast Oathband.flavor: With a narrow-band data burst, those of an oathband who have been wronged can call in the devastating vengeance of their armoured support.
Brandfast Oathband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Brandfast Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
Brandfast Oathband.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one friendly Kapricus or Sagitaur unit within 6" of your INFANTRY unit. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, you can select one friendly Hekaton Land Fortress unit within 6" of your INFANTRY unit instead. The selected unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, models in the selected unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

Dêlve Assault Shift.name: AUGMENTED ASSAULT
Dêlve Assault Shift.flavor: The profusion of bionic augmentations that Beserks possess can grant them a burst of incredible speed, one that can drive them - a guttural war song on their lips - into their reeling foes like a meteor.
Dêlve Assault Shift.group: LEAGUES OF VOTANN - Dêlve Assault Shift
Dêlve Assault Shift.target: One Cthonian Beserks unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Dêlve Assault Shift.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend up to 2YP. Until the end of the turn, add X" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, where X is the number of YP you spent during this use of this Stratagem, and your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Dêlve Assault Shift.name: CYBERSTIMM INFUSION
Dêlve Assault Shift.flavor: The subdermal shunts of Cthonian Beserks can flood their bodies with stimulant chemicals. So empowered, they can smash through the toughest of enemies as easily as an obdurate ore seam.
Dêlve Assault Shift.group: LEAGUES OF VOTANN - Dêlve Assault Shift
Dêlve Assault Shift.target: One Cthonian Beserks unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Dêlve Assault Shift.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Dêlve Assault Shift.name: HIDDEN ACCESSWAYS
Dêlve Assault Shift.flavor: A guild’s elite can swiftly reenter the dêlve’s labyrinth, slipping into an artfully hidden tunnel or activating site-to-site teleports, ready to attack elsewhere at a moment's notice.
Dêlve Assault Shift.group: LEAGUES OF VOTANN - Dêlve Assault Shift
Dêlve Assault Shift.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Dêlve Assault Shift.target: One Cthonian Beserks, Hearthkyn Warriors or Hernkyn Yaegirs unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Dêlve Assault Shift.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Dêlve Assault Shift.name: TECTONIC FRACTURE
Dêlve Assault Shift.flavor: Skilled Cthonian gunners can initiate localised quakes and pressure waves of such intensity that foes struggle to retain their impetus.
Dêlve Assault Shift.group: LEAGUES OF VOTANN - Dêlve Assault Shift
Dêlve Assault Shift.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a CTHONIAN EARTHSHAKERS unit from your army has shot.
Dêlve Assault Shift.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

Dêlve Assault Shift.name: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE
Dêlve Assault Shift.flavor: With their enemies within reach, the Kin’s fury and momentum become an elemental force that will not be stayed.
Dêlve Assault Shift.group: LEAGUES OF VOTANN - Dêlve Assault Shift
Dêlve Assault Shift.target: One Leagues of Votann unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Dêlve Assault Shift.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Piles In or Consolidates, each model in that unit can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Dêlve Assault Shift.name: WEAVEWËRKE BUTTRESS
Dêlve Assault Shift.flavor: Every dêlve is threaded with force fields to shield against catastrophe, a protection that can be tapped in battle to support advances into hostile territory.
Dêlve Assault Shift.group: LEAGUES OF VOTANN - Dêlve Assault Shift
Dêlve Assault Shift.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Hostile Acquisition.
Dêlve Assault Shift.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Dêlve Assault Shift.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Farseekers.name: ECONOMY OF MOTION
Farseekers.flavor: Pioneers operate in great peril behind hostile lines so often that it becomes second nature to respond with alacrity and cunning to the slightest scraps of intelligence on enemy movements.
Farseekers.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PIONEERS unit.
Farseekers.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Farseekers.name: NO SHOT WASTED
Farseekers.flavor: Knowing the burden of responsibility placed upon them by Kindred and Ancestors, Hernkyn focus on their marksmanship with a stern determination that makes every shot count.
Farseekers.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERNKYN unit is selected to shoot.
Farseekers.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Farseekers.name: SCORNFUL ANALYSIS
Farseekers.flavor: Casting a jaundiced eye over the so-called fortifications of their foes, the Hernkyn quickly identify weak spots in the enemy defences and spread the word to their comrades.
Farseekers.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN units’ attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

Hearthband.name: BRËKKEKNOTS
Hearthband.flavor: These micro shield generators, worked into warrior jewellery or armour crests, trigger on command to provide short-lived boosted protection.
Hearthband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hearthband.target: One Kâhl, Ûthar the Destined or Einhyr Hearthguard unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hearthband.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Hearthband.name: FURY OF THE HEARTH
Hearthband.flavor: As though they unleash the raging flames of their kindred’s hearth upon the enemy, the Einhyr all but drown their enemies in fire.
Hearthband.target: One Einhyr Hearthguard unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Hearthband.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. If you spend 1YP, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability as well.

Hearthband.name: MATERIALISATION MATRICES
Hearthband.flavor: Built to a superior standard using secrets imparted by the Votann, the teleporters employed by this Hearthband can stabilise rematerialisation fields remarkably close to the foe.
Hearthband.when: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Hearthband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that is in Reserves and has the Deep Strike ability.
Hearthband.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
Hearthband.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Hearthband.name: SUPERIOR CRAFTSMANSHIP
Hearthband.flavor: Not only are the finest of the Kindred’s warriors selected for this duty, but they are also equipped with the best weaponry and wargear the Brôkhyr can produce.
Hearthband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Hearthband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Hearthband.name: SURE OF PURPOSE
Hearthband.flavor: The single-minded advance of the Kin rolls over collapsing enemy lines and exploits every fault and weakness, driving on towards the objective.
Hearthband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Hearthband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Hearthband.name: UNYIELDING AGGRESSION
Hearthband.flavor: Even should they be compelled to pull back momentarily, the warriors of the Hearthband maintain a punishing curtain of fire to erode the enemy further or rally swiftly and drive back into the fight.
Hearthband.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit from your army Falls Back.
Hearthband.target: That Leagues of Votann Infantry unit.
Hearthband.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Hearthfire Strike.name: ECONOMY OF AGGRESSION
Hearthfire Strike.flavor: A few grenades placed with care and skill reap greater returns in bloodshed than a wealth of recklessly hurled materiel.
Hearthfire Strike.target: One EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Hearthfire Strike.effect: Select one enemy unit that is visible to your unit and wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from it. Until the end of the phase, exo-armour grenade launchers equipped by models in your unit have an Attacks characteristic of 6 and lose the [BLAST] ability while targeting that enemy unit, and attacks made with such weapons that target that enemy unit can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

Hearthfire Strike.name: GRAVITRONIC PULSE
Hearthfire Strike.flavor: Emitters built into this squad's exo-armour batter the foe with focused gravity waves in the instant before the Kin charge crashes home.
Hearthfire Strike.when: Your Charge phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Hearthfire Strike.effect: For each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, until the end of the turn, that unit loses the Fights First ability (if it has it) and, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Hearthfire Strike.name: PAN-SPECTRAL VISUALISER
Hearthfire Strike.flavor: These advanced sets of helm optics pierce veils both technological and sorcerous, laying the foe bare.
Hearthfire Strike.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Hearthfire Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s or that weapon’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

Hearthfire Strike.name: WEAVEFIELD FLARE
Hearthfire Strike.flavor: Triggering weavefield generators worked into their wargear, the Einhyr bleed off the power of incoming enemy attacks.
Hearthfire Strike.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hearthfire Strike.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hearthfire Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Hearthfyre Arsenal.name: COGITATED NEED
Hearthfyre Arsenal.flavor: Focused on aiding their kindred to the best of their abilities, Ironkin Steeljacks locked onto an identified asset will push onward regardless of obstacles.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.target: One Ironkin Steeljacks unit from your army.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move. When doing so, your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker.

Hearthfyre Arsenal.name: DELAYED-FIRE ROUNDS
Hearthfyre Arsenal.flavor: Exotic munitions can seed enemy lines with slow-reiease death, stalling those who neutralise the threat while ravaging any who push on.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Brôkhyr, Ironkin Steeljacks or Arkanyst Evaluator unit from your army has shot.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time that enemy unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, roll one D6 for each model in that unit: for each 1, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Hearthfyre Arsenal.name: FIRST CONCERN
Hearthfyre Arsenal.flavor: Only after executing their prepared firing solutions will the kinhost's heaviest gun lines move on, dispassionately assessing their next target.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Brôkhyr, Ironkin Steeljacks or Arkanyst Evaluator unit from your army has shot.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.effect: If your unit Remained Stationary in your Movement phase this turn, it can make a Normal move.

Hearthfyre Arsenal.name: PREVENTATIVE PURGE
Hearthfyre Arsenal.flavor: Using their strength and rapid target acquisition subroutines to alter fire arcs swiftly, Thunderkyn and Steeljacks are skilled in focusing on escaping foes that might pose a future threat.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.target: One Brôkhyr Thunderkyn or Ironkin Steeljacks unit from your army.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Hearthfyre Arsenal.name: UNWAVERING ACCURACY
Hearthfyre Arsenal.flavor: Besides offering stable fire platforms, exoframes have multiple targeting and sensor subsystems that cut through foes' duplicitous evasion.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.target: One Brôkhyr Thunderkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll; that attack’s Armour Penetration characteristic.

Hearthfyre Arsenal.name: WALL OF STEEL
Hearthfyre Arsenal.flavor: Ironkin Steeljacks use their indomitable strength and bulk on the charge to crush enemy infantry in brutal, mechanised body slams.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.when: Your Charge phase, just after an Ironkin Steeljacks unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Hearthfyre Arsenal.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, rolling two additional D6 if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Hearthguard Covenant.name: BRËKKEKNOTS
Hearthguard Covenant.flavor: These micro shield generators, worked into warrior jewellery or armour crests, trigger on command to provide short‑lived boosted protection.
Hearthguard Covenant.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit.

Hearthguard Covenant.name: FURY OF THE HEARTH
Hearthguard Covenant.flavor: As though they unleash the raging flames of their kindred’s hearth upon the enemy, the Einhyr all but drown their enemies in fire.
Hearthguard Covenant.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit is selected to shoot.
Hearthguard Covenant.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • If you spend 1 YP, [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Hearthguard Covenant.name: MATERIALISATION MATRICES
Hearthguard Covenant.flavor: Built to a superior standard using secrets imparted by the Votann, the teleporters employed by this Hearthband can stabilise rematerialisation fields remarkably close to the foe.
Hearthguard Covenant.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit with Deep Strike is selected to make an ingress move.
Hearthguard Covenant.effect:
• Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Mercenary Oathband.name: AUXILIARY CONTRACT
Mercenary Oathband.flavor: Mercenary Kin are no strangers to working more than one seam of wealth at once, and extra contracts to slay or capture individuals or to gather specific trophies can be highly profitable.
Mercenary Oathband.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Mercenary Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry or Leagues of Votann Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Mercenary Oathband.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

Mercenary Oathband.name: GRAND ARTIFICE
Mercenary Oathband.flavor: Unfazed by deception where it serves a practical use, Kin privateers willingly effect a seemingly ragged retreat only to turn back into the fight from a more advantageous position the moment they are clear of the mire of foes.
Mercenary Oathband.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
Mercenary Oathband.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Mercenary Oathband.name: MOBILE EXPLOITATION
Mercenary Oathband.flavor: The Hernkyn of mercenary oathbands are swift to outflank and outmanoeuvre the enemy, seeking avenues by which to punish any vulnerability as well as scouting for new sources of wealth.
Mercenary Oathband.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Mercenary Oathband.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Alternatively, you can spend 2YP and target up to two HERNKYN units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units instead.
Mercenary Oathband.effect: Remove your units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Mercenary Oathband.name: NEW HORIZONS
Mercenary Oathband.flavor: Efficient and eager to stake their next claim, the Kin are ready to board their transports at a moment’s notice to reach fresh prizes.
Mercenary Oathband.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Mercenary Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement range of one or more enemy units and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
Mercenary Oathband.effect: If your LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Mercenary Oathband.name: OPTIMAL EXPENDITURE
Mercenary Oathband.flavor: By expending energy reserves, the Kin’s close-quarter weapons thrum with forgewrought power. The allotment of such resources sees their wielders determined to make every blow strike true.
Mercenary Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Mercenary Oathband.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Mercenary Oathband.name: PRIVATEER ARSENAL
Mercenary Oathband.flavor: Confident their use will turn the tide, the Kin draw on personal caches of munitions, power cells bearing the signatures of acclaimed Brôkhyr or heirloom augurs to unleash a potent fusillade into the foe.
Mercenary Oathband.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Mercenary Oathband.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this usage of this Stratagem, you can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 instead.

Needgaârd Oathband.name: ANCESTRAL SENTENCE
Needgaârd Oathband.flavor: Some foes are so loathed that their ancestors are told to pass a sentence upon them. Marked for death, these enemies suffer the undiluted wrath of the Kin.
Needgaârd Oathband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Needgaârd Oathband.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.

Needgaârd Oathband.name: HONOUR OF THE HOLD
Needgaârd Oathband.flavor: A kinhost's warriors take great pride in their combat proficiency as a symbol of their hold’s honour. The drive to cleave their foes apart is given greater impetus in pursuit of their kindred's needs.
Needgaârd Oathband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Needgaârd Oathband.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.

Needgaârd Oathband.name: HUNTR’S MARK
Needgaârd Oathband.flavor: Sensor-network calibration tied to the HunTR modules on Kin weaponry can portly automate targeting to ensure the uncompromising judgement of the Votann is carried out without fail.
Needgaârd Oathband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Needgaârd Oathband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Needgaârd Oathband.name: ORDERED RETREAT
Needgaârd Oathband.flavor: Not for the Kin the sudden panic of the rout. Instead, they fall back steadily and by squads, laying down suppressing fire while preparing fresh assaults.
Needgaârd Oathband.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
Needgaârd Oathband.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Needgaârd Oathband.name: REACTIVE REPRISAL
Needgaârd Oathband.flavor: Once prizes have been seized, the Kin focus their efforts upon maximising their control and respond with redoubled fury to attempts to loosen their grip.
Needgaârd Oathband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
Needgaârd Oathband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Needgaârd Oathband.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, can only target that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Needgaârd Oathband.name: VOID HARDENED
Needgaârd Oathband.flavor: Between their resilient armour and technology and their capacity to stoically endure pain and suffering, the Kin can weather devastating attacks.
Needgaârd Oathband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
Needgaârd Oathband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Needgaârd Oathband.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Persecution Prospect.name: ADAPTABLE AVARICE
Persecution Prospect.flavor: When opportunity catches the eye of a prospect's commander, they will readily resume a rapid and aggressive footing.
Persecution Prospect.when: Start of any phase, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
Persecution Prospect.target: One Leagues of Votann Character unit from your army.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend any number of YP. Once you have done so, if you have 6 or fewer YP, until the start of your next turn, units from your army have Hostile Acquisition instead.

Persecution Prospect.name: CLAIMSTAKER REFLEX
Persecution Prospect.flavor: The instinct to seize the most advantageous and dominating positions is ingrained in the Kin.
Persecution Prospect.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Persecution Prospect.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army (excluding Artillery and Vehicle units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
Persecution Prospect.restrictions: A unit cannot embark within a Transport as part of this move.

Persecution Prospect.name: DISPERSED FORMATION
Persecution Prospect.flavor: A prospect's warriors will efficiently scatter to minimise the threat of concerted enemy fire.
Persecution Prospect.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Persecution Prospect.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry or Leagues of Votann Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Persecution Prospect.name: EXPOSED FLAWS
Persecution Prospect.flavor: Attuned to discerning imperfections in possible resources, Hernkyn soon spot weaknesses in their foes and are just as swift to profit from them.
Persecution Prospect.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem and/or if that attack targets an assailed unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Persecution Prospect.name: FRONTIER MOMENTUM
Persecution Prospect.flavor: Beyond the frontiers of kindred territory, survival depends upon swiftness of thought and action.
Persecution Prospect.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Persecution Prospect.name: RANGER TACTICS
Persecution Prospect.flavor: Foes thrown into disarray by the Hernkyn offer a vulnerability that is swiftly exploited.
Persecution Prospect.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that attack targets an assailed unit and/or if your unit has the Hernkyn keyword, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Void Salvagers.name: CORRIDOR COVERED
Void Salvagers.flavor: As their allies push forwards, Kin squads train their guns down darkened corridors, preparing to repel unexpected ambushes.
Void Salvagers.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
Void Salvagers.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
Void Salvagers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

Void Salvagers.name: JUDGED AND PUNISHED
Void Salvagers.flavor: To draw the ire of the Kin is to invite a swift and brutal death.
Void Salvagers.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Void Salvagers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target has 1 or more Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if the target has 2 Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

Void Salvagers.name: POINT-BLANK FIRE
Void Salvagers.flavor: The Kin are well used to working in close confines and can fire their ranged weapons with precision even within the restrictive corridors of a voidship.
Void Salvagers.target: One HEARTHKYN WARRIORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Void Salvagers.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

Void Salvagers.name: RELIC CYPHER
Void Salvagers.flavor: The Kin possess the accumulated knowledge of their ancestors, including ancient cyphers that enable them to seize control of cogitational systems.
Void Salvagers.effect: Select one closed Hatchway on the battlefield and open it.
Void Salvagers.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Annihilation Legion.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
Annihilation Legion.flavor: Whatever strange afflictions eat away at the sanity of Destroyers and Flayed Ones, mercy is not one of them.
Annihilation Legion.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.

Annihilation Legion.name: INSANITY’S IRE
Annihilation Legion.flavor: To strike down one horror is merely to draw the rest of the pack's insane and murderous focus.
Annihilation Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit this phase has shot.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Annihilation Legion.name: MASKS OF DEATH
Annihilation Legion.flavor: Wreathed in tendrils of transdimensional shadow that intensify their deathly visages, these killing machines evoke such terror that steady aims tremble and blade arms are sapped of strength.
Annihilation Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Annihilation Legion.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
Annihilation Legion.flavor: Through some quirk of their kind's shared insanity, a spark of gruesome satisfaction surges through them with every enemy life snuffed out, triggering quiescent power reserves that drive them onwards.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.

Annihilation Legion.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
Annihilation Legion.flavor: Driven into a state of hyperaggression, an Annihilation Legion's most eager hunters plunge into their prey's midst to maximise their butchery.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Annihilation Legion.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
Annihilation Legion.flavor: Where one foe falls, logic dictates all others must follow. Where blood is shed, ever must more flow.
Annihilation Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
Awakened Dynasty.flavor: The legions employ the strategies of their masters in perfect synchronicity, laying down hails of mechanically coordinated fire.
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
Awakened Dynasty.flavor: Necron rulers possess enhanced self-repair systems.
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has half of its starting number of wounds remaining. RESTRICTION: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
Awakened Dynasty.flavor: Arcing energies leap from one Necron to the next, lending them unnatural speed and surety
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
Awakened Dynasty.flavor: Nanoscarabs are released in boiling black clouds that whirl about the legions and effect rapid repairs
Awakened Dynasty.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
Awakened Dynasty.flavor: Criss-crossfire leaps from the Necron ranks, forming a blazing corona of deadly energy to punish those who dare threaten the indignant nobility's legions.
Awakened Dynasty.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Canoptek Court.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
Canoptek Court.flavor: With a twist to the fabric of time, a bubble of another moment enshrouds these constructs. Strange emissions from long-dead elder stars or utter darkness from a nighttime far in the future occludes them from their master’s foes.
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Canoptek Court.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Canoptek Court.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Canoptek Court.name: CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK
Canoptek Court.flavor: Vindictive Crypteks often hardwire vengeance sub protocols into the ancient cores of their unliving servants, by which a last act of reprisal is assured.
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Canoptek Court.target:
One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. 
You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Canoptek Court.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Canoptek Court.name: CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION
Canoptek Court.flavor: Only the foolish tread where a Cryptek has set their sights, for these arcane scientists will suffer no threat to their works.
Canoptek Court.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Canoptek Court.target: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army that is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.
Canoptek Court.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Canoptek Court.name: REACTIVE SUBROUTINES
Canoptek Court.flavor: Canoptek constructs spent the long Great Sleep in watchful vigilance. Triggering a surge of power, they are capable of responsive manoeuvres to outwit the swiftest of attackers.
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Canoptek Court.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Canoptek Court.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Canoptek Court.name: SOLAR PULSE
Canoptek Court.flavor: By remotely accessing a hidden engine's most illuminating protocols, a Cryptek can release the awesome power of a caged solar flare.
Canoptek Court.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army.
Canoptek Court.effect: Select one objective marker within 18" of your CRYPTEK model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.

Canoptek Court.name: SUBOPTIMAL FACADE
Canoptek Court.flavor: Canoptek constructs use sophisticated metalogic to craft sinister ambushes. Luring the foe in by appearing at suboptimal operation, a surge of reanimation protocols suddenly swells their numbers.
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
Canoptek Court.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge and is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: NANOSCARAB VIRUS
Canoptek Harvesters.flavor: The Necrons possess swarms of minute nanoscarabs that burrow into power networks and wrest control of cogitator systems.
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: For each open Hatchway within 3" of your unit, you can close that Hatchway.
Canoptek Harvesters.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: PHASE-SHIFT
Canoptek Harvesters.flavor: A Canoptek Wraith's dimensional destabilisation matrix allows it to phase through solid matter to breach sealed hatches and even solid walls.
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CANOPTEK WRAITHS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
Canoptek Harvesters.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: QUANTUM FLARE-SHIELD
Canoptek Harvesters.flavor: Crypteks enhance their living metal forms with all manner of reactive defences, including single-use quantum shields that flare into life to deflect incoming fire.
Canoptek Harvesters.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: TARGETING ALGORITHMS
Canoptek Harvesters.flavor: A Cryptek's enhanced oculars possess exceptional visual acuity. Even in pitch-dark corridors, there can be no hiding from a Cryptek's wrath.
Canoptek Harvesters.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Cryptek Conclave.name: ANIMUS CURSE
Cryptek Conclave.flavor: A portion of the Cryptek’s animus clings to the battlefield just long enough to possess their servants and use them to exact revenge.
Cryptek Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Cryptek Conclave.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
Cryptek Conclave.flavor: This thrumming cloud of minute nanoscarabs whirls around the Necrons, affecting instantaneous repairs.
Cryptek Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: If your unit has the Necron Warriors keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the Immortals keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Cryptek Conclave.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
Cryptek Conclave.flavor: Targeting analysis of the targets’ molecular makeup allows all attempts at shielding or obfuscation to be bypassed with contemptuous ease.
Cryptek Conclave.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the Cryptek keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.

Cryptek Conclave.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
Cryptek Conclave.flavor: Drawing upon the accumulated precausal potential energies that coalesce around significant locations, the conclave are able to steal that power and use it to trigger the unrealized probable remanifestation matrices of their own forces.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a Cryptek unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.

Cryptek Conclave.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
Cryptek Conclave.flavor: Quantum reservoirs of potent energies held within this Cryptek’s warrior jewellery release a fragment of their charge to augment nearby Necron forces.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly NECRONS model has the CRYPTEK keyword.

Cryptek Conclave.name: UNTAPPED POWER
Cryptek Conclave.flavor: Accessing previously undreamed of skeins of cosmic power, the Cryptek unleashes terrible destructive energies onto the battlefield.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.

Cursed Legion.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
Cursed Legion.flavor: The murderous goad of the Destroyer madness pushes these android killers to seemingly impossible efforts to get to grips with the foe.
Cursed Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
Cursed Legion.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Cursed Legion.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

Cursed Legion.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
Cursed Legion.flavor: Confronted with these android spectres of terminal mortality, even the most courageous enemies find their aim wavering and their limbs shaking.
Cursed Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Cursed Legion.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Cursed Legion.name: METHODICAL MURDER
Cursed Legion.flavor: In the grip of the Destroyer madness, these Necrons strike and slay with inhuman speed and efficiency.
Cursed Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Cursed Legion.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Cursed Legion.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
Cursed Legion.flavor: In the absolute destruction of their enemies, the corrupted Necrons find fresh purpose and a macabre simulacrum of new life.
Cursed Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a Destroyer Cult unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
Cursed Legion.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit.
Cursed Legion.effect: The friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.

Cursed Legion.name: SPREADING MADNESS
Cursed Legion.flavor: It is as though witnessing other Necrons engaged in acts of merciless butchery stokes the Destroyer madness in their fellows.
Cursed Legion.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.

Cursed Legion.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
Cursed Legion.flavor: The android soldiery of the cursed legion are maddened with the desire to engage and slay their victims at close quarters.
Cursed Legion.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Cursed Legion.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Cursed Legion.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Deranged Outcasts.name: BATHED IN BLOOD
Deranged Outcasts.flavor: The Destroyer Cults leave only blood, yore and butchered bodies to mark the decks they have taken.
Deranged Outcasts.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army
Deranged Outcasts.effect: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

Deranged Outcasts.name: RUSH TO SLAUGHTER
Deranged Outcasts.flavor: Often drawn to the same blood-soaked environs, Flayed Ones and Destroyers weave around one another in their desire to kill.
Deranged Outcasts.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Deranged Outcasts.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit has the FLAYED ONES keyword, each time it moves, models in that unit can move through friendly DESTROYER CULT models as if they were not there. If your unit has the DESTROYER CULT keyword, models in it can move through friendly FLAYED ONES models as if they were not there.

Deranged Outcasts.name: SHADOW STALKERS
Deranged Outcasts.flavor: Flayed Ones stalk the shadowy perimeters of the battlefield, descending upon the unwary to spill blood and harvest trophies from their corpses.
Deranged Outcasts.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
Deranged Outcasts.target: One FLAYED ONES unit from your army that is in Reserves.
Deranged Outcasts.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.
Deranged Outcasts.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Deranged Outcasts.name: TERRIFYING AMBUSH
Deranged Outcasts.flavor: The sudden appearance through a bulkhead or a hatchway of a blood-slick Necron Destroyer is enough to cause the boldest warrior to quiver.
Deranged Outcasts.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Deranged Outcasts.effect: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, that unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result: if failed, until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.

Hand of the Dynasty.name: DOMINANCE PROTOCOLS
Hand of the Dynasty.flavor: Simple and inescapable directives compel these Immortals to seize strategically vital battlefield sites and fight with redoubled fury to defend them from the foe.
Hand of the Dynasty.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

Hand of the Dynasty.name: NANOSATURATION
