Valourstrike Lance.flavor: Veteran Knight pilots can swiftly re-angle their ion shields and manipulate their energies to deflect incoming firepower.
Valourstrike Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Valourstrike Lance.name: RUN THEM THROUGH!
Valourstrike Lance.flavor: With deafening challenges blaring from their emitters, honour-bound comrades slam into their foes, where the Nobles' martial prowess and their Knight suits’ overwhelming power are wedded to overcome the most monstrous resilience.
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.

Valourstrike Lance.name: TACTICAL FOIL
Valourstrike Lance.flavor: The neural bond through their Throne Mechanicum enables seasoned pilots to accomplish swift counter-monoeuvres seemingly impossible for such towering war engines.
Valourstrike Lance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights model from your army that is within 8" of that unit.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Valourstrike Lance.name: THUNDERSTOMP
Valourstrike Lance.flavor: The Noble brings their Knight suit’s weight down with the force of an industrial piledriver, trampling their honourless foes beneath their iron tread.
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

Valourstrike Lance.name: VOW OF RETRIBUTION
Valourstrike Lance.flavor: With the swearing of cooperative pacts, Knightly companions vow to visit annihilation on their enemies in a searing barrage of retributive firepower.
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Bastions of Tyranny.name: INTIMIDATING REMINDER
Bastions of Tyranny.flavor: With a spiteful lash of suppressive firepower, a Knight Tyrant reminds its foes of the deferent fear and awe that are the only acceptable attitudes in the presence of such power.
Bastions of Tyranny.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit has shot.
Bastions of Tyranny.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next Command phase:
  • While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

Bastions of Tyranny.name: PITILESS FOCUS
Bastions of Tyranny.flavor: Eager to unleash the full power at their fingertips, the scion of a Knight Tyrant will allow nothing to impede their devastating arsenal.
Bastions of Tyranny.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Bastions of Tyranny.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Bastions of Tyranny.name: RUNE-CURSED STRONGHOLD
Bastions of Tyranny.flavor: The mightiest of the Chaos Knights are etched with malign wards capable of shielding them from powerful weapons and throwing back esoteric assaults.
Bastions of Tyranny.when: Any phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit suffers a mortal wound.
Bastions of Tyranny.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Helhunt Lance.name: BEASTHIDE MANIFESTATION
Helhunt Lance.flavor: The raw and bestial power of the Warp causes this Chaos Knight to sprout thick mutant scales and layered hide in response to incoming attacks
Helhunt Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Helhunt Lance.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Helhunt Lance.name: CONTEMPTUOUS VOLLEYS
Helhunt Lance.flavor: No mere prey swirling about their steed’s feet will prevent this scion from focusing their fire.
Helhunt Lance.when: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Falls Back.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Helhunt Lance.name: FERAL ARROGANCE
Helhunt Lance.flavor: This Chaos Knight shrugs off even the most dire hurts as though they are beneath such a mighty, warp‑empowered predator.
Helhunt Lance.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a Chaos Knights unit from your army.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

Helhunt Lance.name: FLUSH THE QUARRY
Helhunt Lance.flavor: Urged on by their masters, the War Dogs push hard through the densest terrain.
Helhunt Lance.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army and up to three friendly War Dog units within 6" of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Helhunt Lance.name: GOADED BEAST
Helhunt Lance.flavor: Firing upon adamantine monsters only goads them to greater wrath and more ferocious bloodshed.
Helhunt Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Helhunt Lance.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6"

Helhunt Lance.name: MERCILESS FUSILLADE
Helhunt Lance.flavor: The scion slaves their servants’ weapons to their own, forming an overwhelming firestorm.
Helhunt Lance.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Helhunt Lance.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army, and up to two friendly War Dog units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those CHAOS KNIGHTS units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Houndpack Lance.name: ANIMALISTIC RAGE
Houndpack Lance.flavor: Many War Dog pilots are bitter and twisted souls whose hearts are filled with animalistic rage, and they will vent that anger with their last dying gasp.
Houndpack Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a WAR DOG unit from your army that has not been selected to attack this phase is destroyed.
Houndpack Lance.target: That WAR DOG unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Before resolving your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit’s Deadly Demise ability as normal.

Houndpack Lance.name: CUNNING HUNTER
Houndpack Lance.flavor: This War Dog's pilot knows when to feign fight or give ground, only to redouble their attack the moment their prey’s guard drops.
Houndpack Lance.when: Your Movement phase, just after a War Dog unit from your army Falls Back.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Houndpack Lance.name: ENCIRCLING PACK
Houndpack Lance.flavor: The War Dogs of the dread household move to outflank and encircle their prey.
Houndpack Lance.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Houndpack Lance.target: One War Dog unit from your army that is wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Houndpack Lance.name: HARRYING HOUNDS
Houndpack Lance.flavor: War Dogs fight with agility and guile, giving ground only to surge in on the attack from another angle.
Houndpack Lance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Houndpack Lance.target: One War Dog unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Houndpack Lance.name: HUNGRY FOR COMBAT
Houndpack Lance.flavor: Eager to get into battle, these War Dogs hope to win glory and prove their worth to peers and masters alike.
Houndpack Lance.target: Two or more War Dog units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those WAR DOG units. Until the end of the phase, models in those WAR DOG units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those WAR DOG units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Houndpack Lance.name: VOX-HOWL
Houndpack Lance.flavor: This artificially generated vox-borne rallying cry booms out across multiple wavelengths. It bolsters the courage of fellow War Dog pilots and their steeds, even as it fills the foes’ communications with squealing scrapcode and monstrous howling.
Houndpack Lance.when: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Houndpack Lance.target: One War Dog Character unit from your army.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each friendly WAR DOG unit that is within 6" of your unit and is Battle-shocked must take a Leadership test; if that test is passed, that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
Houndpack Lance.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

Hunting Warpack.name: INSENSATE BLOODTHIRST
Hunting Warpack.flavor: Gripped by a fever to kill and with prey within reach, whatever damage the prey inflicts is smothered by a War Dog’s thrill of the hunt.
Hunting Warpack.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit.
Hunting Warpack.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+

Hunting Warpack.name: LEASH OF THE MASTERS
Hunting Warpack.flavor: Under the painful neural leash of a Helm Mechanicum, a War Dog pilot’s gory instincts can be overridden to undertake vital operations prioritised by their larger masters.
Hunting Warpack.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WAR DOG unit has shot.
Hunting Warpack.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

Hunting Warpack.name: STALKING FOCUS
Hunting Warpack.flavor: With a prize under their talons, War Dogs are adept at evading the prey’s sight by loping low through cover.
Hunting Warpack.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit within range of an objective.
Hunting Warpack.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: AVENGE THE MASTERS!
Iconoclast Fiefdom.flavor: As the object of their adulation is consumed by fire, mortal worshippers are roused to a desperate fury, seeking vengeance on behalf of their deceased master.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.when: Any phase, when a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect:
That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle.
  • Friendly DAMNED units’ attacks that target a marked unit have [LETHAL HITS].

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: COURSING THRALLS
Iconoclast Fiefdom.flavor: With blaring hunting horns and bellowed calls to their towering masters, mortal thralls signal the location of hiding prey.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect:
Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit is hunted:
  • While a unit is hunted, that unit has +6" detection range.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: DARK SACRIFICE
Iconoclast Fiefdom.flavor: The pilots of corrupted Knight suits demand a ritual offering of their serfs, and their mechanical steed feeds upon the victims’ life forces and raw fear.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.target: One friendly DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS units) within 9" of a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS model.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect:
Select one CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" of your unit and roll D3+3:
  • Your DAMNED unit suffers that number of mortal wounds.
  • That CHAOS KNIGHTS model heals that number of wounds.

Infernal Lance.name: CORRUPTING TAINT
Infernal Lance.flavor: The foul energies and unnatural influence of the Chaos Knights spread from them like sorcerous radiation, tainting all they touch.
Infernal Lance.when: Your Command phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
Infernal Lance.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Infernal Lance.name: DIABOLIC BULWARK
Infernal Lance.flavor: Ectoplasmic blood surges hot through glowing conduits as the Fallen Noble feeds power to their Knight suit’s supernaturally enhanced ion shield emitters.
Infernal Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Infernal Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Infernal Lance.name: HELLFORGED CONSTRUCTION
Infernal Lance.flavor: Reinforced with warp-infused materials and warded through ritual blood sacrifice, these Chaos Knights can withstand unnatural levels of punishment.
Infernal Lance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Infernal Lance.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Infernal Lance.name: PROFANE SYMBIOSIS
Infernal Lance.flavor: Some Fallen Nobles are conjoined, symbiotically or parasitically, with the hideous systems of their Chaos Knight. This allows them to channel more unholy energies, though not without risk.
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is not Empowered.
Infernal Lance.effect: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge.
Infernal Lance.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Infernal Lance.name: UNLEASH BALEFIRE
Infernal Lance.flavor: These weapons bathe the target in blasts of daemonic balefire that burns flesh and soul alike.
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Infernal Lance.effect: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent’s next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

Infernal Lance.name: WARP VISION
Infernal Lance.flavor: Supernatural sensors perceive the soul-spoor of their prey, or even stare forward through fate and time.
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Infernal Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Lords of Dread.name: CLAIMED FOR THE DARK GODS
Lords of Dread.flavor: The Fallen Noble dedicates their latest conquest to the Dark Gods in hope of reward.
Lords of Dread.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
Lords of Dread.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Lords of Dread.name: CRUSHED LIKE VERMIN
Lords of Dread.flavor: Screaming enemy warriors are crushed to gory paste as the Chaos Knight tramples spitefully through their midst, stamping and raking these unworthy foes with its huge, taloned feet.
Lords of Dread.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army ends a Normal move.
Lords of Dread.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Lords of Dread.name: RUNES OF DISDAIN
Lords of Dread.flavor: Inscribed into the Knight suit’s servo-skeleton, these markings channel the pilot’s contempt for the foe and manifest it as a sorcerous aura of defence.
Lords of Dread.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lords of Dread.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lords of Dread.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Lords of Dread.name: SPITEFUL DEMISE
Lords of Dread.flavor: Determined that tales will be told of their spectacular end, the Fallen Noble overloads the internal generators of their Knight suit, hoping to take their enemy with them into oblivion.
Lords of Dread.when: Any phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army is destroyed.
Lords of Dread.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Lords of Dread.effect: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.

Lords of Dread.name: TITANIC DUEL
Lords of Dread.flavor: The Chaos Knights engage in duels not for honour, but to assert their absolute dominance over the battlefield.
Lords of Dread.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Lords of Dread.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Lords of Dread.effect: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Lords of Dread.name: TROPHY HUNTER
Lords of Dread.flavor: To these Fallen Nobles, each new foe chased down is another opportunity to claim gory trophies.
Lords of Dread.when: Fight phase, just before a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army consolidates.
Lords of Dread.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Traitoris Lance.name: A LONG LEASH
Traitoris Lance.flavor: The neural connections between Fallen Nobles and doggedly loyal or fearful War Dog pilots can extend over remarkable distances.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Abhorrent unit from your army and up to two friendly War Dog units.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.

Traitoris Lance.name: CONQUERORS WITHOUT MERCY
Traitoris Lance.flavor: Chaos Knights leave only death and devastation in their wake, and reduce entire worlds to ruin.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test.

Traitoris Lance.name: DISDAIN FOR THE WEAK
Traitoris Lance.flavor: Fallen Nobles sneer at the pathetic efforts of their foes, doubly so in the case of those who fear them.
Traitoris Lance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.

Traitoris Lance.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
Traitoris Lance.flavor: Employing piloting skill or brute force, Fallen Nobles can either manoeuvre or simply barge their steeds through foes and obstacles alike.
Traitoris Lance.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Traitoris Lance.target: Up to two War Dog units from your army or one Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).

Traitoris Lance.name: PTERRORSHADES
Traitoris Lance.flavor: Shrieking with hunger, Pterrorshades descend in a whirlwind to feast on the fearful souls of the foe. Their banquet transmutes into vital energy that flows into the Chaos Knight on which they roost.
Traitoris Lance.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
Traitoris Lance.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Traitoris Lance.name: STORM OF DARKNESS
Traitoris Lance.flavor: Through dark rituals and dread pacts, the Chaos Knights draw upon the fear and despair of their foes and bind it into a curse upon the land itself, wreathing themselves in a shrouding pall.
Traitoris Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Traitoris Lance.effect:
• Your unit has Stealth.
  • Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

1st Company Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
1st Company Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
1st Company Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

1st Company Task Force.name: DUTY AND HONOUR
1st Company Task Force.flavor: Adeptus Astartes veterans claim critical objectives in daring strikes, annihilating resistance in their Chapter’s name before sweeping onto their next target.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
1st Company Task Force.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

1st Company Task Force.name: HEROES OF THE CHAPTER
1st Company Task Force.flavor: When the fighting is at its fiercest, the veteran warriors of the Chapter truly show their quality.
1st Company Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

1st Company Task Force.name: LEGENDARY FORTITUDE
1st Company Task Force.flavor: Many are the legendary tales of the 1st Company holding their ground against the odds, weathering assaults that would have swept away lesser warriors.
1st Company Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

1st Company Task Force.name: ORBITAL TELEPORTARIUM
1st Company Task Force.flavor: Teleportarium chambers within orbiting strike cruisers are able to perform site-to-strike teleportations for Terminator-armoured battle-brothers in extremis.
1st Company Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability.
1st Company Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

1st Company Task Force.name: TERRIFYING PROFICIENCY
1st Company Task Force.flavor: The 1st Company's veterans unleash their skills with an efficiency that is harrowing to witness.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
1st Company Task Force.effect: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Angelic Inheritors.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Angelic Inheritors.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes, combined with their transhuman physiology, makes them unyielding foes to face.
Angelic Inheritors.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Angelic Inheritors.name: FOCUSED FURY
Angelic Inheritors.flavor: Keeping the beast within under tight control, the Blood Angels nonetheless tap into that inner rage and shackle it to their precisely aimed blows.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Character unit, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [LANCE] ability as well.

Angelic Inheritors.name: IN THE SHADOW OF GREAT WINGS
Angelic Inheritors.flavor: The enemy is engulfed in a soul-deep shadow for just a moment, as though mighty wings have spread above them and marred their vision with occluding darkness.
Angelic Inheritors.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Angelic Inheritors.name: INSTANT OF GRACE
Angelic Inheritors.flavor: In this most desperate moment of need, a lone battle-brother rises to the challenge as a true inheritor of the Angel’s legacy.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Select one non-CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the Character keyword. Designer’s Note: While in effect, your model’s unit is therefore a CHARACTER unit, meaning it can interact with the Legacy of the Angel Detachment rule, in addition to other rules that interact with CHARACTER units.

Angelic Inheritors.name: STRIKE NOW FOR GLORY
Angelic Inheritors.flavor: Knowing instinctively that the pivotal moment has arrived, these battle-brothers aim and hammer their foes with unrelenting volleys.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Angelic Inheritors.name: UNTO THE BURNING SKIES
Angelic Inheritors.flavor: In the face of encroaching doom, as the world seems to burn around them, these scions of Sanguinius leap high into the tormented heavens, ready to strike down with vengeful fury upon the enemy teeming below.
Angelic Inheritors.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, unless it is The Sanguinor.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Anvil Siege Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Anvil Siege Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Anvil Siege Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Anvil Siege Force.name: BATTLE DRILL RECALL
Anvil Siege Force.flavor: Space Marines train for countless hours to master their weapons and in the heat of battle can trigger mnemonic patterning to recall their ritual drills and ensure the foe’s destruction.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If your unit Remained Stationary this turn, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Anvil Siege Force.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
Anvil Siege Force.flavor: Space Marines' incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.
Anvil Siege Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Anvil Siege Force.name: NO THREAT TOO GREAT
Anvil Siege Force.flavor: To combat an entrenched force of Space Marines, foes resort to armoured vehicles or packs of murderous monstrosities. Even the greatest of behemoths has a chink in its armour and the Adeptus Astartes are well versed in exploiting such weaknesses.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Anvil Siege Force.name: NOT ONE BACKWARDS STEP
Anvil Siege Force.flavor: Siege warfare is incomparably brutal. Space Marines battle with the fiercest determination to achieve victory, and will fight unto death to hold every defensive line or to secure gains they have wrested from the enemy.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army within range of an objective marker.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, double the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit, but it must Remain Stationary this turn.

Anvil Siege Force.name: RIGID DISCIPLINE
Anvil Siege Force.flavor: Cleaving to duty, the Adeptus Astartes refuse to be drawn out of position. Instead they secure ground to establish new fire lines to the enemy.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Your unit can immediately make a Fall Back move of up to 6".
Anvil Siege Force.restrictions: When making that move, your unit must end that move either wholly within your deployment zone or within range of an objective marker.

Armoured Speartip.name: ADVANCED DEPLOYMENT
Armoured Speartip.flavor: Coaxing the utmost from roaring engines, transport crews strive to deploy their passengers as close as possible to their assigned objectives.
Armoured Speartip.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the end of the phase, units can disembark from your TRANSPORT after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move this phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn (unless your TRANSPORT has the Assault Ramp ability), but can otherwise act normally.

Armoured Speartip.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Armoured Speartip.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Armoured Speartip.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armoured Speartip.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Armoured Speartip.name: CERAMITE SLEDGEHAMMER
Armoured Speartip.flavor: The mightiest Space Marine transports are unstoppable on the advance.
Armoured Speartip.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features. In addition, if your unit is a Heavy Transport, when making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Armoured Speartip.name: MACHINE WRATH
Armoured Speartip.flavor: In a last act of vengeance, the doomed crew of this burning transport drive into the midst of the enemy.
Armoured Speartip.when: Any phase, just after a Heavy Transport unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
Armoured Speartip.target: That HEAVY TRANSPORT unit, if you rolled a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Armoured Speartip.name: PURGATION DOCTRINE
Armoured Speartip.flavor: Emerging from their transports, Space Marine infantry ruthlessly clear enemy positions.
Armoured Speartip.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll (if your unit disembarked from a Heavy Transport this turn, add 1 to the Wound roll as well).

Armoured Speartip.name: RAPID EMBARKATION
Armoured Speartip.flavor: With steely discipline, Space Marine battle-brothers mount up swiftly, even as the enemy closes in.
Armoured Speartip.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and one friendly Heavy Transport it is able to embark within.
Armoured Speartip.effect: If your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that HEAVY TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Bastion Task Force.name: CODEX DISCIPLINE
Bastion Task Force.flavor: Holding to the teachings of the Codex Astartes, these warriors unleash disciplined volleys of firepower.
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Bastion Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Bastion Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that target is auspex scanned, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

Bastion Task Force.name: GUIDED DISRUPTION
Bastion Task Force.flavor: Employing auspex data to reveal weak points in the foe’s formation, the Space Marines exploit these to sow confusion and suppress their targets.
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army has finished making its attacks.
Bastion Task Force.effect: When an enemy unit is auspex scanned as a result of those attacks this turn, if that enemy unit does not have the MONSTER or VEHICLE keywords, until the start of your next turn, it is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

Bastion Task Force.name: HERESY UNDONE
Bastion Task Force.flavor: Tactical scans and cogitator analysis have revealed the enemy’s debase schemes, rendering their movements easier to anticipate and counter.
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
Bastion Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Battleline units) from your army.
Bastion Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. If it does, every target of that charge and every target of those attacks must be an auspex scanned unit.

Bastion Task Force.name: LIGHT OF VENGEANCE
Bastion Task Force.flavor: With their frailties exposed by the harsh glare of auspex analysis, the foe are easy prey for the Space Marine’s vengeful onslaught.
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Bastion Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Bastion Task Force.effect: Select the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability while targeting an auspex scanned unit or if the bearer has the Battleline keyword.

Bastion Task Force.name: SHOCK BOMBARDMENT
Bastion Task Force.flavor: An auspex-guided hail of shock charges blinds the foe’s targeting systems and skews their aim.
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army finished making its attacks.
Bastion Task Force.effect: When an enemy unit is auspex scanned as a result of those attacks this turn, until the start of your next turn, it is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Black Spear Task Force.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
Black Spear Task Force.flavor: Only a truly versatile approach to warfare allows the tactical genius of the Deathwatch to best the myriad xenos foes they face.
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: Up to two Kill Team units from your army, or one other ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: For each unit targeted, select Furor Tactics, Malleus Tactics or Purgatus Tactics. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Mission Tactic is active for that unit instead of any Mission Tactic that is active for your army.

Black Spear Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Black Spear Task Force.flavor: The belligerency and transhuman physiologies of the Adeptus Astartes make them unyielding foes.
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Black Spear Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Black Spear Task Force.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
Black Spear Task Force.flavor: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
Black Spear Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

Black Spear Task Force.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
Black Spear Task Force.flavor: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities.
Black Spear Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Dragonfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

Black Spear Task Force.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
Black Spear Task Force.flavor: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve the Range characteristic of those weapons by 6".
Black Spear Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Dragonfire Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

Black Spear Task Force.name: SITE-TO-SITE TELEPORTATION
Black Spear Task Force.flavor: Site-to-site battlefield teleportation is a rare capability indeed, used only by the Deathwatch in extreme situations.
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Black Spear Task Force.target: Up to two Kill Team units from your army, or one other Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army, if those units are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. Until the end of your next Movement phase, models in those units that do not have the Deep Strike ability have the Deep Strike ability.

Blade of Ultramar.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Blade of Ultramar.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Blade of Ultramar.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Blade of Ultramar.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Blade of Ultramar.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
Blade of Ultramar.flavor: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.

Blade of Ultramar.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
Blade of Ultramar.flavor: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.
Blade of Ultramar.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.

Blade of Ultramar.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
Blade of Ultramar.flavor: After rapidly making a theoretical assessment of the foes’ probable next moves, the Ultramarines apply practical repositioning to counter them.
Blade of Ultramar.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Blade of Ultramar.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is under the effects of the Tactical Doctrine.

Blade of Ultramar.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
Blade of Ultramar.flavor: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.
Blade of Ultramar.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Blade of Ultramar.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Blade of Ultramar.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
Blade of Ultramar.flavor: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth – theoretical and practical – of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Select the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for your unit instead of any other Combat Doctrine that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Combat Doctrine this battle.

Boarding Strike.name: CERAMITE BULWARK
Boarding Strike.flavor: The Space Marines present a wall of ceramite and plasteel shoulder guards to the breach as they force passage through.
Boarding Strike.target: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Boarding Strike.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.

Boarding Strike.name: DUTY AND DEFIANCE
Boarding Strike.flavor: Even when wounded unto death, still the Adeptus Astartes fight on in hopes their final efforts will spell the difference between defeat and victory.
Boarding Strike.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Boarding Strike.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Boarding Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Boarding Strike.name: IN THE EMPEROR’S NAME
Boarding Strike.flavor: Space Marines will suffer any hardship and endure the savagery of the most monstrous foes to see their duty done.
Boarding Strike.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Boarding Strike.target: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Boarding Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Boarding Strike.name: VOX-AMPLIFIED ROAR
Boarding Strike.flavor: In the echoing confines of a voidship, the deafening battle cries of the Space Marines evoke terror in the foe.
Boarding Strike.when: Your Charge phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army declares a charge.
Boarding Strike.effect: Each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Ceramite Sentinels.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
Ceramite Sentinels.flavor: Auto-sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Select either the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. If your unit is ENTRENCHED, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities instead.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
Ceramite Sentinels.flavor: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is ENTRENCHED, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit can move.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
Ceramite Sentinels.flavor: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: STAND TO THE END
Ceramite Sentinels.flavor: Aware of how vital it is that the defence line holds, these warriors fight even to their last breath.
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if it is an ENTRENCHED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
Ceramite Sentinels.flavor: Knowing that this strategically vital site must be secure for the defence lines to hold, Space Marines stand indomitable in the face of the foe.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in your unit.

Champions of Fenris.name: RUNES OF CLAIMING
Champions of Fenris.flavor: A few quick cuts with a diamond-keen hunting knife or energised claw tip leave Fenrisian runes carved into bedrock, plasteel or flesh, marks of abjuration against the foe and secret messages between Space Wolves alike.
Champions of Fenris.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit.
Champions of Fenris.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

Champions of Fenris.name: STALK BETWEEN WORLDS
Champions of Fenris.flavor: This champion possesses nigh-preternatural stealth and cunning, stalking their prey like some predatory terror circling the dying campfire of its doomed quarry.
Champions of Fenris.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit.

Champions of Fenris.name: WOLF TOTEMS
Champions of Fenris.flavor: Be it the power of belief or something a little more eldritch, the Space Wolves’ trust in their various protective amulets and totems is often borne out.
Champions of Fenris.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit suffers a mortal wound.
Champions of Fenris.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Companions of Vehemence.name: DEVOUT PUSH
Companions of Vehemence.flavor: With a zealous cry, the Black Templars press forward, using their ceramite-armoured bulk to smash into the foe and overwhelm the enemy's lines.
Companions of Vehemence.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Companions of Vehemence.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
Companions of Vehemence.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted with this and the Hearts Hardened to Duty Stratagem in the same phase unless it has the Chaplain or Judiciar keywords.

Companions of Vehemence.name: DREAD CRUSADERS
Companions of Vehemence.flavor: To face the Emperor's transhuman crusaders as they chant their litanies of detestation can chill the soul.
Companions of Vehemence.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
Companions of Vehemence.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
Companions of Vehemence.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Companions of Vehemence.name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR!
Companions of Vehemence.flavor: Filled with the spirit of Sigismund, his heirs seek out the foe's dark and unclean champions so that they may be crushed in the sight oftheirthralls.
Companions of Vehemence.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Companions of Vehemence.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

Companions of Vehemence.name: HEARTS HARDENED TO DUTY
Companions of Vehemence.flavor: To suffer not blind aggression is to evade the snares of foul deceit and honourably reject self-aggrandisement.
Companions of Vehemence.when: Fight phase, just before an Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army Consolidates.
Companions of Vehemence.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model (or the closest enemy unit if the Suffer Not the Unclean to Live Vow is active for it).

Companions of Vehemence.name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
Companions of Vehemence.flavor: Where enemies dare threaten the warriors of the God-Emperor or seek to escape their deserved death, there must be swift retribution.
Companions of Vehemence.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Companions of Vehemence.target: One CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Companions of Vehemence.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Companions of Vehemence.name: PIOUS ENMITY
Companions of Vehemence.flavor: The warrior priests of a crusade drive Sigismund's heirs into the heart of battle, daring the greatest abominations to face their spiritual strength.
Companions of Vehemence.target: One Chaplain or Judiciar unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Companions of Vehemence.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that target is a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

Company of Hunters.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Company of Hunters.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Company of Hunters.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Company of Hunters.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Company of Hunters.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Company of Hunters.name: DEATH ON THE WIND
Company of Hunters.flavor: The Ravenwing employ shock tactics and focussed firepower to tear bloody paths through the enemy ranks, shattering resistance and clearing the way to their true quarry.
Company of Hunters.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit ends an advance move.
Company of Hunters.effect: That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Company of Hunters.name: HIGH-SPEED FOCUS
Company of Hunters.flavor: Even when travelling at breakneck pace, the Ravenwing control their vehicles with consummate skill and are able to jink and dodge around incoming enemy fire.
Company of Hunters.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Company of Hunters.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Company of Hunters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Company of Hunters.name: HUNTERS’ TRAIL
Company of Hunters.flavor: Using augur beacons, servo-skulls and the like, the Ravenwing mark locations they have passed through and cleansed of foes, laying a trial their fellows can follow on the hunt.
Company of Hunters.target: One Ravenwing Mounted unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
Company of Hunters.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

Company of Hunters.name: RAPID REAPPRAISAL
Company of Hunters.flavor: The Ravenwing scan and analyse their foes’ strategic dispositions constantly, augury and aerial surveillance helping to watch that no quarry slips their closing net. They are quick to redirect combat assets should such a risk present itself
Company of Hunters.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Company of Hunters.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Company of Hunters.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Company of Hunters.name: TALON STRIKE
Company of Hunters.flavor: Be it their true quarry or simply one who possesses knowledge that will lead them to their apprehension, when the Ravenwing strike at a priority target they do so with unmerciful surety.
Company of Hunters.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

Dark Age Arsenal.name: NO SACRIFICE TOO GREAT
Dark Age Arsenal.flavor: In extremis, the invoking of plasma coils’ output may be pushed past even the tolerances proscribed by Mars. The price is one the Chapter is prepared to make.
Dark Age Arsenal.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
Dark Age Arsenal.effect: Your unit’s [HAZARDOUS] plasma ranged attacks have +1 S.

Dark Age Arsenal.name: REVELATION OF GUILT
Dark Age Arsenal.flavor: The weapon spirits of the Dark Angels are known to despise guilt, and gunners who chant the foe’s unrepentant acts may be rewarded with merciless precision.
Dark Age Arsenal.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
Dark Age Arsenal.effect: Your unit’s plasma ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Dark Age Arsenal.name: SEARING BURSTS
Dark Age Arsenal.flavor: When correctly calibrated and respectfully invoked, a plasma incinerator can fire blinding bolts that burst with searing energy. Those not killed are scorched and blistered by near misses.
Dark Age Arsenal.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HELLBLASTER SQUAD unit has shot.
Dark Age Arsenal.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by your unit’s plasma ranged attacks. That enemy unit is seared until the start of your next turn:
  • While a unit is seared, that unit has -2" M.

Darkflight Pursuit.name: SKYBORNE SURVEILLANCE
Darkflight Pursuit.flavor: The auspicators of the Ravenwing are sleepless, and from ideal hunting vantages, there is nowhere the foe can hide for long.
Darkflight Pursuit.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.
Darkflight Pursuit.effect: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.

Darkflight Pursuit.name: WE ARE VENGEANCE
Darkflight Pursuit.flavor: The Ravenwing’s aerial assets are capable of swift and reactive manoeuvring to new firing positions, ensuring opportunities for rapid vengeance.
Darkflight Pursuit.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.
Darkflight Pursuit.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Darkflight Pursuit.name: WINGS OF SHADOW
Darkflight Pursuit.flavor: Through subtle manoeuvring and empowered cameleoline armour, the swiftest of the Ravenwing evade attempts to bring their hunt to an end.
Darkflight Pursuit.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit.

Emperor’s Shield.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Emperor’s Shield.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Emperor’s Shield.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Emperor’s Shield.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Emperor’s Shield.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Emperor’s Shield.name: DISCIPLINED EXTERMINATION
Emperor’s Shield.flavor: Masters of bolter drill, the Imperial Fists utilise precise fire patterns to scour their enemies from hiding places and fell them in droves.
Emperor’s Shield.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Emperor’s Shield.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1.

Emperor’s Shield.name: DROPSHIP EXTRACTION
Emperor’s Shield.flavor: Making use of a lull in fighting, Terminator squads pull back from the front line, boarding airborne transports and withdrawing to prepare their next assault.
Emperor’s Shield.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Emperor’s Shield.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Emperor’s Shield.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Emperor’s Shield.name: FURY OF THE FIRST
Emperor’s Shield.flavor: Losses only serve to stoke the fiery wrath of the Imperial Fists and increase their resolve.
Emperor’s Shield.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Emperor’s Shield.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Emperor’s Shield.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Emperor’s Shield.name: OBDURATE VENGEANCE
Emperor’s Shield.flavor: Even when established wisdom favours retreat, the Imperial Fists remain defiant. Stubborn to the last, they would give their lives in the name of honour and the destruction of their foes.
Emperor’s Shield.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Emperor’s Shield.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Emperor’s Shield.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Emperor’s Shield.name: WRATHFUL CONQUERORS
Emperor’s Shield.flavor: The battle-brothers of the Imperial Fists 1st Company advance with merciless efficiency, eliminating all resistance and staking the Emperor’s claim.
Emperor’s Shield.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
Emperor’s Shield.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any phase.

Encarmine Speartip.name: BLINDING BLURS OF VENGEANCE
Encarmine Speartip.flavor: When they power forward in rapid leaps, the glare emitted by their jump packs’ nacelles reflecting from the mirrored gleam of their armour, the Sanguinary Guard seem to glow with a blinding radiance few can look upon.
Encarmine Speartip.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

Encarmine Speartip.name: INEXORABLE VALOUR
Encarmine Speartip.flavor: Ever reaching for the heights of exemplary valour instilled in their forebears by Sanguinius, the golden host seize every opportunity to claim positions from which to strike anew.
Encarmine Speartip.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.
Encarmine Speartip.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Encarmine Speartip.name: JUDGEMENT OF THE GOLDEN HOST
Encarmine Speartip.flavor: The meteoric impact of the Sanguinary Guard is an unavoidable judgement on those who have incurred the Chapter’s wrath.
Encarmine Speartip.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit from your army ends a charge move.
Encarmine Speartip.effect:
Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Firestorm Assault Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Firestorm Assault Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Firestorm Assault Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Firestorm Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Firestorm Assault Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Firestorm Assault Force.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
Firestorm Assault Force.flavor: To open fire on warriors of a Firestorm Assault Force is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
Firestorm Assault Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Firestorm Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Firestorm Assault Force.effect: One unit embarked within that TRANSPORT can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, and can then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Firestorm Assault Force.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
Firestorm Assault Force.flavor: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
Firestorm Assault Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Firestorm Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Firestorm Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest eligible target within 6", add 1 to the Wound roll.

Firestorm Assault Force.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
Firestorm Assault Force.flavor: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
Firestorm Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Firestorm Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Firestorm Assault Force.name: ONSLAUGHT OF FIRE
Firestorm Assault Force.flavor: Armed with targeting data supplied by their transport's augury gheists, warriors erupt from the assault ramps with weapons blazing in ruthless eradication patterns.
Firestorm Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Firestorm Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target within 12", add 1 to the Hit roll. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as the result of any of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Firestorm Assault Force.name: RAPID EMBARKATION
Firestorm Assault Force.flavor: No time can be wasted in punishing the Emperor's foes. Many are those that deserve death and once one enemy is vanquished, soon must another follow.
Firestorm Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit from your army that has no models embarked within it, and one ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT.
Firestorm Assault Force.effect: Your INFANTRY unit can embark within that TRANSPORT.
Firestorm Assault Force.restrictions: You cannot target an INFANTRY unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that cannot normally embark within that TRANSPORT, or that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

Forgefather’s Seekers.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Forgefather’s Seekers.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Forgefather’s Seekers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Forgefather’s Seekers.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Forgefather’s Seekers.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Forgefather’s Seekers.name: BLAZING EARTH
Forgefather’s Seekers.flavor: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.
Forgefather’s Seekers.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Forgefather’s Seekers.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army equipped with one or more Torrent weapons.
Forgefather’s Seekers.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES and units with the FLY keyword) within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

Forgefather’s Seekers.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
Forgefather’s Seekers.flavor: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
Forgefather’s Seekers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Forgefather’s Seekers.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Forgefather’s Seekers.effect: One unit embarked within that TRANSPORT can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, and can then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Forgefather’s Seekers.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
