Forgefather’s Seekers.flavor: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
Forgefather’s Seekers.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Forgefather’s Seekers.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Forgefather’s Seekers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest eligible target within 6", add 1 to the Wound roll.

Forgefather’s Seekers.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
Forgefather’s Seekers.flavor: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
Forgefather’s Seekers.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Forgefather’s Seekers.effect: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Forgefather’s Seekers.name: WRATHFUL INFERNO
Forgefather’s Seekers.flavor: The enemy has closed with your warriors. Now you have them precisely where you want them. Unleash upon them the fires of damnation.
Forgefather’s Seekers.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army Falls Back.
Forgefather’s Seekers.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Fulguris Task Force.name: ANTI-GRAV SURGE
Fulguris Task Force.flavor: The anti-grav plates of this combat skimmer thrum with extra power, powering the craft into the atmosphere from where it can redeploy.
Fulguris Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Fulguris Task Force.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Fulguris Task Force.name: DATA-LINK AUGURY
Fulguris Task Force.flavor: Speeder crews are trained to exploit their craft’s reconnaissance augurs in a data-link with its weapons to target suddenly revealed foes.
Fulguris Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEEDER unit is selected to shoot.
Fulguris Task Force.effect: Select one enemy unit within 24" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range until your unit has shot.

Fulguris Task Force.name: REACTIVE EVASION
Fulguris Task Force.flavor: Triggering sudden flows of power to engines and manoeuvring planes, aggressive advances by the foe can be left foundering in a skimmer’s wake.
Fulguris Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged SPEEDER unit.
Fulguris Task Force.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Gladius Task Force.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
Gladius Task Force.flavor: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent strategic doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Select the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for that unit instead of any other Combat Doctrine that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that doctrine this battle.

Gladius Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Gladius Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Gladius Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Gladius Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Gladius Task Force.name: HONOUR THE CHAPTER
Gladius Task Force.flavor: Every Chapter has forged its own tales of heroism, and none of its battle-brothers would see that noble record besmirched.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.

Gladius Task Force.name: ONLY IN DEATH DOES DUTY END
Gladius Task Force.flavor: Imminent death does not prevent a Space Marine from enacting his final justice upon the enemies of the Imperium.
Gladius Task Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Gladius Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Gladius Task Force.name: SQUAD TACTICS
Gladius Task Force.flavor: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground in order to leave their enemies floundering, before surging back into the fight and driving them from the field in disarray.
Gladius Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Gladius Task Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is under the effects of the Tactical Doctrine.
Gladius Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Gladius Task Force.name: STORM OF FIRE
Gladius Task Force.flavor: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.
Gladius Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.

Godhammer Assault Force.name: A CEASELESS CAUSE
Godhammer Assault Force.flavor: There is no room for hesitation or exultation for the Black Templars. With one knot of blasphemy expunged, the crusaders surge in search of the next.
Godhammer Assault Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
Godhammer Assault Force.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". It cannot embark within a Transport at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

Godhammer Assault Force.name: BLESSED HULL
Godhammer Assault Force.flavor: Their hulls blessed by the chants of Techmarines and their prayer-servitors, a crusade’s war engines can be entreated to withstand the most malign attacks.
Godhammer Assault Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Godhammer Assault Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Godhammer Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Godhammer Assault Force.name: CONDEMNATORY INFO-SCREED
Godhammer Assault Force.flavor: Prepared within their troop compartment by a broadcast litany of their foe's ungodly sins, the crusaders emerge with their hearts full of hatred.
Godhammer Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Godhammer Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that TRANSPORT has the Land Raider keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Godhammer Assault Force.name: FOCUSED HATRED
Godhammer Assault Force.flavor: Surging from assault ramps, the Black Templars let none bar them from the most unholy threats, using their armoured might to bludgeon a path into battle.
Godhammer Assault Force.when: Your Charge phase, just after you make a Charge roll for an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn.
Godhammer Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Charge move, models in your unit can move through models (when doing so, its models can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but they can only end that move within Engagement Range of enemy models if those enemy models belong to a unit that your unit declared a charge against this turn).

Godhammer Assault Force.name: GAUNTLET OF THE GOD-EMPEROR
Godhammer Assault Force.flavor: Like the mailed fist of the Master of Mankind, the crusade's armoured battle tanks, transports and combat walkers smash their way through choked war zones to reach those deserving execution.
Godhammer Assault Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Godhammer Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Godhammer Assault Force.name: UNCOMPROMISING EGRESS
Godhammer Assault Force.flavor: Little can threaten to overwhelm the venerable Land Raider. Its multiple, hydraulically augmented assault ramps slam into closing aggressors, enabling its deadly cargo to deploy quickly.
Godhammer Assault Force.target: One Land Raider model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Godhammer Assault Force.effect: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within your LAND RAIDER can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your LAND RAIDER and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Hammer of Avernii.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Hammer of Avernii.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Hammer of Avernii.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hammer of Avernii.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hammer of Avernii.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Hammer of Avernii.name: AUGMETIC FORTITUDE
Hammer of Avernii.flavor: Gene-wrought flesh reinforced by hardened augmetics and adamantine armour, the warriors of Clan Company Avernii exhibit nigh-supernatural resilience.
Hammer of Avernii.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
Hammer of Avernii.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Hammer of Avernii.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Hammer of Avernii.name: COGITATED FEROCITY
Hammer of Avernii.flavor: Running endless up-to-the-second cogitations of their foes’ weak spots and vulnerabilities, Avernii veterans place every blow with punishing precision.
Hammer of Avernii.target: One Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Hammer of Avernii.effect: Select either the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

Hammer of Avernii.name: DOMINATOR BEACON
Hammer of Avernii.flavor: These custom-built servo-skulls detach from augmetic tethers as the Iron Hands pass, settling into sentry patterns around vital strategic sites.
Hammer of Avernii.target: One Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
Hammer of Avernii.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the end of a phase.

Hammer of Avernii.name: DROPSHIP EXTRACTION
Hammer of Avernii.flavor: Terminators withdraw from the fight during a lull, board airborne transports and prepare their next assault.
Hammer of Avernii.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Hammer of Avernii.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Hammer of Avernii.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Hammer of Avernii.name: RUTHLESS BUTCHERY
Hammer of Avernii.flavor: The Iron Hands elite kill with machine-like relentlessness, and the tempo of slaughter only increases if they have losses of their own to avenge.
Hammer of Avernii.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Hammer of Avernii.target: One Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Hammer of Avernii.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Headhunter Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Headhunter Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Headhunter Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Headhunter Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Headhunter Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Headhunter Task Force.name: KILL SHOT
Headhunter Task Force.flavor: Space Marines are ruthless in culling weakened foes.
Headhunter Task Force.target: One Tank Ace unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Headhunter Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If the target unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
Headhunter Task Force.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted with this and the Target Weak Point Stratagem in the same phase.

Headhunter Task Force.name: MACHINE VENGEANCE
Headhunter Task Force.flavor: Bellicose in the extreme, this vehicle’s machine spirit demands immediate vengeance for the hurts it has incurred.
Headhunter Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Headhunter Task Force.target: One Tank Ace unit from your army (excluding units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 16+) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Headhunter Task Force.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is visible and an eligible target.

Headhunter Task Force.name: RAPID GUNNERY
Headhunter Task Force.flavor: Advanced targeting systems and the skill of transhuman gunners ensure that Space Marine tanks keep up a punishing rate of fire, even when extracting themselves from a press of enemies.
Headhunter Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Headhunter Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Headhunter Task Force.name: REACTIVE REPOSITIONING
Headhunter Task Force.flavor: Reacting swiftly to enemy movements, this tank’s crew reposition their vehicle, angling armour or taking up an advantageous firing position.
Headhunter Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Headhunter Task Force.target: One Tank Ace unit from your army (excluding units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 16+) that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Headhunter Task Force.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Headhunter Task Force.name: TARGET WEAK POINT
Headhunter Task Force.flavor: Targeting vulnerable joints or seams between armoured plates, Space Marine gunners increase the effectiveness of their weapons.
Headhunter Task Force.target: One Tank Ace unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Headhunter Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Headhunter Task Force.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted with this and the Kill Shot Stratagem in the same phase.

Inner Circle Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Inner Circle Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Inner Circle Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Inner Circle Task Force
Inner Circle Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Inner Circle Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Inner Circle Task Force.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
Inner Circle Task Force.flavor: So driven by duty are the veterans of the Unforgiven that even death cannot keep them from it.
Inner Circle Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Inner Circle Task Force
Inner Circle Task Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Inner Circle Task Force.target: One Deathwing unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Inner Circle Task Force.name: MARTIAL MASTERY
Inner Circle Task Force.flavor: The warriors of the Deathwing fight with the honed skill and lethality of knightly champions.
Inner Circle Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Inner Circle Task Force
Inner Circle Task Force.target: One Deathwing Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Inner Circle Task Force.name: RELIC TELEPORTARIUM
Inner Circle Task Force.flavor: The Deathwing employ ancient and incredibly powerful teleportariums, some older than the Great Crusade, to strike at their foes with unparalleled safety and accuracy.
Inner Circle Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Inner Circle Task Force
Inner Circle Task Force.target: One Deathwing unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
Inner Circle Task Force.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Inner Circle Task Force.name: UNMATCHED FORTITUDE
Inner Circle Task Force.flavor: In the name of their oaths to Chapter, Primarch and Emperor, the Deathwing march into the fiercest firestorms and refuse to falter.
Inner Circle Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Inner Circle Task Force
Inner Circle Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Inner Circle Task Force.target: One Deathwing Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than your unit’s Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Inner Circle Task Force.name: WRATH OF THE LION
Inner Circle Task Force.flavor: Channelling the strategic puissance and measured ferocity of their gene-sire, the veterans of the Unforgiven unleash a perfectly timed and utterly lethal storm of tightly controlled violence.
Inner Circle Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Inner Circle Task Force
Inner Circle Task Force.target: One Deathwing INFANTRY unit from your army that just ended a Charge move.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, adding 1 to the result if that enemy unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 3 mortal wounds).

Interrogation Conclave.name: EXACTING PUNISHMENT
Interrogation Conclave.flavor: With a denunciatory roar, Chaplains lead their battle-brothers in focused assaults to root out the foe’s reviled leaders.
Interrogation Conclave.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit is selected to attack.

Interrogation Conclave.name: TERRIFYING ZEAL
Interrogation Conclave.flavor: The intensity with which the skull-masked Interrogator-Chaplains plunge into the fray can shake the hardiest warriors. All who face them feel the tiniest of guilts eating away at their soul.
Interrogation Conclave.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit ends a charge move.
Interrogation Conclave.effect:
Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a leadership roll:
  • If that leadership roll fails, that enemy unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls until the end of the turn.

Interrogation Conclave.name: WAGES OF COWARDICE
Interrogation Conclave.flavor: The spiritual leaders of the Dark Angels are ever watchful for lapses of conviction, and when displayed by the foe, they are the first to fervently capitalise on them.
Interrogation Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly CHAPLAIN unit ends a fall-back move, if that CHAPLAIN unit is unengaged.
Interrogation Conclave.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: ANCIENT FURY
Ironstorm Spearhead.flavor: The heroes entombed within Dreadnoughts have fought across countless war zones throughout their extended existences, perfecting their martial prowess beyond mortal limits.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER model from your army.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, improve your model’s Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics by 1 and each time your model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Ironstorm Spearhead.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
Ironstorm Spearhead.flavor: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and when making such an attack, if the attacking model is a VEHICLE, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
Ironstorm Spearhead.flavor: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army that was reduced to Below Half-strength as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
Ironstorm Spearhead.flavor: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even injured, they will never abandon their oaths.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
Ironstorm Spearhead.flavor: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

Legacy of Grace.name: AURA OF THE ANGEL’S GRACE
Legacy of Grace.flavor: The indomitable inspiration of their Commander fills the Sons of Sanguinius with the resolve to endure, no matter the foe’s hateful power.
Legacy of Grace.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

Legacy of Grace.name: MARTIAL PARAGON
Legacy of Grace.flavor: Led by the exquisite example of their lord, Blood Angels warriors adapt their deadly fighting tactics to efficiently carve their foe apart.
Legacy of Grace.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit is selected to attack.
Legacy of Grace.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • OR: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Legacy of Grace.name: SOUL-DARKENED FURY
Legacy of Grace.flavor: Nobility’s mirror is a darkness that the greatest Blood Angels risk only momentarily to savagely exploit the foe’s attempt to escape.
Legacy of Grace.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
Legacy of Grace.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

Legends of Saga and Song.name: CHILLING HOWL
Legends of Saga and Song.flavor: Raising their feral voices as one, the elite champions of Fenris give voice to a predatory howl fit to freeze the marrow of the bravest warriors.
Legends of Saga and Song.type: Legends of Saga and Song Stratagem
Legends of Saga and Song.group: SPACE MARINES - Legends of Saga and Song
Legends of Saga and Song.target: One friendly WOLF GUARD TERMINATORS unit.
Legends of Saga and Song.effect: Select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll if that enemy unit is at or below half-strength.

Legends of Saga and Song.name: FANGS OF THE PACK
Legends of Saga and Song.flavor: Fighting as one, the Wolf Guard fall upon an enemy champion and drag them down with single-minded savagery.
Legends of Saga and Song.type: Legends of Saga and Song Stratagem
Legends of Saga and Song.group: SPACE MARINES - Legends of Saga and Song
Legends of Saga and Song.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to fight.

Legends of Saga and Song.name: WINGS OF THE BLIZZARD
Legends of Saga and Song.flavor: A swift extraction by gunship sees the Wolf Guard take to the  skies, ready to strike back onto the battlefield wherever the fighting is most fierce.
Legends of Saga and Song.type: Legends of Saga and Song Stratagem
Legends of Saga and Song.group: SPACE MARINES - Legends of Saga and Song
Legends of Saga and Song.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Legends of Saga and Song.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
Legends of Saga and Song.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Liberator Assault Group.name: AGGRESSIVE ONSLAUGHT
Liberator Assault Group.flavor: The Blood Angels enact a sweeping advance.
Liberator Assault Group.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army has Advanced.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge, even though it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Advanced.

Liberator Assault Group.name: ANGELIC GRACE
Liberator Assault Group.flavor: Sanguinius' sons are blessed with the spiritual fortitude of their Primarch.
Liberator Assault Group.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army has a mortal wound allocated to it.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

Liberator Assault Group.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Liberator Assault Group.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Liberator Assault Group.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Liberator Assault Group.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Liberator Assault Group.name: RED RAMPAGE
Liberator Assault Group.flavor: In times of great desperation, fury and ferocity can be a warrior's strongest allies.
Liberator Assault Group.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Select either the [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, then it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities.

Liberator Assault Group.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
Liberator Assault Group.flavor: When Blood Angels execute a tactical withdrawal it is but a prelude to a renewed assault.
Liberator Assault Group.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge even though it Fell Back. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Fell Back.

Liberator Assault Group.name: SAVAGE ECHOES
Liberator Assault Group.flavor: The Sons of Sanguinius may embrace the Red Thirst but for a moment, if the need arises.
Liberator Assault Group.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was just charged by an enemy unit.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Select either the Strength or Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Lion’s Blade Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their transhuman physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: ILLUMINATING FIRE
Lion’s Blade Task Force.flavor: Ravenwing vehicles tear across the battlefield, identifying priority threats and targeting them with volleys of killing fire. The storm of blazing fury serves as a beacon for the wrathful battle‑brothers of the Inner Circle, who strive to bring final judgement to the foe.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a RAVENWING unit from your army has selected its targets.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly Deathwing unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: INESCAPABLE WRATH
Lion’s Blade Task Force.flavor: The Dark Angels’ Inner Circle warriors pursue the Chapter’s sworn foes and any who shield them with relentless endurance and a determination borne of indoctrinated hatred.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One Deathwing Infantry or Deathwing Walker unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: KNIGHTS OF IRON
Lion’s Blade Task Force.flavor: Atop their snarling mechanical steeds, the warriors of the Ravenwing surge through seemingly impassable terrain, smashing through rubble and ruin to unleash the wrath of the Unforgiven upon unsuspecting targets.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: OVERPOWERING EXACTION
Lion’s Blade Task Force.flavor: Engines roar, and teleportation flares erupt across the battlefield. Such is the din and ferocity of the Dark Angels’ assault that even the most veteran foes are given cause to cower before it.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Command phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, if your unit has the Deathwing or Ravenwing keyword, subtract 1 from the result.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: STRENGTH IN UNITY
Lion’s Blade Task Force.flavor: Combining their specialised methods of warfare, the Ravenwing and Deathwing confound their enemies with high‑speed manoeuvrability and stalwart fortitude.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Ravenwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Deathwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of the target, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Armour of Contempt Stratagem in the same phase.

Marshal’s Household.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
Marshal’s Household.flavor: With roared litanies and incendiary hatred, the Sword Brethren plunge into their foe like a white-hot blade, their armoured momentum cracking armour, crushing bones, and trampling the foe underfoot.
Marshal’s Household.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.
Marshal’s Household.effect:
Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Marshal’s Household.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
Marshal’s Household.flavor: The largest manifestations of the foe’s sin are branded unholy abominations, challenges which a crusade’s champions gladly meet to drive their sanctified weapons deeply beneath their hides.
Marshal’s Household.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
Marshal’s Household.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

Marshal’s Household.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
Marshal’s Household.flavor: Those who attempt to flee their rightful death only stoke their executioners’ hatred all the hotter. None can be spared the God-Emperor’s wrath.
Marshal’s Household.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
Marshal’s Household.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

Orbital Assault Force.name: AUTO‑SENSE COORDINATION
Orbital Assault Force.flavor: By binding the datafeeds from their auto-senses, these battle-brothers generate triangulated targeting solutions for close-quarters fire spreads.
Orbital Assault Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Select the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have this ability in a turn in which they disembarked from a Drop Pod or while targeting an enemy unit within 12".

Orbital Assault Force.name: BLIND SCREEN
Orbital Assault Force.flavor: Autolaunchers spit a precogitated spread of blind grenades to baffle organic and mechanical targeting.
Orbital Assault Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly Adeptus Astartes Smoke Vehicle or Drop Pod unit within 9" of it.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your units have the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets one of your units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Orbital Assault Force.name: ONWARD FOR THE EMPEROR
Orbital Assault Force.flavor: There is always another battle to be fought, and the Space Marines waste no time in fighting it.
Orbital Assault Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was not set up on the battlefield this turn and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: If your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Orbital Assault Force.name: SHOCK ONSLAUGHT
Orbital Assault Force.flavor: The sheer devastating momentum of a Space Marine drop assault shatters one enemy battle line after another.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Orbital Assault Force.name: SUPPRESSION STRAFING
Orbital Assault Force.flavor: As the Space Marines storm forward, their gunships and fighter craft streak overhead, hammering enemy positions with hails of fire to keep the foe pinned.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to and within 18" of your unit. That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from that test and, if that test is failed, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Orbital Assault Force.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Orbital Assault Force.name: TACTICAL DECAPITATION
Orbital Assault Force.flavor: By rapidly eliminating localised enemy leaders, the Space Marines keep the foe off balance and hamper organised resistance to their onslaught.
Orbital Assault Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Pilum Strike Team.name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
Pilum Strike Team.flavor: Moving with alacrity, clearing each new space with exceptional speed and skill, the warriors of the strike team advance on their main objective.
Pilum Strike Team.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

Pilum Strike Team.name: FIGHTING RETREAT
Pilum Strike Team.flavor: These warriors employ cover fire and frag charges to batter the foe as they fall back to new positions.
Pilum Strike Team.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

Pilum Strike Team.name: KNIFE WORK
Pilum Strike Team.flavor: These warriors strike at their enemies'weak spots, aiming to silence the foe without raising the alarm.
Pilum Strike Team.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Pilum Strike Team.name: MASTER MARKSMEN
Pilum Strike Team.flavor: Every shot these warriors fire is placed for maximum impact and swift, decisive kills.
Pilum Strike Team.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: A GRIM WARNING
Rage-cursed Onslaught.flavor: So savagely butchered are the corpses left strewn by the Blood Angels that the mere sight of them gives the enemy pause.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One Blood Angels unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Rage-cursed Onslaught.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes, combined with their transhuman physiology, makes them unyielding foes to face.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: DEATHLESS DUTY
Rage-cursed Onslaught.flavor: Even as death at last smothers the inferno of fury consuming the minds of these lost brethren, they keep killing, until not even the faintest spark remains.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: INSENSATE RAMPAGE
Rage-cursed Onslaught.flavor: The agony of even the most catastrophic wounds means nothing to the warriors of the Death Company, pain finding no purchase on their maddened minds.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: LIMB FROM LIMB
Rage-cursed Onslaught.flavor: While the Blood Angels display skill and discipline at close quarters, it is tinged with a blood-drenched brutality that only increases with their building rage.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Select either the Strength or Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: RED WRATH
Rage-cursed Onslaught.flavor: Already swift and aggressive even by Space Marine standards, the Blood Angels can enhance their might yet further by surrendering temporarily to the Red Thirst, albeit at the cost of higher strategic thought.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Reclamation Force.name: CRUSADING CONQUERORS
Reclamation Force.flavor: The sheer will of these battle-brothers to reclaim the sacred Five Hundred Worlds is overwhelming.
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

Reclamation Force.name: FIGHT TO THE END
Reclamation Force.flavor: Those who have sworn an oath to see Ultramar reclaimed will not yield a single yard of its territories once they have seized and secured them.
Reclamation Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Reclamation Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Reclamation Force.name: FURIOUS DEDICATION
Reclamation Force.flavor: Cold fury of purpose drives the charge of the Space Marines, their absolute dedication to their cause lending them ferocious speed and strength.
Reclamation Force.when: Your Charge phase or the Fight phase.
Reclamation Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not declared a charge or been selected to fight this phase.
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Reclamation Force.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

Reclamation Force.name: MARCHING EVER ON
Reclamation Force.flavor: The road to the complete rebuilding of the Five Hundred Worlds will be a long and gruelling one, and those who fight their way along it cannot pause in their advance for even a moment.
Reclamation Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
Reclamation Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
Reclamation Force.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6"+1.

Reclamation Force.name: SCIONS OF GUILLIMAN
Reclamation Force.flavor: The gene-sons of Roboute Guilliman are masters of his tenets, regardless of which Chapter they hail from.
Reclamation Force.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army ends a Fall Back move.
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Reclamation Force.name: ULTRAMARIAN DESTINY
Reclamation Force.flavor: All those Space Marines fighting to defend or to expand the Ultramarines stellar realm trust that their conquest – though it must be hard fought for – is nothing short of ordained by the Primarch’s will.
Reclamation Force.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: COORDINATED STRIKE
Saga of the Beastslayer.flavor: Space Wolves officers rein in their warriors’ impulsive fury, repositioning them to strike exposed flanks.
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One Space Wolves unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: IMPETUOSITY
Saga of the Beastslayer.flavor: Severe losses only drive Blood Claws and Wulfen forward into the midst of the foe.
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged WULFEN INFANTRY/BLOOD CLAWS unit this phase has shot.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: PINNING FIRE
Saga of the Beastslayer.flavor: Unleashing a storm of firepower, the Space Wolves pin their targets down and halt their advance.
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Until the end of the phase, after your unit has shot, select one enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER, or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, that unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: SHOCK CAVALRY
Saga of the Beastslayer.flavor: Thunderwolf Cavalry bound through friend and foe, leaping over obstacles in pursuit of their foes.
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One Thunderwolf Cavalry unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declared a charge this phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but unless it is making a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: THUNDEROUS PURSUIT
Saga of the Beastslayer.flavor: The relentless endurance of thunderwolf steeds enables the Space Wolves to run down fleeing foes.
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit has the Space Wolves Infantry or Thunderwolf Cavalry keywords, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: UNBRIDLED FEROCITY
Saga of the Beastslayer.flavor: The Space Wolves fight with a savage fury that enables them to overcome even the most resilient targets.
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One Space Wolves unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Saga of the Bold.name: ALPHA STRIKE
Saga of the Bold.flavor: A true alpha wolf leads by example, and is always first into the fray.
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Saga of the Bold.name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
Saga of the Bold.flavor: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.target: One Wolf Guard Headtaker or Wolf Guard Terminator Pack Leader model from your army.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the CHARACTER keyword. Designer’s Note: While in effect, your model’s unit is therefore a CHARACTER unit, meaning it can interact with the Heroes All rule, in addition to other rules that interact with CHARACTER units.

Saga of the Bold.name: CHAMPION’S GUIDANCE
Saga of the Bold.flavor: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Saga of the Bold.target: One Space Wolves Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Saga of the Bold.name: COUNTERCHARGE
Saga of the Bold.flavor: Bellowing encouragement, this warrior rallies his pack and leads a furious counterstrike, intercepting the enemy advance before it can fall upon his allies.
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Saga of the Bold.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Saga of the Bold.name: HEROIC RESOLVE
Saga of the Bold.flavor: This warrior’s indomitable fortitude is the stuff of legend, galvanizing his pack to remain standing before an avalanche of incoming attacks.
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Saga of the Bold.target: One Space Wolves Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Saga of the Bold.name: INSPIRING PRESENCE
Saga of the Bold.flavor: The inspiring presence of a champion lends their pack's strikes lethal impetus.
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: BATTLE INSTINCTS
Saga of the Great Wolf.flavor: These champions of Fenris respond to enemy fire with instinctive swiftness, rarely giving their foes a second chance to shoot at them.
Saga of the Great Wolf.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One Space Wolves unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: EYE OF THE PACK
Saga of the Great Wolf.flavor: Once one Fenrisian warrior has perceived some slight weakness in the defences of their foes, they all strike at it like encircling predators dragging down prey.
Saga of the Great Wolf.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can add 1 to the Wound roll.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: FENRISIAN FEROCITY
Saga of the Great Wolf.flavor: Even the most challenging terrain or formidable fortifications cannot stop the Great Wolf’s chief hunters once they are in motion.
Saga of the Great Wolf.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Adeptus Astartes Walker unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move horizontally through models (excluding TITANIC models) and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within Engagement Range of them.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: GRIMNAR’S COMMAND
Saga of the Great Wolf.flavor: Pivotal as they are to the Great Wolf’s plans, this pack have their own orders to fulfil in this moment that come directly from Grimnar himself.
Saga of the Great Wolf.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Select one Hunting Pack from the Master of Wolves Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hunting Pack is active for your unit instead of any other Hunting Pack that is active, even if you have already selected that Hunting Pack this battle.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: THE FOE FORESEEN
Saga of the Great Wolf.flavor: With his great strategic wisdom, Grimnar predicted the peril these warriors would encounter and warned them to be ready for it.
Saga of the Great Wolf.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: UNRELENTING HUNTERS
Saga of the Great Wolf.flavor: Knowing their part in the grand plan and determined to execute it with the magnificence of true champions, these warriors fight with a fluid and inescapable ferocity.
Saga of the Great Wolf.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a Space Wolves unit, until the end of the turn, it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Saga of the Hunter.name: BOUNDING ADVANCE
Saga of the Hunter.flavor: Fenrisian warriors and wolves surge forward, driving through the enemy line to outflank the foe.
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Saga of the Hunter.target: One Space Wolves Infantry or Space Wolves Beasts unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declared a charge this phase.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models (excluding Titanic models). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but unless it is making a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

Saga of the Hunter.name: CHOSEN PREY
Saga of the Hunter.flavor: Having singled out their prey, the pack repeatedly strikes in waves, bleeding the target with each hit.
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Space Wolves unit from your army Falls Back.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Saga of the Hunter.name: HUNTERS’ TRAIL
Saga of the Hunter.flavor: The Space Wolves close in on their foes, some packs hurling themselves upon the enemy whilst others move to cut off retreat routes.
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.target: One Space Wolves unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

Saga of the Hunter.name: MARKED FOR DESTRUCTION
Saga of the Hunter.flavor: At the barked orders of their Pack Leaders, the Space Wolves focus their fury upon a single target, combining their firepower to bring the foe down.
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.target: Two ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army (excluding Beasts) that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to both of your units. Until the end of the phase, models in your units can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in one of your units makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Saga of the Hunter.name: OVERWHELMING ONSLAUGHT
Saga of the Hunter.flavor: Several packs converge upon a single target, pinning them in place with the weight of their bodies.
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Saga of the Hunter.target: Two ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, or one Space Wolves Beasts unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Saga of the Hunter.name: TERRITORIAL ADVANTAGE
Saga of the Hunter.flavor: The wolf packs are ever on the move, seizing ground and repelling their foes with savage violence.
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Shadowmark Talon.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Shadowmark Talon.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Shadowmark Talon.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shadowmark Talon.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Shadowmark Talon.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Shadowmark Talon.name: FEINT AND THRUST
Shadowmark Talon.flavor: Retreating from the fight, these warriors lure their enemies on before swiftly turning the tables and hurling themselves into their now overextended foe.
Shadowmark Talon.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If it is a Phobos or Scout Squad unit, it is also eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Shadowmark Talon.name: INTO DARKNESS
Shadowmark Talon.flavor: At the opportune moment, Raven Guard infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
Shadowmark Talon.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Shadowmark Talon.target: Up to two Phobos and/or Scout Squad units from your army, or one other Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Shadowmark Talon.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Shadowmark Talon.name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
Shadowmark Talon.flavor: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.
Shadowmark Talon.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Shadowmark Talon.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

Shadowmark Talon.name: RAPTORIAL VIGILANCE
Shadowmark Talon.flavor: The Raven Guard are swift to exploit the movements of their foes, whether to pursue their prey and complete the kill or to make use of an opportunity to fade oncemore from sight.
Shadowmark Talon.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Shadowmark Talon.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Shadowmark Talon.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a Phobos or Scout Squad unit.

Shadowmark Talon.name: STUNNING FUSILLADE
Shadowmark Talon.flavor: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle-brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.
Shadowmark Talon.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Shadowmark Talon.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit that is more than 12" away, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Shield of the Void.name: ADAPTIVE PURGE
Shield of the Void.flavor: Whatever hidden horrors lurk in the vessels the Shield Chapters must conquer, the warriors are able to adapt their firing tactics to ensure their destruction.
Shield of the Void.group: SPACE MARINES - Shield of the Void
Shield of the Void.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Shield of the Void.effect: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.

Shield of the Void.name: CODEX WARFARE
Shield of the Void.flavor: The Codex Astartes is held as a hallowed work of martial genius by the Shield Chapters. Its tenets prescribe tactical adaptability and fighting on the move, advancing from one adversary to the next in a series of deadly redeployments.
Shield of the Void.group: SPACE MARINES - Shield of the Void
Shield of the Void.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Shield of the Void.name: OVERCHARGED BREACH
Shield of the Void.flavor: With a well-placed volley of high-powered ammunition or a dedicated melta charge, specially equipped Space Marines can effect a permanent access route.
Shield of the Void.group: SPACE MARINES - Shield of the Void
Shield of the Void.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Shield of the Void.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.
Shield of the Void.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.

Shield of the Void.name: RAPID TAKEOVER
Shield of the Void.flavor: With one foe reeling in disarray, the battle-brothers instantly refocus on their next target, their rapid yet methodical progress capitalising on the enemy's every move.
Shield of the Void.group: SPACE MARINES - Shield of the Void
Shield of the Void.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
Shield of the Void.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
Shield of the Void.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".

Spearpoint Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Spearpoint Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Spearpoint Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Spearpoint Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Spearpoint Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Spearpoint Task Force.name: EVASIVE MANOEUVRES
Spearpoint Task Force.flavor: Battle-brothers of the White Scars Chapter are born and raised in the saddle. Expert pilots and riders all, they weave through incoming fire with instinctive skill.
Spearpoint Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Spearpoint Task Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Adeptus Astartes Fly Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Spearpoint Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Spearpoint Task Force.name: HUNTER’S INSTINCTS
Spearpoint Task Force.flavor: The White Scars read the ebb and flow of battle with the hungry cunning of raptorial predators, reacting to the enemy’s movements with exceptional rapidity.
Spearpoint Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Spearpoint Task Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Spearpoint Task Force.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Spearpoint Task Force.name: MOBILE LETHALITY
Spearpoint Task Force.flavor: The White Scars fight their wars at a furious tempo, and their warriors are adept at fire-and-manoeuvre strategies.
Spearpoint Task Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Spearpoint Task Force.name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
Spearpoint Task Force.flavor: Some foes can be ended with a single charge. Others require sustained savagery to fell. The White Scars are adept at both methods of fighting.
