Spearpoint Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Spearpoint Task Force.effect: Select either the [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. If it is a MOUNTED unit, until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities instead.

Spearpoint Task Force.name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
Spearpoint Task Force.flavor: The riders and pilots sweep away as swiftly as they arrive, regrouping in preparation for their next assault.
Spearpoint Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Spearpoint Task Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Adeptus Astartes Fly Vehicle unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Spearpoint Task Force.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Stormlance Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Stormlance Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Stormlance Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Stormlance Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Stormlance Task Force.name: BLITZING FUSILLADE
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: Warriors of Stormlance Task Forces can suddenly pour heavy and accurate fire into the enemy even as they race to finish off any survivors.
Stormlance Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Stormlance Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. If such a weapon already has this ability, until the end of the phase, that weapon has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability as well.

Stormlance Task Force.name: FULL THROTTLE
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: On the eve of riding down the most elusive prey, the task force's expert Techmarines will entreat the engine spirits o f their vehicles, honing the iron steeds' performance to elicit even more speed from them.
Stormlance Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKERS) from your army.
Stormlance Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, or 9" instead if your unit is MOUNTED.

Stormlance Task Force.name: RIDE HARD, RIDE FAST
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: Like zephyrs dancing across wide horizons, Space Marine riders and pilots can weave lithely around incoming fire with incredible skill.
Stormlance Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Stormlance Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Stormlance Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Stormlance Task Force.name: SHOCK ASSAULT
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: The Adeptus Astartes are elite troops who strike with all the speed and fury of a searing thunderbolt.
Stormlance Task Force.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

Stormlance Task Force.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: Space Marines are loathe to be brought into combat on any others’ terms, especially the warriors of Stormlance Task Forces, whose battlefield tactics revolve around speed and precise, ferocious assaults.
Stormlance Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Stormlance Task Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Stormlance Task Force.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Stormlance Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Subversion Assets.name: ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS
Subversion Assets.flavor: Those warriors who operate far from Chapter reinforcement maintain their lethal fire even while conducting vital strategic operations.
Subversion Assets.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit starts an action.
Subversion Assets.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Subversion Assets.name: CLOAKED POSITION
Subversion Assets.flavor: When still, silent and further masked by cameleoline materials or drifting smoke, a Chapter’s forward operatives are almost impossible to spot until it is too late.
Subversion Assets.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Subversion Assets.target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
Subversion Assets.effect: Your unit has -3" detection range until the end of the turn.

Subversion Assets.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
Subversion Assets.flavor: Holding to the shadows and choosing victims with care, stealthy warriors winnow the enemy ranks without ever revealing their positions.
Subversion Assets.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot.
Subversion Assets.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

Terminator Assault.name: CARVE A PATH
Terminator Assault.flavor: Power fists, chainfists, and sheer servo-actuated armoured mass ensure that Terminators’ paths are never barred for long.
Terminator Assault.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Terminator Assault.target: One Terminator Assault Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
Terminator Assault.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
Terminator Assault.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

Terminator Assault.name: CLEANSING SWEEP
Terminator Assault.flavor: Refined during the clearance of infested space hulks, these methodical tactics ensure no angle of approach goes undefended.
Terminator Assault.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
Terminator Assault.target: One Terminator Squad unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
Terminator Assault.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

Terminator Assault.name: FOCUSING SHRINE
Terminator Assault.flavor: An ancient device built into the structure of the teleportarium, this relic allows for incredibly accurate teleport assaults.
Terminator Assault.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
Terminator Assault.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army that is in Reserves.
Terminator Assault.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability, ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways).
Terminator Assault.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Terminator Assault.name: TOWER OF STRENGTH
Terminator Assault.flavor: Each individual Terminator is a walking fortress. When they stand together they are truly indomitable.
Terminator Assault.when: Start or end of any phase.
Terminator Assault.target: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army.
Terminator Assault.effect: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
Terminator Assault.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.

The Angelic Host.name: ANGEL’S SACRIFICE
The Angelic Host.flavor: The Blood Angels would gladly put themselves in harm's way to protect others, just as Sanguinius sacrificed his own life.
The Angelic Host.target: One Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army.
The Angelic Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects its targets, it must select your unit as the target of all of its attacks.

The Angelic Host.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
The Angelic Host.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their enhanced physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
The Angelic Host.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
The Angelic Host.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
The Angelic Host.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

The Angelic Host.name: DEATH FROM THE SKIES
The Angelic Host.flavor: The roar of the Blood Angels jump packs is as a funeral dirge to their foes.
The Angelic Host.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
The Angelic Host.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

The Angelic Host.name: DESCENT OF ANGELS
The Angelic Host.flavor: The Blood Angels are masters of aerial assault, leaping from airborne transports with jump packs roaring to plunge into the heat of battle.
The Angelic Host.target: One Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
The Angelic Host.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
The Angelic Host.restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

The Angelic Host.name: MARTIAL EXEMPLARS
The Angelic Host.flavor: The Blood Angels are mighty warriors indeed, and wield their gilded and shimmering blades with consummate skill.
The Angelic Host.target: One Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
The Angelic Host.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PRECISION] abilities.

The Angelic Host.name: UNBRIDLED ARDOUR
The Angelic Host.flavor: The Sanguinary Guard exemplify the noble heritage of Sanguinius, leaping to avenge their battle-brothers without hesitation.
The Angelic Host.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
The Angelic Host.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

The Lost Brethren.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
The Lost Brethren.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their enhanced physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
The Lost Brethren.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
The Lost Brethren.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
The Lost Brethren.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

The Lost Brethren.name: FINAL RETRIBUTION
The Lost Brethren.flavor: These battle-brothers have already accepted their deaths. They now seek to strike one last, telling blow against the enemy.
The Lost Brethren.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
The Lost Brethren.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
The Lost Brethren.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly Chaplain models; on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

The Lost Brethren.name: FURIOUS ONSLAUGHT
The Lost Brethren.flavor: The Lost push towards new foes, the bloodlust in their veins enhancing their preternatural speed.
The Lost Brethren.target: One Death Company unit from your army, just before that unit Piles-in.
The Lost Brethren.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3". If your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly Chaplain models, or if it is below Starting Strength, it can move up to 6" instead. In either case, it can only do so provided your unit ends that Pile-in move in Unit Coherency and within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

The Lost Brethren.name: GLORIOUS SACRIFICE
The Lost Brethren.flavor: Even in death, the Lost bring victory to their Chapter.
The Lost Brethren.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
The Lost Brethren.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

The Lost Brethren.name: LOST TO RAGE
The Lost Brethren.flavor: The Lost are consumed utterly by rage.
The Lost Brethren.target: One Death Company unit from your army that is below Starting Strength and has not been selected to fight this phase.
The Lost Brethren.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks, Stength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and, unless your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly Chaplain models, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

The Lost Brethren.name: WRATHFUL RAMPAGE
The Lost Brethren.flavor: So lost to rage are the Death Company that they surge unstoppably into battle, eagerly outpacing their brothers.
The Lost Brethren.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Death Company unit from your army Advances.
The Lost Brethren.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly Chaplain models, or it is below its Starting Strength, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Unforgiven Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Unforgiven Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Unforgiven Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unforgiven Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unforgiven Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Unforgiven Task Force.name: FIRE DISCIPLINE
Unforgiven Task Force.flavor: There is no escaping the Unforgiven’s wrath when they bring their disciplined firepower to bear.
Unforgiven Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Unforgiven Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT], [HEAVY] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

Unforgiven Task Force.name: GRIM RETRIBUTION
Unforgiven Task Force.flavor: Stern and vengeful as they are, the warriors of the Unforgiven Chapters deliver swift retribution to any foe foolish enough to try to lay them low.
Unforgiven Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Unforgiven Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that had one or more models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unforgiven Task Force.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target the enemy unit that just attacked it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Unforgiven Task Force.name: INTRACTABLE
Unforgiven Task Force.flavor: Even the Dark Angels must give ground occasionally, y but their stubborn determination ensures they never do so for long, or without a fight.
Unforgiven Task Force.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
Unforgiven Task Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Unforgiven Task Force.name: UNBREAKABLE LINES
Unforgiven Task Force.flavor: Countless assaults have faltered against the unbreakable ceramite wall that is the Unforgiven standing their ground.
Unforgiven Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
Unforgiven Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Unforgiven Task Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Unforgiven Task Force.name: UNFORGIVEN FURY
Unforgiven Task Force.flavor: With focused aggression, the Dark Angels relentlessly punish the foe.
Unforgiven Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Unforgiven Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Unforgiven Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. In addition, if one or more ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army are currently Battle-shocked, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Vanguard Spearhead.name: A DEADLY PRIZE
Vanguard Spearhead.flavor: Warriors of a Vanguard Spearhead will rig critical objectives with explosives to deny them to the enemy.
Vanguard Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
Vanguard Spearhead.effect: That objective marker is said to be Sabotaged, and remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While an objective marker is Sabotaged and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Vanguard Spearhead.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Vanguard Spearhead.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Vanguard Spearhead.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Vanguard Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Vanguard Spearhead.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Vanguard Spearhead.name: CALCULATED FEINT
Vanguard Spearhead.flavor: A feigned retreat can be used to overextend eager foes or draw them into deadly arcs of fire.
Vanguard Spearhead.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
Vanguard Spearhead.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit within 12" of that enemy unit.
Vanguard Spearhead.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit. RESTRICTION: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Vanguard Spearhead.name: GUERRILLA TACTICS
Vanguard Spearhead.flavor: At the opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
Vanguard Spearhead.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Vanguard Spearhead.target: Up to two PHOBOS and/or SCOUT SQUAD units from your army, or one other ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
Vanguard Spearhead.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
Vanguard Spearhead.restrictions: Each unit selected for this Stratagem must be more than 3" away from all enemy models.

Vanguard Spearhead.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
Vanguard Spearhead.flavor: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
Vanguard Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Vanguard Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit that is more than 12" away, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1. If one or more enemy models are destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one of those destroyed models; that destroyed model’s unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Vanguard Spearhead.name: SURGICAL STRIKES
Vanguard Spearhead.flavor: Every tyrant must fear the assassin's blade, and the vanguard spring ambushes with precision coordination.
Vanguard Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Vanguard Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

Vengeful Hosts.name: KNOW NO FEAR
Vengeful Hosts.flavor: Inspired by duty, these warriors reject dismay and fight on with renewed fury.
Vengeful Hosts.target: One friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.

Vengeful Hosts.name: METEORIC ONSLAUGHT
Vengeful Hosts.flavor: Jump jets blazing, these Space Marine shock troops slam into their foes with bone-breaking force.
Vengeful Hosts.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to attack.

Vengeful Hosts.name: PURGE BY SECTORS
Vengeful Hosts.flavor: Focused on sweeping the Ork threat from Armageddon, if these warriors find themselves unengaged, they press swiftly onward.
Vengeful Hosts.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
Vengeful Hosts.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Veterans of the Fang.name: BLADE-KEEN SENSES
Veterans of the Fang.flavor: Many decades’ experience hunting foes through the worst conditions have honed the senses of these warriors to near-inescapable sharpness.
Veterans of the Fang.group: SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Fang
Veterans of the Fang.target: One friendly unengaged GREY HUNTERS unit.
Veterans of the Fang.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 24" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

Veterans of the Fang.name: GRIZZLED KILLERS
Veterans of the Fang.flavor: Be it mighty beasts or hordes of lesser foes, these warriors learned long ago how to best them.
Veterans of the Fang.group: SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Fang
Veterans of the Fang.when: Fight phase, when a friendly GREY HUNTERS unit is selected to fight.
Veterans of the Fang.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
  • OR: [LETHAL HITS].

Veterans of the Fang.name: ICY CALM
Veterans of the Fang.flavor: No matter what is demanded of them amidst the mayhem of battle, still packs of Grey Hunters are able to complete even the most complex tasks with stern surety.
Veterans of the Fang.group: SPACE MARINES - Veterans of the Fang
Veterans of the Fang.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly GREY HUNTERS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
Veterans of the Fang.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

Vindication Task Force.name: LITANIES OF PURGATION
Vindication Task Force.flavor: Where the Emperor's domain is imperilled by the unholy, the Black Templars vow to cleanse it.
Vindication Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Vindication Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that model’s unit is within range of one or more objective markers or the target unit is within range of one or more objective markers, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Vindication Task Force.name: PERFERVID INTERVENTION
Vindication Task Force.flavor: When the Emperor blesses his crusaders with the opportunity to seize the initiative, none refuse.
Vindication Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Vindication Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Vindication Task Force.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
Vindication Task Force.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Vindication Task Force.name: RECITATION OF THE REVERED
Vindication Task Force.flavor: The Ancient leads a deafening recital of his banner's honours, the projected chant's zeal shaking the foe.
Vindication Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Vindication Task Force.target: One Ancient unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Vindication Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Vindication Task Force.name: RECLAIM OUR HONOUR!
Vindication Task Force.flavor: The sacred standards of a crusade embody its warriors' honour, and no one would see them lost.
Vindication Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys an Ancient model from your army that has not been targeted with the Refusal to Yield Stratagem this phase.
Vindication Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army visible to that enemy unit.
Vindication Task Force.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
Vindication Task Force.restrictions: You cannot target that ANCIENT model with the Refusal to Yield Stratagem this phase.

Vindication Task Force.name: REFUSAL TO YIELD
Vindication Task Force.flavor: Where honour is upheld, the Emperor's divinity may manifest to grant his pious warrior new strength.
Vindication Task Force.when: Any phase, just after an Ancient model from your army is destroyed.
Vindication Task Force.target: That ANCIENT model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Vindication Task Force.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.
Vindication Task Force.restrictions: You cannot target the same model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.

Vindication Task Force.name: SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY
Vindication Task Force.flavor: Perhaps guided by visions from the Emperor, Black Templars can pick out heresy wherever it lurks.
Vindication Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Vindication Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Vindication Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll.

Wrath of the Doomed.name: DEATH BEGETS VENGEANCE
Wrath of the Doomed.flavor: With their perceptions twisted, the battle-brothers of the Death Company transmute loss into the worst of ancient betrayals and seek only to sever such treachery from existence.
Wrath of the Doomed.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Doomed
Wrath of the Doomed.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
Wrath of the Doomed.effect: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle: While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units’ attacks that target that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

Wrath of the Doomed.name: NO BARRIER TO RETRIBUTION
Wrath of the Doomed.flavor: Knowing in what remains of his mind that his is a sorrow-filled mission of galactic consequence, this ancient interred warrior permits nothing to stand in his way.
Wrath of the Doomed.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Doomed
Wrath of the Doomed.when: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a normal/advance/charge move.

Wrath of the Doomed.name: RAGE-FUELLED RESPONSE
Wrath of the Doomed.flavor: They may no longer recognise the foe before them, but the Lost Brethren are sane enough to identify an attack and capable of responding with a violent surge and a howl of wrath.
Wrath of the Doomed.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Doomed
Wrath of the Doomed.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.
Wrath of the Doomed.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Wrath of the Rock.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Wrath of the Rock.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their transhuman physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Wrath of the Rock.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Rock
Wrath of the Rock.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Wrath of the Rock.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Wrath of the Rock.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Wrath of the Rock.name: INESCAPABLE JUSTICE
Wrath of the Rock.flavor: The Dark Angels pursue their enemies relentlessly, eliminating one with ruthless precision before turning to the next.
Wrath of the Rock.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Rock
Wrath of the Rock.when: Any phase, just after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed.
Wrath of the Rock.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit that is on the battlefield.
Wrath of the Rock.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" and visible to your unit. That enemy unit becomes your Oath of Moment target until the start of your next Command phase.

Wrath of the Rock.name: LEONINE AGGRESSION
Wrath of the Rock.flavor: The Dark Angels are always aggressive in their waging of war, seizing any opportunity to pounce upon and annihilate their prey.
Wrath of the Rock.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Rock
Wrath of the Rock.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Wrath of the Rock.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army within 3" of one or more enemy units, or one Deathwing unit from your army within 6" of one or more enemy units.
Wrath of the Rock.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
Wrath of the Rock.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Wrath of the Rock.name: LION’S WILL
Wrath of the Rock.flavor: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, Dark Angels battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
Wrath of the Rock.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Rock
Wrath of the Rock.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Wrath of the Rock.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, until the end of the turn, if your unit does not have the Deathwing, Ravenwing or Vehicle keyword, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Wrath of the Rock.name: RELICS OF THE DARK AGE
Wrath of the Rock.flavor: Amongst the many secrets hoarded by the Dark Angels are those technological in nature. The armouries of the Rock contain potent weapons unseen in the armouries of other Chapters.
Wrath of the Rock.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Rock
Wrath of the Rock.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Wrath of the Rock.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Wrath of the Rock.name: TACTICAL MASTERY
Wrath of the Rock.flavor: When the constituent elements of the Dark Angels fight as one, the enemy is often overwhelmed and torn apart by the fluidity of the Chapter’s rapid advances, tactical withdrawals and unexpected counteroffensives.
Wrath of the Rock.group: SPACE MARINES - Wrath of the Rock
Wrath of the Rock.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the Ravenwing keyword, it is also eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Wrathful Procession.name: CASTIGATE THE DEMAGOGUES
Wrathful Procession.flavor: There is nowhere that the architects of heresy can hide from the righteous judgement of the Black Templars.
Wrathful Procession.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit is selected to fight.

Wrathful Procession.name: FUELLED BY FAITH
Wrathful Procession.flavor: So powerfully gripped by holy fervour are these warriors that they fight on through even the most grievous wounds to body and mind.
Wrathful Procession.when: Any phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit suffers a mortal wound.
Wrathful Procession.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

Wrathful Procession.name: RITE OF PERFERVID WRATH
Wrathful Procession.flavor: With a bellowed oath to Rogal Dorn, Chaplains lead their warriors plunging into the foe’s midst, shattering armour and crushing skulls with blows granted the strength of their devotion.
Wrathful Procession.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit is selected to fight.

(none).name: ALIEN EXPERTISE
(none).flavor: There is much that the alien auxiliaries of the T’au empire can

(none).name: EXPERIMENTAL MODIFICATIONS
(none).flavor: These experimental Earth caste weapon upgrades can only activate

(none).name: GUIDED FIRE
(none).flavor: Firing on coordinates provided by selfless alien auxiliaries,

Advanced Acquisition Cadre.name: AUTOREACTIVE CAMOUFLAGE
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.flavor: An experimental new form of portable electrocamouflage generators, these small devices interweave active energy shielding with passive sensor damping to further protect T’au soldiery in hiding.
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/ STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit, if that friendly unit is hidden.

Advanced Acquisition Cadre.name: MARKER BEACON
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.flavor: These small devices emit tightbeam triangulation signals for follow‑up waves of incoming T’au forces, silently marking out strategically vital sites to be secured.
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.target: One friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit.
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

Advanced Acquisition Cadre.name: MICRODRONE SUPPORT
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.flavor: Deployed from overflights of heavier stealth‑capable carrier drones, these tiny machines provide versatile battlefield support for T’au stealth specialists, even in the midst of vicious firefights.
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PATHFINDER TEAM/ STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit starts an action.
Advanced Acquisition Cadre.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Experimental Prototype Cadre.name: EXPERIMENTAL AMMUNITION
Experimental Prototype Cadre.flavor: From hardened warheads and amplified ion capacitors, to hyperaccelerated pulse fields and refined fusion cores, the T’au are forever innovating improvements to improve the lethality of their ammunition.
Experimental Prototype Cadre.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit is selected to shoot.
Experimental Prototype Cadre.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • OR: +1 S, AP and [HAZARDOUS].

Kauyon.name: A TEMPTING TRAP
Kauyon.flavor: Kauyon teaches that many things can be used to bait a trap, luring the foe into position.
Kauyon.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. The first time you use this Stratagem, you must also select one objective marker that is not in your opponent’s deployment zone; until the end of the battle, this becomes your Trap objective marker.
Kauyon.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within range of your Trap objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Kauyon.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.

Kauyon.name: COMBAT EMBARKATION
Kauyon.flavor: Those who act as the lure in the Kauyon must be ready to make a hasty withdrawal once the enemy closes into killing range, lest they be trapped.
Kauyon.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
Kauyon.target: One T’au Empire Infantry unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge, and one friendly Transport.
Kauyon.effect: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. If it does, your opponent can select new targets for that charge.
Kauyon.restrictions: Every model in your T’AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit must be within 3" of that TRANSPORT and there must be sufficient transport capacity to embark the entire unit.

Kauyon.name: COORDINATE TO ENGAGE
Kauyon.flavor: T’au Hunter Cadres work in close coordination to destroy the most dangerous enemy targets.
Kauyon.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has just been selected as an Observer unit (see For the Greater Good).
Kauyon.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets their Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if your unit has the Markerlight keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Kauyon.name: PHOTON GRENADES
Kauyon.flavor: Hurling a volley of photon grenades, the T’au leave their enemies dazzled and disorientated, unable to close the distance into combat at a crucial moment.
Kauyon.when: Your opponent's charge phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its charge target.
Kauyon.target: One T’AU EMPIRE GRENADES unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
Kauyon.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test, and until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit. RESTRICTION: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Kauyon.name: POINT-BLANK AMBUSH
Kauyon.flavor: Devastating firepower need not be applied from afar, especially when striking an unsuspecting foe.
Kauyon.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Kauyon.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Kauyon.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the first or second battle rounds.

Kauyon.name: WALL OF MIRRORS
Kauyon.flavor: T’au Stealth Cadres utilise obfuscation fields and wide-band refraction beams to mask their advance.
Kauyon.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Kauyon.target: One Stealth, Ghostkeel or Commander Shadowsun unit from your army.
Kauyon.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Kauyon.restrictions: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Kroot Hunting Pack.name: A TRAP WELL LAID
Kroot Hunting Pack.flavor: The Kroot have long perfected the art of ambush hunting, their packs working in deadly concert.
Kroot Hunting Pack.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Kroot Hunting Pack.target: One Kroot unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Kroot Hunting Pack.effect: After your unit has resolved its attacks this phase, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, unless the attacking unit is Battle-shocked, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Kroot Hunting Pack.name: EMP GRENADES
Kroot Hunting Pack.flavor: Furnished by T’au allies or returning Farstalkers, these electromagnetic grenades wreak havoc with the animuses of armoured fighting vehicles.
Kroot Hunting Pack.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy VEHICLE unit is selected to shoot or fight.
Kroot Hunting Pack.target: One Kroot Grenades unit from your army within 8" of that enemy VEHICLE unit.
Kroot Hunting Pack.effect: Until the end of the phase, worsen the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of that enemy VEHICLE unit’s weapons by 1.

Kroot Hunting Pack.name: GUERRILLA WARRIORS
Kroot Hunting Pack.flavor: Kroot see no value in stand-up fights, caring little for honour or glory. They hit and fade, frustrating their foes and bleeding them by degrees until - weakened and out of position - they are rendered vulnerable.
Kroot Hunting Pack.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Kroot unit from your army Falls Back.
Kroot Hunting Pack.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

Kroot Hunting Pack.name: HIDDEN HUNTERS
Kroot Hunting Pack.flavor: The Kroot are experts in camouflage and concealment, able to utilise cover in ways most foes would never consider and - to their great misfortune - do not anticipate.
Kroot Hunting Pack.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Kroot Hunting Pack.target: One Kroot unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Kroot Hunting Pack.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Kroot Hunting Pack.name: JOIN THE HUNT
Kroot Hunting Pack.flavor: When a Kroot Hunting Pack closes in on its prey, there are often other hunters waiting to join in the fray and take their share of any spoils.
Kroot Hunting Pack.target: One Kroot Infantry or Kroot Hounds unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Kroot Hunting Pack.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
Kroot Hunting Pack.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed Character units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

Kroot Hunting Pack.name: THE GRISLY FEAST
Kroot Hunting Pack.flavor: The psychological impact of witnessing one's comrades being dismembered and devoured by gore-splattered Kroot cannot be overstated.
Kroot Hunting Pack.target: One Kroot unit from your army that destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
Kroot Hunting Pack.effect: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Kroot Raiding Party.name: BOARDING BLADES
Kroot Raiding Party.flavor: Expecting close-quarters carnage, these Kroot have adapted the blades on their weapons to slice through even thick armour.
Kroot Raiding Party.target: One KROOT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Kroot Raiding Party.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.

Kroot Raiding Party.name: BRUTE FORCE
Kroot Raiding Party.flavor: Where cunning will not suffice, the brutal strength of Krootox sees hatchways and bulkheads smashed to pieces, filling the corridors beyond with whickering shrapnel.
Kroot Raiding Party.when: Your Movement phase, just after a KROOTOX RIDERS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Kroot Raiding Party.effect: Roll one D6 for each unit that is within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

Kroot Raiding Party.name: SWEEPING AMBUSH
Kroot Raiding Party.flavor: Once they spring their ambush these Kroot move fast, hacking through one band of foes and pouncing on the next before the enemy can regain their footing.
Kroot Raiding Party.target: One KROOT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Kroot Raiding Party.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, when making a Consolidation move, that model can end that move within Engagement Range of the closest enemy unit that was not visible to its unit when it started that move.

Kroot Raiding Party.name: TANGLEBOMB BOLAS
Kroot Raiding Party.flavor: Sent spinning in to entangle their targets, these weapons leave their victims easy prey for the screeching Kroot.
Kroot Raiding Party.target: One KROOT unit from your army.
Kroot Raiding Party.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit and roll one D6: on a 2+, until the start of your next Shooting phase, halve the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit and halve Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

Mont’ka.name: AGGRESSIVE MOBILITY
Mont’ka.flavor: By advancing swiftly into commanding positions, Mont’ka forces maximise the benefits of their enemies' shock and disorientation.
Mont’ka.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Mont’ka.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Mont’ka.name: COMBAT DEBARKATION
Mont’ka.flavor: The most aggressive Fire caste warriors sometimes spring from moving transports, roll with the impact of landing, and come up with weapons already blazing.
Mont’ka.target: One T’au Empire Infantry unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
Mont’ka.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Mont’ka.name: COUNTERFIRE DEFENCE SYSTEMS
Mont’ka.flavor: Point-defence systems trigger as incoming fire is detected, blasting projectiles from the air and lessening the power of the enemy fusillade.
Mont’ka.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Mont’ka.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Mont’ka.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Mont’ka.name: FOCUSED FIRE
Mont’ka.flavor: Mont’ka doctrine heavily emphasises the massed concentration of fire upon a single target at a time, obliterating each component of the enemy force in succession with a series of unrelenting barrages.
Mont’ka.target: Two T’AU EMPIRE units from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase, and one enemy unit.
Mont’ka.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
Mont’ka.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem during the fourth or fifth battle rounds.

Mont’ka.name: PINPOINT COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
Mont’ka.flavor: Mont’ka emphasises rapid evolving threat-analysis and the application of overwhelming firepower to eliminate emergent high-priority targets.
Mont’ka.target: One T’AU EMPIRE unit (excluding Kroot units) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Mont’ka.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a T’AU EMPIRE unit (excluding KROOT units) from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Mont’ka.name: PULSE ONSLAUGHT
Mont’ka.flavor: Rather than charge into hand-to-hand combat, T’au soldiery instead intensify their fire patterns, pinning their advancing foes and staving off their onslaught.
Mont’ka.target: One T’au Empire Infantry unit (excluding Kroot units) from your army that has just shot, and one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks.
Mont’ka.effect: Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, that enemy unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2 from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

Retaliation Cadre.name: FAIL-SAFE DETONATOR
Retaliation Cadre.flavor: Devices are incorporated into some battlesuits either to prevent high-ranking pilots being taken alive for interrogation or to prevent just such fatal explosions.
Retaliation Cadre.when: Any phase, just after a T’au Empire Battlesuit model from your army is destroyed.
Retaliation Cadre.target: That destroyed model’s unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even if that unit was just destroyed.
Retaliation Cadre.effect: Before removing your model from play, if it has the Deadly Demise ability, do not roll for that ability; instead, you can choose whether the result of that roll is a 1 or a 6. If your model does not have the Deadly Demise ability, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of it: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Retaliation Cadre.name: GRAV-INHIBITOR FIELD
Retaliation Cadre.flavor: First used by O’Jir during the battle for Laguna Shard, these battlesuit-mounted emitters batter advancing foes backwards with gravitic pulse waves.
Retaliation Cadre.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
Retaliation Cadre.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
Retaliation Cadre.effect: That enemy unit must immediately take a Battle-shock test and you must roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Retaliation Cadre.name: STIMM INJECTORS
Retaliation Cadre.flavor: On-board hypodermics shunt pain-blockers and chemical stimulants into the pilot's system.
Retaliation Cadre.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Retaliation Cadre.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Retaliation Cadre.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

Retaliation Cadre.name: THE ARRO’KON PROTOCOL
Retaliation Cadre.flavor: Commander Arro’kon’s teachings are considered pre-eminent in the art of engaging and eliminating numerically overwhelming enemy formations.
Retaliation Cadre.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Retaliation Cadre.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that contains 6 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If that attack targets an enemy unit that contains 11 or more models, it has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.

Retaliation Cadre.name: THE SHORTENED BLADE
Retaliation Cadre.flavor: Made famous by Commander Farsight and his protege Brightsword, this philosophy encourages pilots to drop into the very teeth of the enemy army and apply their firepower at point-blank range.
Retaliation Cadre.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
Retaliation Cadre.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
Retaliation Cadre.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

Retaliation Cadre.name: THE TORCHSTAR GAMBIT
Retaliation Cadre.flavor: Though now disgraced by association with O'Shovah, Sub-Commander Torchstar’s strike-and-fade tactics are still taught - albeit officially under other names - in many Fire caste academies.
Retaliation Cadre.target: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that can FLY whose attacks have been resolved this phase.
Retaliation Cadre.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. If it does, your unit cannot declare a charge this turn

Starfire Cadre.name: FIRING LINE
Starfire Cadre.flavor: Should the foe break through one line of Fire caste defence, the next is ready to push them back from vital sites aboard the contested ship.
Starfire Cadre.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army.
Starfire Cadre.target: One FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, has not fired Overwatch this turn and is within 9" of that enemy unit.
Starfire Cadre.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit.

Starfire Cadre.name: PULSE BARRAGE
Starfire Cadre.flavor: The tight confines of voidship warfare funnel the enemy right into the waiting T'au guns.
Starfire Cadre.when: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase.
Starfire Cadre.target: One FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
Starfire Cadre.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

Starfire Cadre.name: RESPONSIVE VOLLEY
Starfire Cadre.flavor: Should enemy forces be suddenly revealed during such close-confines combat, Fire caste soldiery are trained to loose immediate, punishing firepower.
Starfire Cadre.when: Your Movement phase, just after a FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Starfire Cadre.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from them, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

Starfire Cadre.name: RETREATING FIRE
Starfire Cadre.flavor: Collapsing lines of infantry provide a defence in depth through the shipboard confines, allowing the enemy to overextend even as retreating T'au continue to pour fire into them.
Starfire Cadre.target: One FIRE WARRIOR or PATHfINDER TEAM unit from your army.
Starfire Cadre.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Changehost of Deceit.name: CHRONOSORCEROUS BLEED
Changehost of Deceit.flavor: By sacrificing minute slivers of the oncoming foes' lives, time can be bled into the Warp, stretching perceptions and causing sudden exhaustion.
Changehost of Deceit.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Changehost of Deceit.target: One friendly unengaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER/SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit.
Changehost of Deceit.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

Changehost of Deceit.name: DECEPTIVE GLAMOUR
Changehost of Deceit.flavor: Tendrils of phantasmal sorcery are sent to invade the minds of the Thousand Sons' foes, magnifying the infernal threat until it eclipses all others in a kaleidoscope of insanity.
Changehost of Deceit.target: One Thousand Sons unit from your army.
Changehost of Deceit.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets for its attacks, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible Scintillating Legions targets for those attacks.

Changehost of Deceit.name: ETHEREAL PHANTASM
Changehost of Deceit.flavor: Semi-sentient doppelgangers stalk the battlefield, bewildering attempts to target the daemonic spawn.
Changehost of Deceit.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Changehost of Deceit.target: One Scintillating Legions unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Changehost of Deceit.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons units.

Changehost of Deceit.name: FRACTAL DISJUNCTION
Changehost of Deceit.flavor: Tzeentchian daemons can twist perceptions until they seem no longer there, bending light and dissipating technological targeting scans in a dizzying, fractal puzzle.
Changehost of Deceit.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Changehost of Deceit.target: One Scintillating Legions unit from your army (excluding Monsters) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Changehost of Deceit.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Changehost of Deceit.name: GLIMMERSHIFT PORTAL
Changehost of Deceit.flavor: Weaving a spell of splintering translocation, Tzeentch's daemons can prise open an unnatural pathway through the Warp.
Changehost of Deceit.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Changehost of Deceit.target: Up to two Scintillating Legions units from your army (excluding Monsters), or one Scintillating Legions Monster unit from your army, if all of those units are more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
Changehost of Deceit.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Changehost of Deceit.name: SULPHUROUS VEIL
Changehost of Deceit.flavor: Gouts of choking brimstone or arcane smog seeping from the Warp are exploited to confound the foe.
Changehost of Deceit.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Changehost of Deceit.target: One Thousand Sons or Scintillating Legions unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Changehost of Deceit.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Chosen Cabal.name: COSTLY BLESSING
Chosen Cabal.flavor: Tzeentch's gifts may protect his followers, but such intervention never comes without cost.
Chosen Cabal.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Chosen Cabal.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARAcTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Chosen Cabal.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 3+ invulnerable save. At the end of the phase, your model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Chosen Cabal.name: EMPYRIC DESECRATION
Chosen Cabal.flavor: Powerful Sorcerers may use their mastery of the warp to corrupt areas of the battlefield and deny them to the foe.
Chosen Cabal.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARAcTER model from your army.
Chosen Cabal.effect: Select one objective marker Secured by your opponent’s army that is within 6" of and visible to your model, then roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army.

Chosen Cabal.name: INFERNO BOLTERS
Chosen Cabal.flavor: The Thousand Sons inferno bolters make use of warp-imbued ammunition capable of burning through bulkheads to strike unsuspecting targets.
Chosen Cabal.target: One RUBRIc MARINES or ScARAB OccULT TERMINATORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Chosen Cabal.effect: Select one closed Hatchway. Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can make attacks with ranged weapons (excluding Torrent weapons) that target enemy units within 1" of that Hatchway and that are wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, as if that Hatchway was open. Each time a model does so, that attack has an Armour Penetration characteristic of 0.

Chosen Cabal.name: TZEENTCH’S BOON
Chosen Cabal.flavor: This psyker’s devotion to the God of Change has been rewarded with terrible destructive power.
Chosen Cabal.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army within range of an objective marker that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Chosen Cabal.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes a Psychic Attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Devoted Thralls.name: BESTIAL SURGE
Devoted Thralls.flavor: When struck by enemy fire, the bestial Tzaangors react with instinctive fury, surging towards their assailants in a vengeful flock.
Devoted Thralls.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Devoted Thralls.target: One TzAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Devoted Thralls.effect: Your unit can make a Bestial Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.

Devoted Thralls.name: FELL SACRIFICE
Devoted Thralls.flavor: As ritual violence gathers in intensity, the massed thralls of the Thousand Sons swell with the terrifying powers of the warp.
Devoted Thralls.when: Your opponent’s Command phase, at the start of the Battle-shock step.
Devoted Thralls.target: One THOUSAND SONS CHARAcTER or TzAANGORS unit from your army.
Devoted Thralls.effect: Select one enemy unit below its Starting Strength that is within Engagement Range of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that enemy unit is also Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. This Enhancement cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Devoted Thralls.name: FLESH CHANGE
Devoted Thralls.flavor: Tzeentch’s mutagenic gifts lend resilience to those brave or fool hardy enough to embrace them.
Devoted Thralls.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Devoted Thralls.target: One TzAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Devoted Thralls.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Devoted Thralls.name: PSYCHIC INGRESS
Devoted Thralls.flavor: The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons can draw upon their powers to melt away hatches and bulkheads.
Devoted Thralls.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER CHARAcTER model from your army.
Devoted Thralls.effect: Open every Hatchway within 3" of your model. When measuring this distance, ignore Walls and closed Hatchways.
Devoted Thralls.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Fateseekers.name: ENDURING ANIMUS
Fateseekers.flavor: The malefic spirit echoes bound within the armour of the Thousand Sons cling tenaciously to existence and are not banished easily.
Fateseekers.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Fateseekers.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Fateseekers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Fateseekers.name: INVISIBLE ASSAILANTS
Fateseekers.flavor: Flocking to the Sorcerer's summons, swarms of minor warp entities assail the enemy, wailing and clawing at them until they are driven to horrified distraction.
Fateseekers.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Fateseekers.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army.
Fateseekers.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your model. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the start of your opponent’s next Movement phase, subtract 2" from the Move characteristic of models in that unit and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it; if passed, subtract 1" from the Move characteristic of models in that unit and subtract 1 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

Fateseekers.name: PHANTASMIC MUNITIONS
Fateseekers.flavor: The Sorcerer renders the shells and blasts of their warriors ethereal, allowing them to pass through intervening targets before solidifying again to lethal effect.
Fateseekers.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Fateseekers.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can ignore enemy models for the purposes of determining visibility.

Fateseekers.name: STRATEGIC VISION
Fateseekers.flavor: Flickering visions allow this Sorcerer to foresee enemy threats and direct the weapons of their thralls accordingly.
Fateseekers.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Fateseekers.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability, and models in your unit can target enemy units that are not within Engagement Range of them (as long as they are otherwise eligible targets).

Grand Coven.name: ARCANE FOCUS
Grand Coven.flavor: Using a locus formed from the ritually broken matter of sorcerous artefacts, a Sorcerer can infuse themselves with its power. So invigorated, their empyrically fuelled manipulations are made all the more potent.
Grand Coven.when: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a Thousand Sons model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).
Grand Coven.effect: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).

Grand Coven.name: DESECRATION OF WORLDS
Grand Coven.flavor: The Sorcerers of the Thousand Sons pour their corrupting spite and contempt into the bedrock of the battlefield, tainting it with their warpcraft.
Grand Coven.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
Grand Coven.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Grand Coven.name: DESTINED BY FATE
Grand Coven.flavor: The Architect of Fate has great designs for his pawns, which do not yet include their untimely demise.
Grand Coven.when: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a Thousand Sons Psyker model from your army. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple saving throws at once.
Grand Coven.effect: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those attacks you failed a saving throw for.

Grand Coven.name: DEVASTATING SORCERY
Grand Coven.flavor: The Thousand Sons' flesh seethes with raw sorcery. The sheer unstoppable might of their conjurations is such that little can prevent them from manifesting devastation when unleashed with destructive intent.
Grand Coven.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Grand Coven.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 9" to the Range characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Grand Coven.name: EGOTISTICAL POWER
Grand Coven.flavor: Drawing on the accumulating empyric energies, one devoted to Tzeentch will willingly syphon the swelling power to fuel their selfish ploys.
Grand Coven.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army.
Grand Coven.effect: Select the Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.

Grand Coven.name: PSYCHIC DOMINION
Grand Coven.flavor: To pit one's psychic prowess against the sorcerous might of the Thousand Sons is to be trapped, helpless and screaming, within one's mind.
Grand Coven.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Grand Coven.target: One Thousand Sons unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Grand Coven.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [hazardous] ability, and models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

Hexwarp Thrallband.name: KALEIDOSCOPIC TEMPEST
Hexwarp Thrallband.flavor: As the Thousand Sons solidify their control over sites of magical power, the Immaterium spills into reality in searing torrents, blossoming into a multi-spectral storm of arcane energy that obscures mortal senses and mechanical augury.
Hexwarp Thrallband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hexwarp Thrallband.target: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hexwarp Thrallband.effect:
• Your unit has Stealth.
  • If your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, your unit has ‐3 detection range.

Hexwarp Thrallband.name: SCOURING WARPFLAME
Hexwarp Thrallband.flavor: At a spat curse, Warp‑infused ammunition can be made to glow with sulphurous flame, enabling it to burn through solid cover to strike enemies beyond. Those hit by the fusillade find their forms wreathed in illuminating azure fire.
Hexwarp Thrallband.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic.
Hexwarp Thrallband.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. After your unit has shot this phase, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

Hexwarp Thrallband.name: STRANDS OF TIME
Hexwarp Thrallband.flavor: By drawing upon their expanding nexus of magic, this disciple of Tzeentch can tear strands of temporal energy from the Warp and wind them around themselves and their thralls. Lent speed by this garland of stolen time, they melt away from their foes’ desperate strikes before lashing out again.
Hexwarp Thrallband.when: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army Falls Back.
Hexwarp Thrallband.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic when it is targeted with this Stratagem, then until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Hexwarp Thrallband.name: THROUGH THE VEIL
Hexwarp Thrallband.flavor: With arcane energy flooding the battlefield, the veil between Warp and reality rapidly collapses. From yawning rifts emerge Rubricae reinforcements to ensure their thrallband’s victory.
Hexwarp Thrallband.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
Hexwarp Thrallband.target: One Rubric Marines or Scarab Occult Terminators unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.
Hexwarp Thrallband.effect: If it is a RUBRIC MARINES unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATOR unit it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
Hexwarp Thrallband.restrictions: If a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit is targeted with this Stratagem, it is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

Hexwarp Thrallband.name: WARDING HEX
Hexwarp Thrallband.flavor: Thousand Sons Sorcerers draw upon tide swells of Warp energy to weave spells of binding and warding, thereby shackling sites of arcane power to their own arrogant will.
Hexwarp Thrallband.target: One Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control, if that objective marker is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic.
Hexwarp Thrallband.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Hexwarp Thrallband.name: WRATH OF THE DOOMED
Hexwarp Thrallband.flavor: Forewarned of the moment of their demise, the followers of Tzeentch allow the flood of magic to run rampant through their forms, providing them with a final burst of killing energy before unbound arcane force rips their bodies asunder
Hexwarp Thrallband.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hexwarp Thrallband.target: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hexwarp Thrallband.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Ritual of Regeneration.name: MULTITUDINOUS LIMBS
Ritual of Regeneration.flavor: So unstoppable is the torrent of life rushing through these warriors that their bodies and even their wargear sprout nests of twitching limbs that move and act with a mind of their own.
Ritual of Regeneration.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is selected to make an advance/fall back move.
Ritual of Regeneration.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

Ritual of Regeneration.name: MUTAGENIC MAGICKS
Ritual of Regeneration.flavor: Focusing the unholy energies of their ritual into the bodies of the foe, the champions of Tzeentch cause them to erupt into a riot of gruesome and unstoppable mutation.
Ritual of Regeneration.target: One friendly engaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.
Ritual of Regeneration.effect:
Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll six D6:
  • For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Ritual of Regeneration.name: RELENTLESS REBIRTH
Ritual of Regeneration.flavor: As quickly as these warriors are wounded, so their corporeal forms regenerate with supernatural swiftness.
Ritual of Regeneration.when: Any phase, when a friendly INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit suffers a mortal wound.
Ritual of Regeneration.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Rubricae Phalanx.name: ARDENT AUTOMATA
Rubricae Phalanx.flavor: The martial discipline once known amongst the Legion's fellowships has been pared back and twisted until it is another means of control, one which the Rubricae’s masters use to wrongfoot their foes with sudden changes of tactics.
Rubricae Phalanx.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Rubricae unit from your army Falls Back.
Rubricae Phalanx.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Rubricae Phalanx.name: IMPLACABLE GUARDIANS
Rubricae Phalanx.flavor: The Rubricae are superlative, enduring guardians who can absorb great storms of fire if it means shielding their masters.
Rubricae Phalanx.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
